**Company Description**  

Headquartered in India, its flagship product, the PhonePe digital payments app, was launched in Aug 2016\. As of April 2025, PhonePe has over 60 Crore (600 Million) registered users and a digital payments acceptance network spread across over 4 Crore (40\+ million) merchants. PhonePe also processes over 33 Crore (330\+ Million) transactions daily with an Annualized Total Payment Value (TPV) of over INR 150 lakh crore.

  

PhonePe’s portfolio of businesses includes the distribution of financial products (Insurance, Lending, and Wealth) as well as new consumer tech businesses (Pincode \- hyperlocal e\-commerce and Indus AppStore Localized App Store for the Android ecosystem) in India, which are aligned with the company’s vision to offer every Indian an equal opportunity to accelerate their progress by unlocking the flow of money and access to services.

 **Job Description**  

Job Objective: We are looking for HRBP for the Tech organization at PhonePe. The role will develop and execute on the HR strategy for the function by partnering closely with the engineering leadership team.


Responsibilities:


Talent Acquisition \& Onboarding:

* Be on top of hiring needs in your ownership areas.
* Collaborate with talent acquisition partner to ensure right manning and onboarding of new hire talent
* Designs structured onboarding frameworks to accelerate time\-to\-productivity for new hires and build early organizational engagement.


Talent Management:

* Oversee the performance management process including goal setting, regular touch bases and final evaluation as per the decided timelines
* Enable the talent process by holistic review of talent in the team for creating a strong succession planning bench
* Facilitate discussions of low performers with their managers and ensure creation of performance improvement plan; Track achievement and take appropriate action in case of no visible increase in performance level
* Partner to design IDPs and conduct talent reviews regularly with HOEs/EMs
* Drive organization health \& manager connect surveys, as and when conducted, and ensure maximum coverage and deep analysis for your respective areas. Own action plans and ensure adherence and improvement
* Establishes clear career ladders, competency models, and targeted managerial training to equip managers with coaching, feedback, and execution skills.


Business Partnering:

* Partner with HOEs/EMs to deliver on functional goals by providing HR solutions
* Expected to proactively identify opportunities for increased efficiency and effectiveness
* Maintain strong individual connect and regular touch points with all employees from the assigned business groups
* Solve for attrition by doing attrition analysis and taking corrective action
* Own and interpret HR policy for the organization and resolve issues quickly and effectively. Address all employee queries and provide help/ support within decided timelines
* Partner internally with the COE teams for efficient people process roll outs contextualised to tech
* Review org structures, redefines roles and workflows to eliminate bottlenecks and efficiencies

 **Qualifications**  

Capabilities \& Requirements:

* MBA \- HR from Tier 1 campus with proven working experience of 4\+ years in business partnering
* Exposure to fast paced start up environment is an added advantage.
* Strong business acumen \& understanding of the business
* Drive for result, able to demonstrate/quantify success relative to established targets and metrics
* Strong bias for impact, analytical and problem solving skills

 **Additional Information**

* Insurance Benefits \- Medical Insurance, Critical Illness Insurance, Accidental Insurance, Life Insurance
* Wellness Program \- Employee Assistance Program, Onsite Medical Center, Emergency Support System
* Parental Support \- Maternity Benefit, Paternity Benefit Program, Adoption Assistance Program, Day\-care Support Program
* Mobility Benefits \- Relocation benefits, Transfer Support Policy, Travel Policy

title: Front Desk cum Centre Operations Manager
description:
**About BAHRC**

The Bhaktivedanta Ayurvedic Healing Research Centre (BAHRC) is ISKCON Navi Mumbai's integrative Ayurveda, Yoga, Mantra \& Wellness centre at the Glory of Maharashtra Temple, Kharghar — a 10,000 sq. ft. facility offering doctor and nutritionist consultations, Panchakarma therapies, seven signature Wellness Programmes, and annual wellness memberships. The front desk is the first and most frequent point of contact for every patient and member, and this role is central to how BAHRC is experienced by the public.

**Role Overview**

This is a dual\-scope role: part guest\-facing front desk, part front\-office operations manager. We are looking for a business\-qualified, presentable, and energetic professional who can run BAHRC's day\-to\-day front desk with polish, convert enquiries into booked consultations and memberships, and independently own front\-office billing, scheduling, and light team coordination — essentially, someone who can manage the centre's front\-of\-house as their own small business unit within BAHRC.

**Key Responsibilities**

**A. Guest Experience \& Front Desk Operations**

● Serve as the first point of contact for all patients, members, and visitors, delivering a warm, professional, and presentable welcome consistent with BAHRC's brand and seva\-oriented values.

● Manage daily front\-desk operations — appointment scheduling, walk\-in registration, and patient\-flow coordination — across doctor consultations, nutritionist sessions, and therapy bookings.

● Own and administer BAHRC's online booking/scheduling system end\-to\-end, ensuring accurate real\-time availability, minimising double\-bookings, and following up on no\-shows.

**B. Consultation Conversion \& Guest Communication**

● Confidently and accurately explain BAHRC's Ayurvedic consultation process, Wellness Programmes, Panchakarma therapies, and membership tiers to enquirers, converting phone, walk\-in, and digital enquiries into booked doctor consultations and programme/membership enrolments.

● Handle enquiry calls, WhatsApp, and in\-person conversations fluently in Hindi, English, and Marathi, adapting to each caller's preferred language and comfort level.

● Track daily/weekly enquiry\-to\-conversion metrics and report trends to the Director and Sales \& Marketing Manager.

**C. Billing, Accounts \& Financial Administration**

● Process patient/member billing accurately per BAHRC's current Price Menu, issue receipts, and reconcile daily cash/card/UPI collections.

● Maintain day\-to\-day front\-office accounts records — daily collection registers, petty cash, and basic vendor payment tracking — in coordination with BAHRC's finance function.

● Ensure all billing and refund handling complies with BAHRC's Billing, Pricing \& Refund Policy, escalating discrepancies to the Director promptly.

**D. Centre \& Team Coordination**

● Coordinate daily schedules across doctors, therapists, and support staff to ensure smooth patient flow and minimal wait times.

● Provide day\-to\-day guidance to junior front\-desk/support staff, upholding service standards, punctuality, and BAHRC's Code of Conduct.

● Maintain and organise patient/member records via Google Drive and BAHRC's CRM/membership register, ensuring accuracy and confidentiality per the Patient/Member Data Privacy Policy.

● Coordinate basic retail\-shop inventory tracking and vendor liaison for front\-office and reception supplies.

**E. Reporting \& Continuous Improvement**

● Prepare and share weekly/monthly reports on footfall, conversion rates, billing summaries, and patient/member feedback with the Director.

● Proactively identify and recommend improvements to front\-desk workflows, booking\-system usage, and the overall guest experience.

**Requirements \& Skills**

● BBA or MBA, ideally with a specialisation in Marketing, Healthcare/Hospital Administration, or Operations.

● 3\-5 years of experience managing (not just staffing) front\-desk/reception operations at a wellness, spa, Ayurvedic, or healthcare centre.

● Demonstrated track record of converting enquiries into paid consultations, therapy bookings, or memberships.

● Fluent in Hindi, English, and Marathi — spoken and written.

● Proficient in MS Office/Google Workspace (Docs, Sheets, Drive), online booking/scheduling platforms, and basic billing/accounting tools.

● Young, energetic, and presentable, with polished interpersonal skills and telephone etiquette.

● Strong organisational and multitasking ability — comfortable switching between guest\-facing duties, billing, and light team supervision within the same shift.

● Comfortable working in a temple\-based, values\-led wellness environment; participation in devotional practice is welcomed but never required.

**Terms**

● This is a full\-time role governed by the BAHRC HR \& Operations Policy Manual, including a standard 6\-month probation period, notice periods, leave entitlement, and statutory benefits applicable to full\-time payroll employees.

● Compensation will be discussed at interview; we anticipate structuring this as a fixed salary plus a conversion\-linked performance incentive, consistent with BAHRC's approach for guest\-facing, sales\-adjacent roles.

**How to Apply**

Interested candidates may apply directly via this job posting, or send their resume to wellness@iskcon\-navimumbai.org with the subject line "Application — Front Desk cum Centre Operations Manager." Shortlisted candidates will be invited for an in\-person interview at BAHRC, Kharghar.

description:
Eaton’s EITC division is currently seeking a Program and Delivery Manager \- AI and Data Delivery.


### **What you’ll do:**



This position leads the delivery of data and artificial intelligence products for the HR, Legal and Corporate Development functions. The role owns the portfolio from demand intake through design, build, deployment and adoption, and is accountable for the scope, schedule, cost and quality of every initiative within it. It is a new role, created to give these functions a dedicated delivery leader as the demand for data and AI capability continues to grow.



The leader manages the HR, Legal and Corporate Development delivery team and acts as the primary point of contact for functional leadership. Working closely with the System Architect, Enterprise Architecture and Cyber Security, the role ensures that solutions handling sensitive employee and legal information meet Eaton architecture, privacy and security standards. The position also serves as secondary owner of the AI Navigator idea\-to\-disposition process for ideas raised by these functions.


* Lead end\-to\-end data and artificial intelligence delivery for the HR, Legal and Corporate Development functions, covering demand intake, prioritization, execution, deployment and value realization.
* Own the delivery roadmap and release plan for every product in the portfolio, and hold delivery teams accountable to committed scope, schedule, cost and quality.
* Lead engagement with senior functional stakeholders to identify business priorities, shape demand into fundable initiatives, and secure agreement on outcomes and success measures.
* Manage the HR, Legal and Corporate Development delivery team, including hiring, onboarding, coaching, performance management, capability building and retention of employees and contractors.
* Act as secondary owner for AI Navigator idea\-to\-disposition for ideas originating in HR, Legal and Corporate Development, ensuring each idea is assessed, dispositioned and tracked to closure.
* Build and manage the financial plan for the portfolio, including annual budget, project and run forecasting, platform consumption, contractor cost control and variance reporting.
* Partner with the System Architect, Enterprise Architecture and Cyber Security so that solutions comply with architecture guardrails, data privacy obligations and information security standards applicable to employee and legal data.
* Establish and operate delivery governance, covering status reporting, risk and issue management, dependency management, change control and steering reviews.
* Drive adoption of Agile delivery practices and improve predictability, cycle time and quality through objective delivery metrics.
* Manage supplier and partner relationships, including statements of work, resource onboarding and performance against agreed service levels.
* Champion organizational change management and user adoption for AI products, and ensure realised benefits are measured and communicated to stakeholders.

### **Qualifications**


* Bachelor degree in a technical discipline such as B.E. / B.Tech / MCA, or B.S. in Computer Science, Mathematics or Engineering. A master degree or MBA is preferred.
* 14 or more years of relevant industry experience in information technology delivery.
* 8 or more years leading program or project delivery for data, analytics or application products in a global organization.
* 4 or more years of direct people leadership of engineering teams that include employees and contract resources.

### **Skills**


* Project or program management certification such as PMP, PgMP, Scrum Master or SAFe is preferred.
* Experience delivering technology for HR, Legal or Corporate Development functions, including work with confidential employee or legal data, is preferred.
* Working knowledge of data engineering and analytics platforms, including data pipelines, data warehousing and reporting on Microsoft Azure.
* Practical understanding of artificial intelligence and generative AI solution patterns, including large language models, retrieval augmented generation, prompt design and accuracy evaluation.
* Strong command of program and portfolio management disciplines covering scope, schedule, cost, risk, quality and benefits management.
* Experience running Agile delivery at scale using Scrum, Kanban or SAFe, with hands\-on use of Azure DevOps or equivalent tooling.
* Understanding of enterprise application integration, application programming interfaces and workflow automation.
* Familiarity with data privacy, records retention and information security requirements that apply to employee, legal and corporate development data.
* Financial management capability covering budgeting, forecasting, vendor contracting and cost control.
* Executive communication and stakeholder management, with the ability to translate technical work into business outcomes.
* Ability to lead through influence across a matrixed, global organization and across time zones.
* Proven capability in coaching, developing talent and building inclusive, high\-performing teams.
* Structured problem solving and sound decision making in conditions of ambiguity.
* Customer focus, solution orientation and a strong drive for results.

title: Sr. HR Executive
description:
Banu's Holdings Pte Ltd (Singapore) is looking for a hands\-on Senior HR Executive to own end\-to\-end payroll and HR documentation across three jurisdictions — Singapore, Malaysia, and India. This role sits at the centre of our HR operations, ensuring every employee and contractor is paid accurately, on time, and in full compliance with local statutory requirements, while keeping our leave and documentation systems airtight.

This is a strong fit for someone who is meticulous with numbers and paperwork, comfortable working across multiple legal frameworks, and confident picking up new regulatory requirements quickly — you'll be expected to get up to speed on Malaysian employment law fast if you're not already familiar with it.

Key Responsibilities

**Multi\-country Payroll**

* Process monthly payroll for employees and contractors across Singapore, Malaysia, and India entities, ensuring accuracy and timeliness in each pay cycle
* Accurately capture and apply all allowances (e.g. WFH/infrastructure, attendance, transport, other fixed and variable allowances) per each contractor's or employee's specific terms
* Calculate pro\-rated pay correctly for new joiners, exits, and mid\-cycle changes
* Compute and process statutory contributions correctly per country: CPF (Singapore), EPF/SOCSO/EIS (Malaysia), and applicable India statutory deductions.
* Reconcile payroll figures against contracts, invoices, and attendance/leave records before disbursement
* Liaise with Finance to ensure payment runs are accurate and submitted on schedule

**Statutory Compliance**

* Build working knowledge of Malaysian Employment Act requirements (and keep Singapore/India knowledge current) — proactively flag compliance gaps or upcoming regulatory changes
* Ensure statutory filings and submissions (CPF, EPF/SOCSO/EIS, and India equivalents) are completed accurately and on time
* Support audit and compliance reviews with organized, accurate payroll documentation

**Leave Management**

* Maintain and manage leave schedules across all three entities, tracking entitlements, balances, and approvals
* Ensure leave records reconcile correctly with payroll (unpaid leave, pro\-ration, encashment where applicable)
* Flag scheduling conflicts or coverage gaps to management

**HR Documentation**

* Maintain accurate, up\-to\-date records for all employees and contractors: contracts, amendments, pay structures, and personal particulars
* Draft and update employment/contractor agreements, remuneration clauses, and HR letters as needed
* Keep a clean, audit\-ready paper trail for every payroll decision, allowance change, and contract amendment
* Maintain master salary/payroll workbooks and supporting documentation used for monthly payment processing

What We're Looking For

* Proven experience running payroll (ideally multi\-country) — Singapore and/or Malaysia payroll experience strongly preferred; India payroll exposure a plus
* willingness and ability to quickly learn Malaysian employment law in depth
* Excellent attention to detail — this role requires zero\-tolerance accuracy on pay calculations and allowances
* Strong documentation discipline: comfortable drafting, organizing, and maintaining contracts, policies, and records
* Proficiency with payroll related tools (e.g. Talent, Autocount HR); AutoCount experience is a plus
* Ability to manage competing deadlines across three entities and time zones
* Clear written communication for contracts, policy documents, and employee correspondence
* Prior experience in a lean, fast\-scaling SME environment is an advantage

Nice to Have

* HR certification (e.g. CIPD, IHRP) or equivalent
* Experience with contractor/freelancer engagement structures alongside traditional payroll
* Exposure to food/FMCG, manufacturing, or distribution industries

**About Turabit Solutions**

Turabit Solutions is a technology\-driven organization focused on delivering innovative technology and AI\-enabled solutions. We are looking for a dedicated and career\-oriented **Corporate Recruiter** who can take ownership of the recruitment process and contribute to building a strong and high\-performing organization.

This role is ideal for an HR professional who has **at least 1 year of experience in US IT Services, US IT Staffing, or a similar technology\-driven environment** and is looking to build a long\-term career in Corporate HR and Talent Acquisition.

**Position Overview**

The Corporate Recruiter will be responsible for managing and executing the **end\-to\-end recruitment process** for corporate and technology positions. The person should have a strong understanding of recruitment fundamentals, excellent follow\-up and coordination skills, attention to detail, and the ability to work with a sense of urgency.

We are looking for someone who is **dedicated, disciplined, time\-bound, proactive and willing to go the extra mile** to achieve hiring objectives.

The candidate should also be comfortable using **AI tools and modern recruitment technologies** to improve sourcing, screening, communication, productivity, and overall recruitment efficiency.

**Key Responsibilities**  
1\. End\-to\-End Recruitment

* Manage the complete recruitment lifecycle from understanding hiring requirements to candidate onboarding.
* Work closely with hiring managers and department heads to understand manpower requirements and job specifications.
* Prepare and publish accurate job descriptions on appropriate job portals and professional networks.
* Source candidates through job portals, LinkedIn, employee referrals, databases, social media, and other relevant channels.
* Screen resumes and conduct initial candidate assessments.
* Conduct preliminary HR interviews and evaluate candidates based on skills, experience, communication, attitude, and organizational fit.
* Coordinate technical and managerial interview rounds with relevant stakeholders.
* Maintain regular communication and follow\-up with candidates throughout the hiring process.
* Manage offer discussions, salary negotiations, documentation, and joining formalities.
* Ensure a smooth candidate experience from first contact through onboarding.

2\. US IT Staffing / Technology Recruitment Understanding

* Leverage previous exposure to **US IT Services / US IT Staffing** to understand technology roles, candidate profiles, and recruitment terminology.
* Understand common technology skill sets and be able to identify relevant candidates from resumes.
* Develop and maintain a strong candidate pipeline for recurring and critical positions.
* Build relationships with potential candidates for future hiring requirements.

3\. Corporate HR \& Recruitment Process

* Maintain proper recruitment records, trackers, interview schedules, candidate status, and hiring reports.
* Ensure recruitment activities are completed within defined timelines.
* Follow established HR policies, recruitment SOPs, and approval processes.
* Maintain confidentiality of candidate and employee information.
* Coordinate with HR and management for joining, documentation, background verification, and onboarding activities.
* Support other HR initiatives as required.

4\. AI \& Recruitment Technology

* Use **AI tools and recruitment technologies** to work smarter, faster, and more efficiently.
* Explore practical applications of AI for:
* Resume screening and shortlisting
* Candidate sourcing
* Job description creation and optimization
* Interview question generation
* Candidate communication
* Recruitment reporting and analysis
* Recruitment documentation
* Market and talent research
* Continuously identify ways to improve recruitment productivity through automation, AI, and digital tools.
* Stay updated with emerging AI\-based HR and recruitment technologies.

Key Skills \& Competencies

The ideal candidate should demonstrate:

* Strong understanding of **core recruitment and HR processes**.
* Minimum **1 year of experience in US IT Services, US IT Staffing, IT recruitment, or a similar technology environment**.
* Excellent sourcing and candidate screening skills.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
* Good understanding of recruitment lifecycle and interview coordination.
* Strong follow\-up and candidate relationship management skills.
* Excellent attention to detail.
* Strong organizational and time\-management skills.
* Ability to manage multiple vacancies and priorities simultaneously.
* Strong sense of ownership and accountability.
* Professional discipline and a positive attitude.
* Ability to work within deadlines and meet recruitment targets.
* Proactive approach with a willingness to **go the extra mile** when required.
* Ability and willingness to learn new technologies and recruitment tools.
* Basic understanding or hands\-on exposure to **AI tools for recruitment** will be an advantage.

What We Are Looking For

We are looking for a professional who:

* Is **serious about building a long\-term career in Corporate HR and Talent Acquisition**.
* Takes ownership rather than waiting for instructions.
* Is highly **dedicated, detail\-oriented, disciplined, and time\-bound**.
* Understands that recruitment requires consistent follow\-up, urgency, and persistence.
* Can work independently while collaborating effectively with managers and teams.
* Is willing to learn, adapt, and continuously improve.
* Has a **“can\-do” attitude** and is willing to go beyond routine responsibilities to achieve hiring objectives.
* Wants to develop into a strong HR professional and eventually take on broader HR responsibilities.

Preferred Qualifications

* 1\+ year of relevant recruitment experience.
* Prior experience with **US IT Staffing / US IT Services / Technology recruitment** is preferred.

* Familiarity with AI tools such as ChatGPT or other AI\-based recruitment/productivity tools is preferred.

Career Growth

Based on performance, capability, and demonstrated ownership, the role can provide opportunities to grow into areas such as:

title: Head of Talent Acquisition
description:
**Head of Talent Acquisition**

**Invisia Software Pvt. Ltd. \| Bengaluru, Kalyan Nagar \| Full\-time**

**Function:** People \& Culture  
**Location:** Bengaluru, Kalyan Nagar, On\-site  
**Experience:** 10–15 years  
**Reporting To:** CHRO / Executive Leadership  
**Team:** 2–4 TA professionals initially  
**Industry Preference:** SaaS / Product Technology

**About Invisia Software**

Invisia Software is a growing product technology company headquartered in Bengaluru. As the organization scales its product, technology and business functions, we are strengthening our Talent Acquisition function to build a predictable, high\-quality and scalable hiring capability.

**Role Overview**

The Head of Talent Acquisition will own the complete Talent Acquisition function, from workforce and hiring planning through recruitment strategy, team management, sourcing, execution, funnel performance and hiring outcomes.

This is a hands\-on functional leadership role. The successful candidate will partner with leadership and functional heads to translate business and workforce requirements into executable hiring plans, establish TA goals and processes, build and manage the TA team, personally support critical hiring, and ensure recruitment performance meets agreed quality, timeline and cost expectations.

The role is expected to establish a TA function that operates with clear ownership, measurable performance, reliable forecasting and limited dependency on continuous senior leadership intervention.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Workforce and Hiring Planning**

* Partner with leadership, HR and functional heads to translate annual and quarterly business plans into workforce and hiring requirements.
* Validate requirements based on business priority, role necessity, skill availability, compensation and market conditions.
* Develop quarterly and monthly hiring plans with priorities, timelines, recruiter capacity, sourcing approach, dependencies and risks.
* Forecast TA capacity required to deliver approved hiring plans.
* Maintain forward\-looking talent pipelines for anticipated and difficult\-to\-fill requirements.
* Provide realistic hiring forecasts and proactively escalate risks with corrective actions.

**TA Strategy and Functional Ownership**

* Own the Talent Acquisition strategy, operating model and performance of the function.
* Translate organizational hiring goals into departmental goals and individual recruiter KRAs/KPIs.
* Establish recruitment processes, playbooks, SLAs, interview frameworks and governance.
* Build an appropriate TA team structure and develop internal recruitment capability.
* Evaluate TA tools, sourcing channels, agencies and external partners based on performance and business requirements.
* Continuously identify and resolve structural recruitment issues.

**Hiring Delivery**

* Own delivery of the approved hiring plan across Technology, Product, Design, Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, Operations, Finance, HR and leadership positions.
* Personally lead or support critical, niche, senior and difficult\-to\-fill positions.
* Maintain strong hands\-on capability in sourcing, talent mapping, screening, assessment, candidate engagement and offer negotiation.
* Ensure recruitment delivery meets agreed quality, timeline and cost expectations.
* Build proactive pipelines for recurring and strategically important talent requirements.

**TA Team Leadership and Performance**

* Lead, coach and develop the TA team.
* Allocate requisitions based on priority, complexity, capacity and recruiter capability.
* Establish individual and team goals, KPIs and performance expectations.
* Conduct structured weekly pipeline and performance reviews.
* Identify capability and performance gaps and implement appropriate development or corrective actions.
* Build team capability to reduce dependency on individual recruiters or external agencies.

**Recruitment Funnel Management**

* Own performance across the complete recruitment funnel from sourcing through joining.
* Establish appropriate funnel benchmarks by role category.
* Monitor conversion, aging, candidate withdrawals, interview no\-shows, offer declines and joining drop\-offs.
* Diagnose whether underperformance originates from sourcing, screening, requirement calibration, assessments, interviewer quality, compensation, candidate engagement or other factors.
* Implement corrective actions when funnel performance falls below expectations.
* Prevent repeated poor\-quality submissions from consuming unnecessary hiring\-manager and leadership bandwidth.

**Hiring Manager Governance**

* Establish structured requisition intake and role\-calibration processes.
* Ensure role requirements, competencies, assessment methods, compensation and timelines are aligned before sourcing begins.
* Establish appropriate SLAs for profile review, interviews, feedback and hiring decisions.
* Use market evidence and recruitment data to challenge unrealistic or inconsistent requirements.
* Conduct recalibration where repeated candidate rejection indicates misalignment.
* Support hiring managers in structured interviewing and objective candidate evaluation.

**Analytics, Forecasting and Reporting**

* Establish and maintain TA dashboards covering hiring plan versus actual, requisition aging, forecasted closures, funnel conversions, offer acceptance, offer\-to\-join, source effectiveness, recruiter productivity, agency performance and critical hiring risks.
* Provide leadership with clear weekly and monthly hiring\-health reporting.
* Distinguish positions that are on track, at risk or critical and provide corrective actions and expected resolution timelines.
* Maintain ATS discipline and ensure reliable recruitment data and reporting.

**Vendor and Agency Management**

* Determine where external recruitment support is appropriate.
* Manage recruitment agencies, executive search firms and specialist sourcing partners.
* Establish candidate\-quality expectations, SLAs and commercial terms.
* Track vendor performance based on quality, conversion, closures, TAT and cost.
* Optimize agency usage and reduce unnecessary external dependency.

**Employer Branding and Talent Market**

* Own TA requirements and strategy relating to employer positioning and candidate experience.
* Partner with HR, Marketing and Creative on careers content, employee stories and recruitment campaigns.
* Develop employee referral and relevant talent\-community initiatives.
* Monitor candidate experience and recruitment\-related employer reputation.
* Represent the organization at relevant hiring and talent events where appropriate.

**Role Boundaries**

The Head of Talent Acquisition is not the primary owner of:

* HR operations, payroll or general HR administration.
* Employee relations or organization\-wide performance management.
* Learning and Development or Compensation and Benefits.
* Marketing or employer\-brand content production.
* Routine onboarding administration following recruitment handover.
* Final technical evaluation of specialist candidates.
* Business headcount decisions or justification of workforce requirements on behalf of functional leaders.

Functional leaders remain accountable for identifying and justifying business capability and headcount requirements. The Head of TA is responsible for validating, translating and executing approved workforce requirements through an effective recruitment strategy.

**First 90 Days: Expected Outcomes**

**First 30 Days**

* Complete current\-state assessment of TA processes, people, tools and vendors.
* Validate open requisitions, priorities and hiring requirements with functional heads.
* Establish baseline hiring plan and recruitment funnel metrics.
* Assess recruiter capacity and capability.
* Review ATS discipline, agency performance and existing sourcing channels.
* Identify critical hiring risks and implement immediate interventions.
* Present recommended TA operating model and priority improvement plan.

**Days 31–60**

* Implement quarterly/monthly hiring plan and requisition prioritization.
* Establish recruiter allocation and capacity planning.
* Cascade TA goals into individual recruiter KRAs/KPIs.
* Establish weekly TA operating and performance reviews.
* Implement hiring\-manager intake, calibration and SLA processes.
* Operationalize TA dashboard and hiring forecasts.
* Implement agency/vendor scorecards.
* Establish structured interview and evaluation frameworks.
* Begin proactive talent mapping for critical positions.

**Days 61–90**

* Establish reliable hiring plan versus actual reporting and monthly closure forecasting.
* Demonstrate measurable recruiter productivity and accountability.
* Establish visibility and intervention mechanisms for critical\-role pipelines.
* Demonstrate active management of recruitment funnel bottlenecks.
* Establish measurable hiring\-manager and agency performance.
* Improve ATS and recruitment\-data discipline.
* Present TA team capacity and capability recommendations.
* Present a six\-month TA improvement and hiring roadmap.

**Key Result Areas**

**KRA \- Weight**

Workforce and Hiring Planning \-15%

Hiring Delivery and Critical Role Closure \- 25%

TA Team Performance and Capability \- 15%

Sourcing Strategy and Pipeline Health \- 10%

Recruitment Funnel Performance \- 15%

Hiring Manager Governance \- 10%

Analytics, Forecasting and Process Governance \- 5%

Vendor, Employer Brand and Talent Ecosystem \- 5%

**Total \- 100%**

**Experience and Qualifications**

* 10–15 years of Talent Acquisition experience, preferably with significant exposure to SaaS, product or technology organizations.
* Minimum 4–5 years of experience directly managing TA professionals.
* Demonstrated experience owning a TA function or substantial recruitment portfolio.
* Proven ability to translate workforce requirements into structured hiring plans and execution.
* Strong experience establishing recruiter goals, KPIs, processes and operating cadences.
* Proven track record of technology, product and business\-function recruitment.
* Strong hands\-on sourcing, talent mapping and passive candidate engagement capability.
* Experience personally closing difficult mid\-to\-senior and leadership positions.
* Demonstrated recruitment funnel analysis, hiring forecasting and problem\-solving capability.
* Experience building or significantly improving recruitment processes and assessment frameworks.
* Strong hiring\-manager and senior stakeholder management.
* Experience managing recruitment agencies and external search partners.
* Strong understanding of ATS, recruitment analytics and data\-driven TA management.

**Preferred:** Executive search, startup/scale\-up, employer branding, high\-volume recruitment or experience building a TA function from an early or less mature stage.

**Overall Accountability**

The Head of Talent Acquisition is accountable for delivering the approved workforce hiring plan within agreed quality, timeline and cost parameters while building a capable TA team, maintaining healthy recruitment funnels and providing leadership with reliable hiring forecasts and clear accountability.

description:

**Job Description:**

**The Opportunity**

At Hitachi Energy, we are committed to creating a sustainable energy future through innovation, collaboration, and operational excellence. We are looking for a Compensation \& Benefits Analyst to join our Global HR Services team and play a critical role in delivering compensation and benefits support across multiple geographies.


In this role, you will partner with HR teams, business leaders, employees, and external vendors to ensure the efficient administration of compensation programs and employee benefits. You will be responsible for supporting key annual compensation processes, maintaining data accuracy within Workday, providing insightful reporting and analytics, and ensuring a high level of service delivery to stakeholders worldwide.


This position offers an excellent opportunity to gain global exposure while working on complex compensation programs, incentive plans, salary reviews, and benefits administration. You will collaborate with colleagues across regions, contribute to process improvements, and help drive operational excellence within a fast\-paced and dynamic environment.


As part of a high\-performing HR Services organization, you will leverage analytical thinking, digital tools, and process expertise to enhance employee experience, ensure compliance, and support strategic business objectives. If you are detail\-oriented, customer\-focused, and passionate about compensation and benefits, this role provides an exciting platform for professional growth and impact.


**How You'll Make an Impact**

* Support the execution of global compensation processes, including Annual Salary Reviews (ASR), Short\-Term Incentive (STI) programs, Long\-Term Incentive (LTI) programs, scorecards, and other compensation initiatives, ensuring accuracy and timely delivery.
* Administer compensation programs across multiple countries and regulatory environments while maintaining compliance with company policies and local requirements.
* Maintain, validate, and monitor compensation\-related employee data in Workday, ensuring data integrity and accuracy across HR systems.
* Generate standard and ad hoc compensation reports, analytics, and insights to support global and regional stakeholders in decision\-making.
* Coordinate and support regional and global employee benefits programs, including vendor management and service delivery activities.
* Manage end\-to\-end compensation transactions, including data validation, calculations, approvals, and payout readiness through established workflows and systems such as ServiceNow.
* Ensure delivery of compensation services in accordance with defined Service Level Agreements (SLAs), maintaining high standards of quality, turnaround time, and customer satisfaction.
* Develop and maintain Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and Work Instructions (WIs) to ensure process consistency and compliance.
* Identify process improvement opportunities, perform root cause analysis, and contribute to initiatives that enhance operational efficiency and service excellence.
* Collaborate effectively with cross\-functional and global teams while leveraging digital and analytical tools to improve productivity and decision\-making.

**Your Background**

* Master's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Finance, or a related discipline.
* 3 to 5 years of experience in HR Shared Services, Compensation Operations, or Compensation \& Benefits Administration within a global organization.
* Hands\-on experience supporting compensation programs, including Annual Salary Reviews (ASR), Short\-Term Incentives (STI), Long\-Term Incentives (LTI), salary administration, and compensation reporting.
* Experience working with HR systems, preferably Workday, including compensation data management, reporting, and process administration.
* Strong analytical skills with proficiency in Microsoft Excel and working knowledge of PowerPoint, Power BI, and other digital reporting tools.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to effectively manage stakeholders across different functions and geographies.
* Proven ability to manage multiple priorities, meet deadlines, and thrive in a fast\-paced, high\-volume environment.
* Experience supporting employee benefits administration and vendor coordination is preferred.

**More About Us**

At Hitachi Energy, we are advancing the world's energy system to be more sustainable, flexible, and secure. We foster an inclusive and collaborative culture where diverse perspectives are valued, innovation is encouraged, and continuous learning is supported.


Joining our team means working alongside talented professionals across the globe while contributing to meaningful work that supports employees and business success. We offer opportunities for career growth, global exposure, and professional development in an environment built on integrity, safety, and respect.


**Demonstrates effective use of AI and digital tools to enhance problem\-solving, decision\-making, and productivity, while applying sound judgment, ensuring accuracy and compliance, and maintaining accountability for outcomes.**

**Accessibility and reasonable accommodation**

**Qualified individuals with a disability may request a reasonable accommodation if you are unable or limited in your ability to use or access the Hitachi Energy career site as a result of your disability. You may request reasonable accommodations by completing a** **general inquiry form** **on our website. Please include your contact information and specific details about your required accommodation to support you during the job application process.**

  

**This is solely for job seekers with disabilities requiring accessibility assistance or an accommodation in the job application process. Messages left for other purposes will not receive a response.**

  

**Use of Al and automated tools in recruitment**

**As part of our recruitment process, Hitachi Energy uses digital and automated tools, including Al\-supported solutions, to assist with activities such as application screening, job matching, and interview scheduling. These tools are designed to support our recruiters and do not replace human decision\-making. Candidate data is processed in accordance with applicable data protection and employment laws as well as** **Hitachi's Global Data Privacy Notice.**  

  

**Background Screening and Security Checks**

**As part of the hiring process, Hitachi Energy conducts pre\-employment background checks that may include verification of employment history, education, criminal records, and other relevant information, in accordance with applicable laws.**

**For certain roles—particularly those involving access to sensitive information, financial responsibilities, client data, regulated environments, or security\-sensitive functions—additional or more comprehensive background or security screenings may be required. These may include, but are not limited to, enhanced criminal history checks, credit history reviews (where legally permissible), sanctions screening, or other due diligence measures aligned with the responsibilities of the position.**

**The scope and depth of any background or security review will be determined based on the nature of the role and business necessity, and will always be conducted in compliance with applicable federal, state, and local laws. Candidates will be notified and, where required, asked to provide consent prior to the initiation of any such checks.**

**Customer Support Intern**

**Location:** Pune**Employment Type:** Internship**Experience:** Fresher / 0–1 year**Company:** Celoxis

**About Celoxis**

Celoxis is a global Project Portfolio Management (PPM) platform used by organizations to plan projects, manage resources, track financials, collaborate, and make better business decisions.

We are looking for curious, customer\-focused graduates who enjoy solving problems and want to build a career in SaaS, customer support, and technology.

**Role Overview**

As a **Customer Support Intern**, you will be part of the team responsible for helping Celoxis customers successfully use and troubleshoot the product.

This is not just a ticket\-handling role. You will learn how a B2B SaaS product works, understand real customer business problems, investigate technical issues, and communicate solutions clearly.

You will work closely with Customer Success, Product, Engineering, and other internal teams.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Respond to customer questions through support tickets, email, chat, and calls.
* Understand customer issues and identify the actual problem before suggesting a solution.
* Learn the Celoxis product in depth, including projects, tasks, resources, timesheets, reports, workflows, and administration.
* Reproduce customer\-reported issues and document clear reproduction steps.
* Troubleshoot functional and basic technical issues using application settings, logs, browser developer tools, APIs, and other available diagnostic information.
* Guide customers through product configuration and recommended approaches.
* Escalate product defects and complex technical issues with complete supporting information.
* Work with Product and Engineering teams to follow issues through to resolution.
* Keep customers updated on the progress of their queries.
* Create and improve internal troubleshooting documentation and knowledge\-base content.
* Identify recurring customer problems and share feedback that can help improve the product and customer experience.
* Participate in product testing and validation of fixes or new releases when required.

**What We Are Looking For**

We care more about your ability to **learn, think, communicate, and solve problems** than prior work experience.

You should have:

* A Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, IT, Engineering, BCA, BSc Computer Science, or a related field.
* Strong written and verbal English communication skills.
* Good analytical and logical reasoning skills.
* Curiosity to understand how software works instead of simply following predefined steps.
* Ability to break a problem into smaller parts and troubleshoot systematically.
* Patience and professionalism while communicating with customers.
* Willingness to learn new technologies and business concepts.
* Good attention to detail and documentation skills.
* Ability to take ownership of a problem and follow it through to resolution.

**Good to Have**

Prior knowledge is not mandatory, but exposure to any of the following will be helpful:

* SQL and relational databases
* REST APIs, JSON, HTTP, and web applications
* Browser Developer Tools
* Basic networking concepts
* Linux / Windows command line
* Java or general programming concepts
* SaaS applications
* Project management concepts
* Tools such as Postman, Zendesk, Jira, or similar platforms

**What You Will Learn**

During the internship, you will gain hands\-on exposure to:

* Enterprise SaaS customer support
* Project and Portfolio Management concepts
* Technical troubleshooting
* APIs and integrations
* Database and application fundamentals
* Customer communication and expectation management
* Product testing and defect reporting
* Working with Product and Engineering teams
* Handling real\-world enterprise customer scenarios

**What Success Looks Like**

A successful Customer Support Intern at Celoxis will gradually be able to:

* Understand customer requirements without relying heavily on others.
* Troubleshoot issues methodically.
* Provide accurate and easy\-to\-understand responses.
* Distinguish between configuration issues, product limitations, and potential defects.
* Write high\-quality escalation notes that help Engineering investigate quickly.
* Take ownership of customer queries from initial investigation through resolution.
* Build strong product knowledge and become a dependable member of the Customer Support team.

**Who Would Enjoy This Role?**

You may be a strong fit if you enjoy questions such as:

**“Why is this happening?”**

**“Can I reproduce this?”**

**“What changed?”**

**“Is this configuration, expected behaviour, or a bug?”**

**“How can I explain the solution clearly to the customer?”**

If you enjoy solving puzzles, learning software, interacting with people, and understanding both the technical and business side of a problem, this role can be a strong starting point for your career in SaaS.

Position: HR Recruiter

**Company:** Akssai ProjExel \& STCO  
**Location:** Bengaluru  
**Work Mode:** Onsite  
**Working Days:** Monday to Saturday (6 Days)  
**Experience:** 0\.6 months to 1 Years  
**Joining:** Immediate Joiners Preferred  
**Qualification:** MBA – HR / Human Resources

About the Role

We are looking for a **proactive and result\-oriented HR Recruiter** to join our Noida team. The candidate will be responsible for managing the **end\-to\-end recruitment lifecycle**, from candidate sourcing and screening to interview coordination, selection, offer management, and onboarding.

The ideal candidate should have strong communication and coordination skills, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple hiring requirements simultaneously.

Key Responsibilities1\. Candidate Sourcing \& Screening

* Source candidates through job portals, social media platforms, employee referrals, and other recruitment channels.
* Screen candidates based on experience, location, salary expectations, communication skills, and relevant domain knowledge.
* Shortlist suitable candidates according to the job requirements.
* Maintain an updated candidate pipeline and recruitment tracker.

2\. Interview Coordination

* Coordinate and schedule **HR, Technical, Office Visit, and Final Interview** rounds.
* Share interview meeting links and assessment details with candidates.
* Follow up with candidates and interviewers to ensure smooth coordination.
* Track interview attendance and collect timely feedback from hiring managers.

3\. Candidate Communication

* Communicate interview schedules, selection, rejection, and next\-step updates to candidates.
* Maintain professional communication throughout the recruitment process.
* Follow up with selected candidates to ensure availability and joining commitment.

4\. Selection \& Salary Coordination

* Coordinate salary discussions and negotiations with candidates and senior stakeholders.
* Confirm and document salary, reporting manager, coach details, and client/work location.
* Share salary details for internal approval.
* Update recruitment trackers and maintain accurate hiring records.

5\. Offer \& Pre\-Joining Process

* Send selection/confirmation emails to candidates.
* Initiate and coordinate **Background Verification (BGV)**.
* Generate Employee IDs and coordinate credential creation.
* Prepare and issue offer letters.
* Track offer acceptance and candidate commitment.

6\. Onboarding Coordination

* Coordinate system/laptop allocation and other onboarding requirements.
* Upload and maintain candidate/employee details in the HRMS or recruitment system.
* Share onboarding communication with selected candidates.
* Confirm and track the **Date of Joining (DOJ)**.
* Ensure a smooth transition from recruitment to onboarding.

Required Skills

* Strong verbal and written communication skills.
* Good interpersonal and coordination abilities.
* Strong follow\-up and candidate management skills.
* Excellent attention to detail.
* Ability to multitask and manage multiple open positions.
* Good understanding of recruitment and hiring processes.
* Ability to work in a fast\-paced and target\-oriented environment.
* Proficiency in MS Excel/Google Sheets and recruitment/HR systems.

Eligibility Criteria

* **MBA graduates, preferably MBA – HR, are eligible to apply.**
* Candidates with **0\.6 months –1 years of recruitment experience** will be preferred.
* Immediate joiners will be given preference.
* Candidates must be interested in building a **long\-term career in recruitment/HR**.
* Candidates applying only for an internship certificate are **not eligible**.

What We Offer

* Health Benefits
* Training \& Mentorship
* Learning and Development Opportunities
* Clear Career Growth Path
* Exposure to End\-to\-End Recruitment
* Professional and Growth\-Oriented Work Environment

Pay: ₹10,000\.00 \- ₹18,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Health insurance

OX Agry Pvt Ltd is looking for a **Customer Relationship Executive (CRE)** to manage the end\-to\-end machinery\-service relationship through our **digital platform**.

This is a **customer relationship, booking, and operations coordination role — not a telecalling role**.

**Career Growth**

title: Human Resource Intern
description:
**Who Are We?**

Millipixels Interactive is where creativity, technology, strategy, and innovation come together to build meaningful digital experiences for clients across 16 countries. We partner with startups, growing businesses, and enterprise brands globally to create immersive digital products and technology solutions.  
We’re a team that thrives on ideas, ownership, experimentation, and execution. We like people who take initiative, think beyond the obvious, and bring energy into everything they do. If you’re someone who enjoys building, collaborating, and making a visible impact, you’ll probably enjoy being here.

**About The Role**

Good culture isn't an accident \- it's built through consistent, well\-run people processes surveys that lead to real action, reports and dashboards that leadership can actually use, events that people look forward to, and an onboarding experience that makes new hires feel at home from day one.  
As the Human Resources Intern, you'll work closely with the Human Resources team to support exactly that. You'll get hands\-on exposure across engagement, dashboards \& reporting, training coordination, and day\-to\-day HR operations, learning what it actually takes to run a people function, not just observe one.

**You’ll Be The Person Who**

* **Drives Engagement Initiatives:** Assists with engagement surveys and initiatives, helping capture how the team is really feeling.
* **Makes the Numbers Tell a Story:** Helps build and maintain HR reports and dashboards, keeping people's data accurate and current.
* **Coordinates Learning:** Supports the planning and coordination of training sessions, handling logistics and scheduling.
* **Brings People Together:** Helps plan and coordinate HR events and engagement activities, from idea to on\-the\-day execution.
* **Smooths the Onboarding Journey:** Assists with onboarding new hires, so their first few weeks feel organised and welcoming.
* **Keeps the Records Straight:** Handles general HR documentation and maintains employee records, so nothing falls through the cracks.

**Is This You?**

* You're proficient in MS Excel/Google Sheets and PowerPoint, and familiar with task tracking tools like ClickUp.
* You communicate clearly — in writing and out loud — and can put together basic content for engagement posts and announcements.
* You're strongly organised, reliable with recurring tasks, and good at juggling multiple priorities at once.
* You have an eye for detail, take data accuracy seriously, and can think analytically to put together reports that make sense.
* You've got some experience with (or genuine interest in) event planning and coordination.
* You're proactive, creative, and enthusiastic, with a collaborative mindset that works well across teams.

**Benefits Of Working At Millipixels**

* **Flexible work, your way:** Work where you do your best thinking. We measure outcomes, not hours at a desk.
* **Life admin handled:** Regular expert\-led sessions on finance, tax, and healthcare, so the boring stuff doesn't eat into your weekends.
* **Real mentorship:** Work closely with an experienced HR team that invests in your growth, not just your task list.
* **Hands\-on learning:** Get exposure to real HR projects and processes from day one — not just coffee runs and admin.
* **Room to grow:** Continuous learning and real development in a global team, with space to turn this internship into something more.
* **Ownership, not red tape:** Small team, big trust. Bring the idea, run with it, and watch it ship.

**About Northern Trust**

  

As a global leader in innovative wealth management, asset servicing, asset management and banking services, Northern Trust (Nasdaq: NTRS) is proud to guide the world’s most successful individuals, families, corporations and institutions.

**The key responsibilities of the role include;**

* Good understanding of the statutory compliances of the region

* Record monthly payroll metrics

* Research and monitor regulatory and legislative changes impacting payroll areas of responsibility.
* Performs vendor management activities to ensure adherence to corporate vendor management standards.
* Review team members work; including but not limited to review of payroll input and manual calculations.
* Acquire knowledge of other team members’ payroll activities and perform back up support.
* Represent the department in meetings.

**Skills/ Qualifications:**


The successful candidate will benefit from having:

* 5\+ years of payroll experience dealing with multiple countries is desirable
* Experience with payroll processing including; payroll production, reconciliation,
* Attention to detail
* Ability to work independently
* Ability to meet strict deadlines
* Ability to multi\-task in a high paced environment
* Strong analytical and problem solving skills, with a focus on continuous improvements

The Northern Trust Bangalore office, established in 2005, is home to over 5,600 employees. In this stunning office space, we offer fantastic amenities which include our Arrival Hub \- Jungle, the GameZone, and the Employee Experience Zone that appeal to both clients and employees. Learn more.

**Job Title:** HR Generalist  
**Experience:** 0–2 Years  
**Location:** Bangalore, India  
**Employment Type:** Full\-Time  
**Department:** Human Resources

About the Role

We are looking for a motivated and detail\-oriented **HR Generalist** to join our HR team. The ideal candidate will support day\-to\-day HR operations, employee coordination, recruitment activities, documentation, and employee engagement initiatives.

This role is well suited for a candidate who is looking to build a strong foundation across different areas of Human Resources.

Key Responsibilities

* Support the **end\-to\-end recruitment process**, including job postings, candidate sourcing, screening, interview coordination, and follow\-ups.
* Coordinate with candidates and hiring managers to schedule interviews and maintain recruitment updates.
* Assist with **joining and onboarding formalities**, including documentation and employee records.
* Maintain and update employee information, HR trackers, attendance records, and personnel files.
* Support preparation and management of **offer letters, appointment letters, confirmation letters, relieving letters, and other HR documents**.
* Assist in employee attendance, leave, and payroll\-related coordination.
* Handle employee queries and coordinate with relevant teams for timely resolution.
* Support employee engagement activities, internal communications, and HR initiatives.
* Maintain proper HR documentation and ensure records are accurate and up to date.
* Assist with **performance management, confirmation processes, and employee lifecycle activities**.
* Support exit formalities, including resignation documentation, exit interviews, and clearance processes.
* Ensure HR processes are followed consistently and maintain confidentiality of employee information.
* Prepare regular HR reports and trackers as required by management.
* Assist the HR team with other administrative and operational activities.

Required Skills

* Good verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong interpersonal and coordination skills.
* Basic understanding of **HR processes and recruitment**.
* Good knowledge of MS Office, particularly **Excel and Word**.
* Strong organizational and time\-management skills.
* Attention to detail and ability to maintain accurate records.
* Ability to handle multiple tasks and meet deadlines.
* Professional attitude and willingness to learn.
* Ability to maintain confidentiality and handle sensitive employee information.

Qualification

* Bachelor's degree in **Human Resources, Business Administration, Management, or a related field**.
* MBA/PGDM in HR will be an added advantage.
* **0–2 years of experience** in HR, recruitment, HR operations, or a related role.
* Freshers with relevant internship experience may also be considered.

Preferred Candidate

* Proactive and responsible approach toward work.
* Comfortable communicating with employees, candidates, and management.
* Willingness to learn and take ownership of HR activities.
* Ability to work effectively in a fast\-paced professional environment.

What We Offer

* Opportunity to gain hands\-on experience across multiple HR functions.
* Professional learning and career growth opportunities.
* Exposure to recruitment, HR operations, employee engagement, and compliance processes.
* Collaborative and professional work environment.

Pay: ₹25,000\.00 \- ₹29,166\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule
* Health insurance
* Leave encashment
* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person

title: Head HR & IR
description:
About Ginni International Limited
 



  





 Ginni International Ltd started its weaving journey way back in 1996 with a state\-of\-the\-art manufacturing unit at RIICO Industrial Area, Neemrana, Distt. Alwar, Rajasthan. Ginni International is an integrated textile company, engaged in the manufacturing of Cotton yarn, Greig and Denim fabric. It banks upon the core strength that lies in its unmatched quality, modern manufacturing technology, and commitment to customer satisfaction. The soul of denim at Ginni International is its people – tenacious, dynamic and wearing their passion on their sleeves.
 



  





**About the Position** 




  





**Designation:** 
 Head – HR \& IR
 



**Work Location** 
 : Neemrana, Rajasthan
 



**Reporting to** 
 : Plant Head
 



  





**Purpose of the role** 
 :
 



  





 The purpose of this role is to lead HR \& Industrial Relations at the plant, which has approximately 1000 blue\-collar workers and 200 white\-collar staff. Ensure smooth Industrial relations, manpower planning, statutory compliance, and stable productivity on the shop\-floor.
 



 .
 



**Core Responsibilities** 
 :
 



**Industrial \& Employee Relations** 



* Build and sustain constructive relationships with unions and worker representatives.
* Lead collective bargaining, wage settlements, and productivity\-linked agreements.
* Ensure a stable and disruption\-free IR climate with zero mandays lost.
* Manage grievance redressal, disciplinary cases, and conflict resolution in line with the applicable labor laws.



  





**Manpower Planning \& Workforce Management** 



* Drive worker hiring pipelines through ITIs, contractors, and multi\-state networks.
* Oversee recruitment, onboarding, and retention strategies for blue\- and white\-collar workforce.
* Control absenteeism, overtime, and discipline on the shop floor to sustain high productivity.
* Ensure balanced workforce cost through effective deployment and optimization.



  





**Compliance \& Statutory Management** 



* Ensure 100% compliance with Factories Act, CLRA, ID Act, ESI, PF, PoSH, and other applicable statutory norms.
* Liaise with government departments, factory inspectorate, labor authorities, and ensure timely filings.
* Conduct regular compliance audits and maintain error\-free statutory records.



  





**Worker Welfare \& Engagement** 



* Oversee and improve welfare facilities including hostel, canteen, medical, safety, and transportation.
* Implement worker safety initiatives in alignment with best practices in textile manufacturing.
* Design and run worker engagement, reward, and incentive schemes to reduce attrition.



  





**HR Systems \& Talent Development** 



* Implement HRIS, dashboards, and MIS for manpower cost, absenteeism, and productivity tracking.
* Develop supervisors, staff, and high\-potential talent through focused training programs.
* Strengthen performance management and recognition systems for staff employees.



  





**Qualification and Experience** 



* 12–18 years of progressive HR \& IR experience, with at least 5 years as HR/IR Head in a large/medium size textile unit (spinning/weaving/denim preferred).
* Proven expertise in union negotiations, wage settlements, and dispute resolution.
* Deep knowledge of Indian labor laws and contractor workforce management.
* Strong communication in Hindi; local dialect proficiency desirable.
* Hands\-on leader with shop\-floor presence and problem\-solving orientation.



  





**Key competencies** 



* Strategic IR management \& conflict resolution.
* Workforce planning \& productivity orientation.
* Stakeholder influence (workers, management, authorities).
* Discipline, integrity, and resilience under pressure.
* Data\-driven HR systems \& compliance focus



  





**Success measure** 



* Zero mandays lost and stable IR climate at the factory
* Reduction in absenteeism, attrition, and overtime.
* Faster hiring turnaround and healthy position occupancy
* 100% statutory compliance.
* Productivity improvement through engagement and incentive schemes
* Effective cost management in HR \& IR budgets

 You will partner with the External Services pillar, a growth\-critical business function focused on go\-to\-market execution, practice building, new health system onboarding, governance, and delivery excellence. title: HR Generalist
description:
Bengaluru, India  


**About Us**
------------


Ushur delivers the world's first Customer Experience Automation platform built specifically for regulated industries. With guardrails and compliance\-ready infrastructure, Ushur powers vertical AI Agents for healthcare, financial services and insurance.


Founded in 2014 and headquartered in Santa Clara, California, Ushur is backed by Third Point Ventures, Tiger Global, 8VC, Iron Pillar, Aflac Ventures and Pentland Ventures, with a sizeable Fortune 500 customer base. Our Bengaluru office is one of two principal locations and is central to how the company is built and run.


We build AI agents for regulated enterprises, and we run our own operations the same way.


About Ushur l Ushur Platform


**Title:** HR Generalist
  

**Experience:** 2–3 years
  

**Location:** Bengaluru
  

**Work Mode:** Hybrid
  

**Reports to:** Director, People Operations


**About the Role**
------------------


The HR Generalist sits within Ushur's global Operations team — finance, accounting, legal, revenue operations, enablement and HR. The role supports the People function globally, with most day\-to\-day focus on India operations, spanning payroll and statutory administration, benefits, the employee lifecycle, compliance, recruitment and engagement.


You work directly with Operations colleagues in India and the US as a peer on one global team, with shared ownership of company\-wide processes.


Alongside the operational core, the role carries the People function's automation work — identifying where AI can take on repetitive tasks across hiring, onboarding and reporting, and supporting new ways of working as they are adopted across the India team. Ushur is becoming an AI\-native company, and this is where that shows up in People processes.


Operational accuracy comes first: payroll correct and filings on time. The Director, People Operations reviews work carrying statutory or financial risk, with independent ownership building through the first few cycles.


Three things distinguish this role. You work across the whole India People function rather than a slice of it, at a point when most people are still administering parts of it. You work on a question few practitioners at any level get near: how AI is used responsibly in decisions about people, in a business built for regulated industries. And you sit in a global Operations function, not a local support desk.


**AI\-Native Operations**
-------------------------


Automation is core to the Operations team's mandate, and the standard is straightforward: where a process can be run by a workflow, it should be, and a person's time should go to the parts requiring judgment. Dedicated time is allocated to this, with access to Ushur's own platform. In practice, that means:


* Finding repetitive tasks in People processes and automating them.
* Using AI to help with screening, scheduling, checks and reporting — with a person always making the final call on anything that affects an individual.
* Helping new joiners get comfortable with these tools from the start.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------


### **Payroll and statutory compliance**


* Run the monthly India payroll cycle — inputs, validation, and post\-payroll reconciliation — working with Finance and Director, People Operations.
* Prepare termination pay inputs and full and final settlements, including notice, leave encashment and recovery calculations, for review before release.
* Support periodic salary structure and labour code updates led by the Director, People Operations.
* Support statutory compliance across PF, EPFO, NPS and professional tax, and act as the first point of contact for employee queries on tax regimes, declarations and payslips.
* Maintain accurate employee records, leave data and reporting in the HRIS.

### **Benefits and vendor management**


* Administer the India benefits programme, including group medical insurance, OPD, meal cards and wellness initiatives.
* Manage benefits vendors: onboarding and offboarding of employees, claims escalations, invoice processing with Finance, quarterly reviews and annual renewals.
* Gather market and cost data to support annual renewals and vendor evaluations.

### **Employee lifecycle**


* Run onboarding end\-to\-end: pre\-joining documentation, HRIS workflows, induction, systems and access coordination with IT, and 30\-60\-90 plans.
* Run offboarding end\-to\-end: exit formalities, relieving and experience letters, asset and access recovery, benefits removal, final settlement coordination, and exit conversations.
* Issue employment letters and respond to employment and background verification requests.
* Administer the HRIS and improve the workflows within it.

### **Talent acquisition**


* Conduct first\-level screening for candidates against structured rubrics and present evidence\-based recommendations.
* Coordinate interview loops across India and US time zones, and keep candidates informed throughout.
* Administer and improve the applicant tracking system, and maintain hiring data and reporting.

### **Compliance, policy and documentation**


* Provide administrative support to the POSH Internal Committee, including the statutory training cadence, record\-keeping and awareness communication.
* Maintain the India People folder set as the single source of truth for the function.
* Support internal and external audits by preparing documentation and responding to information requests.

### **Employee experience and engagement**


* Translate engagement survey findings into practical actions and track them through to closure.
* Run recognition programmes, milestone celebrations and engagement initiatives for the India office.
* Support all\-hands and internal communication for the India team.
* Partner with workplace and administration colleagues on office operations, and administer operational programmes such as the on\-call roster.

**Qualifications**
------------------


### **Essential**


* Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration or a related field.
* 2–3 years' experience in Human Resources, with broad exposure across its core functions.
* Experience supporting an employee population of comparable size, approximately 100 to 200, preferably within a startup or scale\-up environment.
* Demonstrated experience running payroll inputs, onboarding, compliance administration and employee query resolution with limited supervision.
* Exposure to recruitment, including interview coordination, candidate communication and applicant tracking system use.
* Familiarity with and enthusiasm for using AI tools to improve efficiency.
* Strong analytical skills, with the ability to organise and interpret significant volumes of information accurately.
* Working knowledge of Indian employment law and payroll practices.

### **Attributes**


* Receptive to feedback and able to act on it promptly.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills across employees, candidates, leadership and external partners.
* Ownership\-minded, with a track record of taking tasks through to closure and escalating issues early.
* Adaptable and able to re\-prioritise at pace without compromising accuracy.
* Comfortable working with limited supervision, having run core HR processes directly rather than only in a support capacity.
* Interested in AI and automation, with practical use of AI tools to simplify repetitive work.

**Selection Criteria**
----------------------


* Established use of AI tools in your daily work, with examples of what you have built. Informal work is fine; demonstrated application is required.
* A track record of identifying repetitive work and addressing it.
* The ability to explain the purpose of a process before proposing changes to it.
* A considered view on where AI should not be applied, and the reasoning behind it.

**Why Join Us?**
----------------


* **Company culture.** A values\-driven environment built on respect, inclusion, and collaboration.
* **Paid time off.** Twenty days of flexible paid time off annually.
* **Health benefits.** Preventive check\-ups, medical insurance for employees and dependents, wellness sessions, and health talks.
* **Compensation and equity.** Competitive compensation and stock options — a direct stake in Ushur's success.
* **Professional development.** Reimbursed certifications, plus the Ushur Community's learning resources.

Information Security \- Security Operations Center (SOC). The SOC is the front line of Sagility’s cyber\-defense, providing 24x7 monitoring, detection, triage, incident response and threat analysis across all operating geographies (India, Philippines, Jamaica, Colombia and the USA).


**Job Role**


A hands\-on Security Operations resource responsible for monitoring, analyzing and responding to security events and incidents, spanning **Tier 1 (monitoring \& triage)** and **Tier 2 (investigation \& response)** activities. Key focus areas:


* Daily events log analysis and security alerts/alarm handling from the SIEM.
* Monitor and analyze IPS threat feeds, endpoints, network, cloud and email for indicators of compromise.
* Triage, investigate and drive incidents to closure with zero misses and 100% SLA adherence.
* Conduct forensic triage and support vulnerability assessment closure.

**Shift**


Rotational shifts, including night shifts, to support 24x7 SOC coverage


**Location**


India (Bangalore preferred) \- supporting Sagility’s SOC operations globally

Responsibilities grow in depth and autonomy from Tier 1\. Common duties apply for the Tier 1 sections define clear demarcation.


* Protect the organization’s assets by upholding the principles of the Quality Information Security Management System (QISMS).
* Ensure confidentiality, integrity and availability of information, that is critical to Sagility’s business functions and client commitments.
* Report information\-security incidents, losses, weaknesses and malfunctions to the right authority without any delay.
* Participate in training, orientation and awareness programs pertaining to QISMS and SOC processes.

**Tier 1 (Level 1\) \- Monitoring \& Triage Focus**

* Perform daily events log analysis and monitor security alerts/alarms from the SIEM.
* Monitor closure of Critical Events and Security Alerts and notify concerned groups \- targeting zero misses and 100% SLA.
* Perform daily and monthly review and analysis of IPS (e.g., Cisco Firepower) threat feeds and flag notable/reported threats and possible intrusions.
* Prepare and analyze daily monitoring reports for Sagility sites, servers and network devices (100% compliance).
* Create ad\-hoc analysis of unusual events and user activities, or upon request by concerned groups or departments.
* Escalate validated incidents to Tier 2 with complete context per defined runbooks and SLAs.

**Qualifications**


* Graduate of a 4 to 5\-year course \- Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering or any IT\-related course.
* A strong internal drive for pursuing continuous learning and improvement.

**Tier 1 Analyst**

* 2 to 5 years of experience in a SOC, NOC, IT security or related monitoring function (freshers with relevant internships / certifications considered).
* Basic understanding of security monitoring, SIEM concepts, and incident\-handling fundamentals.
* **Certification (any one, preferred):** CompTIA Security\+, ISC2 Certified in Cybersecurity (CC), any SOC Analyst certificate, any Cisco security certificate, Microsoft SC\-900\.

**Tools / Applications**

* SIEM platforms, IPS/IDS (e.g., Cisco Firepower), EDR, vulnerability scanners, email\-security and cloud\-security tooling; MS Office, Visio and ticketing systems.

BangaloreIndia

 Company: Medinex Workforce

 Medinex Workforce is offering a Machine Learning Internship for freshers and entry\-level candidates who want to gain practical experience in preparing datasets, developing machine learning models, evaluating results, and understanding applied AI workflows.
