title: IT Infrastructure Engineer Intern
description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**
===================

**Infrastructure Engineer Intern**
----------------------------------

**Location:** Bangalore – Brookfield**Department:** IT Infrastructure / Technology**Employment Type:** Internship – Full\-Time**Working Hours:** 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM**Working Days:** Monday to Saturday (Alternate Saturdays Off)**Experience:** Fresher / Recent Graduate / Intern### **About the Role**


We are looking for a motivated and technically strong **Infrastructure Engineer Intern** to join our IT Infrastructure and Technology team.
The candidate will receive hands\-on exposure to:  

* Server administration
* Virtualization
* Networking
* Endpoint support
* Operating systems
* Monitoring
* Cybersecurity
* Backups
* Databases
* Application platforms
* Infrastructure operations


The candidate must also have a **basic understanding of Frontend, Backend, and Full\-Stack development**, as the role involves supporting the infrastructure on which business applications and software platforms operate.
The ideal candidate should be interested in building a career in:  

* Infrastructure Engineering
* System Administration
* Network Administration
* DevOps
* Cloud Infrastructure
* IT Operations

**Key Responsibilities**
========================

**1\. Infrastructure Management**
---------------------------------

* Assist in deploying, configuring, and maintaining on\-premises physical servers.
* Support environments consisting of multiple physical servers and virtual machines.
* Assist in managing servers deployed at client locations.
* Support virtualization environments and VM lifecycle management.
* Assist with VM creation, configuration, maintenance, backup, and decommissioning.
* Assist with IP allocation and network configuration.
* Maintain infrastructure documentation and configuration records.
* Support infrastructure capacity and resource monitoring.

**2\. Server Management**
-------------------------

* Assist in administering Linux, Windows, and macOS environments.
* Gain exposure to Dell and HP physical servers.
* Monitor server health and system performance.
* Assist in troubleshooting CPU, memory, storage, and performance issues.
* Monitor server availability and application services.
* Assist with database server and application platform administration.
* Perform basic server maintenance under supervision.
* Assist with patching, updates, and routine infrastructure activities.

**3\. End\-User Device \& Desktop Support**
-------------------------------------------

* Provide first\-level technical support for laptops, desktops, printers, and peripherals.
* Diagnose and resolve basic hardware and software issues.
* Troubleshoot driver and peripheral connectivity problems.
* Install and configure operating systems and applications.
* Prepare, image, and configure laptops/desktops for new employees.
* Support employee onboarding and IT setup.
* Maintain proper records of assigned IT equipment.

**4\. Operating System Administration**
---------------------------------------


Assist with installation, configuration, maintenance, and troubleshooting of:  

* Windows
* Ubuntu/Linux
* macOS

**Responsibilities include:**  

* OS installation and configuration.
* Software and application installation.
* Driver troubleshooting.
* OS updates and patching.
* Boot and startup troubleshooting.
* Performance troubleshooting.
* Application compatibility troubleshooting.
* Basic system security configuration.

**5\. Network Infrastructure Management**
-----------------------------------------

* Assist in configuring and troubleshooting network switches.
* Support routers and wireless access points.
* Troubleshoot LAN and Wi\-Fi connectivity.
* Assist with IP addressing and network configuration.
* Understand basic VLAN and network segmentation concepts.
* Assist with firewall configuration and monitoring.
* Monitor firewall logs and identify unusual traffic.
* Assist with VPN configuration and remote connectivity.
* Support secure external access.
* Assist with periodic firewall rule reviews.
* Learn basic network performance optimization.
* Troubleshoot connectivity, latency, and network performance issues.

**6\. Endpoint Security \& Antivirus Management**
-------------------------------------------------

* Assist in deploying and managing Seqrite Antivirus and Endpoint Security.
* Monitor endpoint security status.
* Monitor malware and virus alerts.
* Assist with quarantine and security incident handling.
* Ensure endpoint definitions and security policies remain updated.
* Assist with endpoint security agent installation.
* Troubleshoot antivirus agent connectivity and installation issues.
* Maintain basic endpoint security documentation.

**7\. Infrastructure Monitoring**
---------------------------------


Assist in administering and maintaining:  

* Zabbix
* Uptime Monitoring
* Grafana
* SigNoz

**Responsibilities include:**  

* Monitor server availability.
* Monitor VM availability.
* Track CPU utilization.
* Track memory utilization.
* Monitor disk and storage utilization.
* Monitor application and service availability.
* Review alerts and logs.
* Assist in troubleshooting infrastructure alerts.
* Maintain monitoring dashboards.
* Support proactive infrastructure monitoring.

**8\. CCTV Infrastructure Support**
-----------------------------------

* Monitor CCTV system health and uptime.
* Ensure network connectivity to CCTV cameras.
* Troubleshoot basic camera connectivity issues.
* Monitor video feed availability.
* Assist with CCTV hardware and software troubleshooting.
* Monitor CCTV storage.
* Assist with surveillance footage archiving.
* Ensure required retention policies are followed.

**9\. Backup \& Storage Management**
------------------------------------

* Assist in maintaining backup infrastructure.
* Monitor scheduled backups.
* Verify successful completion of backups.
* Identify and report backup failures.
* Assist with database and server backup activities.
* Perform basic backup validation.
* Assist with restoration testing.
* Maintain backup documentation.
* Gain practical exposure to disaster recovery concepts.

**10\. IT Asset Management**
----------------------------

* Maintain hardware and software inventory.
* Track laptops, desktops, servers, monitors, printers, and networking equipment.
* Maintain asset allocation records.
* Track asset lifecycle and replacement requirements.
* Assist with procurement activities.
* Maintain infrastructure and asset documentation.
* Ensure proper handover and return of IT assets.

**11\. Core Platform Services**
-------------------------------

* Gain practical exposure to LDAP and directory services.
* Assist with basic identity and access management.
* Support user and system access activities under supervision.
* Maintain infrastructure room and server room documentation.
* Assist with physical infrastructure inspections.
* Maintain proper organization of network and server equipment.
* Follow infrastructure security and operational procedures.

**12\. Frontend Development Knowledge – MANDATORY**
===================================================


The candidate must have basic knowledge of **Frontend development**.### **Required Understanding**

* HTML
* CSS
* JavaScript
* Basic frontend application architecture.
* Basic understanding of browser and client\-server communication.
* Understanding of frontend build and deployment concepts.
* Basic understanding of API integration.
* Basic troubleshooting of frontend application issues.

### **Preferred**

* React
* Angular
* Vue.js
* npm
* Frontend build tools


The candidate should understand how a frontend application is hosted, deployed, accessed, and connected to backend services.**13\. Backend Development Knowledge – MANDATORY**
==================================================


The candidate must have basic knowledge of **Backend development**.### **Required Understanding**

* Basic backend application architecture.
* REST APIs.
* HTTP/HTTPS.
* API requests and responses.
* Authentication and authorization concepts.
* Application\-server communication.
* Basic backend troubleshooting.
* Basic database connectivity.

### **Backend Technologies**


Candidate should have exposure to at least one backend technology/language such as:  

* Java
* Python
* Node.js
* PHP
* .NET


The candidate should be able to understand how backend applications run on servers and communicate with databases and frontend applications.**14\. Full\-Stack Development Knowledge – MANDATORY**
======================================================


The candidate must have a basic understanding of **Full\-Stack application architecture**.
The candidate should understand the relationship between:**Frontend API/Backend Database Backend Frontend**### **Basic Knowledge Should Include**

* Frontend application structure.
* Backend/API structure.
* Database interaction.
* REST APIs.
* Application deployment.
* Server\-side application hosting.
* Basic application troubleshooting.
* Basic understanding of logs and application errors.
* Basic understanding of application\-server communication.


The candidate is **not required to be an expert Full\-Stack Developer**, but must understand how a complete application works across frontend, backend, database, server, and network layers.**15\. Database Knowledge – MANDATORY**
=======================================

* Basic understanding of databases.
* Basic SQL knowledge.
* Understanding of tables, records, and queries.
* Basic knowledge of relational databases.
* Understanding of application\-to\-database connectivity.
* Basic database troubleshooting.

### **Preferred Database Exposure**

* MySQL
* PostgreSQL
* SQL Server
* Similar databases

**16\. DevOps \& Development Tools**
====================================


Basic exposure to the following will be an advantage:  

* Git
* GitHub/GitLab
* Docker
* CI/CD concepts
* Build and deployment processes
* Shell scripting
* Python scripting
* Linux command line
* Application logs
* Environment variables
* Basic cloud concepts

**Mandatory Technical Skills**
==============================


The candidate must have basic knowledge or academic/project exposure to:### **Infrastructure**

* Infrastructure
* Linux/Ubuntu
* Windows
* Computer hardware
* Servers
* Virtual machines

### **Networking**

* Networking fundamentals
* TCP/IP
* DNS
* DHCP
* LAN/Wi\-Fi
* Routers and switches
* Basic firewall concepts

### **Development**

* **Frontend – Mandatory**
* **Backend – Mandatory**
* **Full\-Stack concepts – Mandatory**
* **Database/SQL – Mandatory**
* REST APIs
* HTTP/HTTPS
* Basic application architecture

### **Security \& Monitoring**

* Basic cybersecurity concepts
* Antivirus/Endpoint Security
* System monitoring
* Logs and troubleshooting

**Preferred Technical Exposure**
================================


Candidates having exposure to the following will be preferred:  

* Zabbix
* Grafana
* SigNoz
* Uptime Monitoring
* Docker
* Git/GitHub
* CI/CD
* Shell scripting
* Python
* LDAP
* Active Directory
* VPN
* Firewall administration
* Cloud platforms
* Database administration
* Backup and disaster recovery

**Educational Qualification**
=============================

* B.E./B.Tech in Computer Science, Information Technology, Electronics, or related field.
* BCA / MCA or equivalent IT qualification.
* Freshers and recent graduates are welcome.
* Candidates with academic projects in Infrastructure, Networking, DevOps, Full\-Stack Development, or System Administration are preferred.

**Candidate Profile**
=====================


We are looking for someone who:  

* Has a strong interest in IT Infrastructure and Technology.
* Has basic knowledge of both Infrastructure and Software Development.
* Is comfortable working with Linux and Windows.
* Understands basic networking concepts.
* Has basic Frontend, Backend, and Full\-Stack knowledge.
* Has good troubleshooting and analytical skills.
* Is willing to work hands\-on with servers, networks, systems, and applications.
* Can learn new technologies quickly.
* Has good communication and teamwork skills.
* Is willing to work in an onsite infrastructure environment.

**Key Learning Opportunities**
==============================


During the internship, the candidate will gain practical exposure to:  

* Server administration
* Linux administration
* Windows administration
* Virtualization
* Networking
* Firewalls and VPN
* Endpoint security
* Zabbix and Grafana monitoring
* Application monitoring
* Database environments
* Backup and disaster recovery
* CCTV infrastructure
* IT asset management
* LDAP
* Frontend applications
* Backend applications
* Full\-Stack architecture
* APIs
* Application deployment
* DevOps fundamentals
* Infrastructure troubleshooting

**Career Path**
===============


This internship can provide a foundation for careers in:  

* Infrastructure Engineer
* System Administrator
* Network Engineer
* DevOps Engineer
* Cloud Engineer
* IT Operations Engineer
* Site Reliability Engineer (SRE)
* Application Support Engineer
* Full\-Stack Infrastructure/Platform Engineer

**Internship\-to\-Hire**
========================


Based on **performance, technical skills, learning ability, discipline, and organizational requirements**, the successful intern may be considered for a **full\-time employment opportunity after completion of the internship**.**Important Requirement**
=========================


Candidates with only basic desktop\-support knowledge and no understanding of **Frontend, Backend, Full\-Stack, APIs, and databases** will not be considered suitable for this position.
The role requires a combination of:**Infrastructure \+ Networking \+ Systems \+ Application \+ Development knowledge.**

 Join EY and help build a better working world.

 At EY, we’ll develop you with future\-focused skills and equip you with world\-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams.

title: Security Analyst
description:
**This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Security Analyst based in India.**
 This role is an opportunity to strengthen security operations within a globally distributed, 24/7 environment protecting large\-scale digital platforms and their users.
   

  

 You will monitor, investigate, and respond to security events across cloud infrastructure, applications, endpoints, identities, and other critical systems.
   

  

 The position combines hands\-on incident response, detection engineering, threat intelligence, vulnerability management, and security automation.
   

  

 You will work closely with security, engineering, infrastructure, product, privacy, legal, and compliance teams during complex investigations.
   

  

 As you develop in the role, you will take greater ownership of incidents, operational improvements, and specialized areas such as cloud security or threat hunting.
   

  

 You will also contribute to improving SIEM/SOAR capabilities, playbooks, automation, documentation, and overall monitoring coverage.
   

  

 This is a strong opportunity for a security professional ready to take on more complex responsibilities while developing deeper expertise in modern cloud and security operations.
   

  

 Accountabilities
   

  

* Monitor, analyze, and interpret security, system, application, cloud, and infrastructure logs to identify suspicious activity, configuration issues, and potential security incidents.
* Use SIEM platforms, security dashboards, threat intelligence, and proactive investigation techniques to identify anomalous or malicious activity.
* Monitor cloud infrastructure and services for security events, misconfigurations, indicators of compromise, and emerging risks.
* Track relevant security advisories, vulnerabilities, attack techniques, and changes in the threat landscape, escalating findings as appropriate.
* Investigate security alerts, incidents, and service requests through structured triage, analysis, documentation, escalation, and follow\-up.
* Develop, maintain, tune, and improve detection use cases and alerts across SIEM and other security monitoring platforms.
* Design, implement, and maintain security automation workflows using SOAR or comparable orchestration technologies.
* Investigate and coordinate security incidents across technical and non\-technical teams, taking ownership from initial triage through containment, remediation, recovery, and closure when required.
* Act as an Incident Commander or Incident Coordinator for appropriate security incidents, establishing ownership, priorities, dependencies, and follow\-up actions.
* Maintain accurate incident timelines and provide clear, timely status updates to stakeholders and security leadership.
* Participate in major incident calls, supporting evidence collection, investigation, timeline development, incident summaries, and post\-incident reviews.
* Collaborate with Product Security, Infrastructure Security, Application Security, GRC, Engineering, Privacy, Legal, and other relevant teams during investigations.
* Provide technical findings and evidence during security or privacy\-related incidents and investigations.
* Create, maintain, and continuously improve SOPs, security playbooks, runbooks, detection use cases, and knowledge\-base documentation.
* Support audit activities by gathering security evidence, validating controls, and coordinating with relevant stakeholders.
* Contribute to vulnerability assessment, prioritization, and remediation activities using appropriate security platforms.
* Support proof\-of\-concept initiatives, security tool evaluations, process improvements, and operational enhancement projects.
* Use scripting and automation to improve security investigations, monitoring, and operational efficiency.
* Take ownership of assigned responsibilities during each shift, ensuring timely escalation, effective handovers, and appropriate follow\-through.
* Proactively identify and escalate risks, incidents, blockers, and operational concerns.
* Continuously develop security expertise and contribute to improvements in detection quality, response speed, monitoring coverage, automation, and team knowledge.
* Build a specialization aligned with team and business needs, such as cloud security monitoring, detection engineering, threat intelligence, or another relevant security discipline.


**Requirements**
* 3–5 years of hands\-on experience in a 24/7 Security Operations Center, Cyber Fusion Center, or equivalent security operations environment.
* Experience in one or more areas such as SaaS security, cloud security, API or container security, threat intelligence, threat hunting, vulnerability management, SIEM, or SOAR operations.
* Strong practical experience using SIEM platforms for security monitoring, investigation, correlation, and detection engineering; Splunk experience is preferred.
* Hands\-on experience with SOAR platforms and security automation workflows.
* Experience with Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR) technologies and related capabilities such as threat intelligence, exposure management, device control, or data protection.
* Experience with CSPM/CNAPP platforms such as Wiz, CrowdStrike Falcon Cloud Security, Prisma Cloud, Microsoft Defender for Cloud, Sysdig, or equivalent.
* Experience assessing, prioritizing, and managing vulnerabilities using tools such as CrowdStrike Exposure Management/Spotlight, Qualys, Rapid7, Wiz, or equivalent.
* Practical experience with AWS or GCP is mandatory, including knowledge of cloud identity, logging, networking, compute, storage, and security controls.
* Basic scripting ability in Python, Bash, PowerShell, or an equivalent language for security operations, investigation, or automation.
* Strong understanding of the cybersecurity incident lifecycle, from identification and triage through containment, remediation, recovery, and post\-incident activities.
* Demonstrated ability to investigate and coordinate incidents across technical and non\-technical teams.
* Previous experience acting as an Incident Coordinator, Incident Commander, or security incident lead is highly desirable.
* Good understanding of cybersecurity risk concepts, security frameworks, threat landscapes, vulnerabilities, and potential technical and business impacts.
* Strong ability to correlate information across logs, cloud platforms, endpoints, identity systems, applications, threat intelligence, and other security data sources.
* Understanding of authentication and credential\-management concepts, including public/private key authentication, API keys, access tokens, service accounts, and secure credential handling.
* Comfortable working with command\-line interfaces, APIs, IDE\-based tools, and modern security and cloud engineering workflows.
* Working knowledge of AI and LLM tools such as ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, or equivalent, including their practical and secure use within Security Operations.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving abilities, with the independence to investigate moderately complex events and the judgment to escalate higher\-risk or unfamiliar situations.
* Excellent attention to detail and ability to connect findings across multiple technical data sources.
* Strong written and verbal English communication skills, with the ability to communicate technical findings, risks, incident status, and required actions to both technical and non\-technical audiences.
* Comfortable communicating during active security incidents and major incident calls.
* Experience collaborating within globally distributed teams across functions, cultures, regions, and time zones.
* Strong team\-oriented approach and ability to work effectively with security, engineering, infrastructure, product, GRC, privacy, legal, and business stakeholders.
* Willingness and ability to work a 24/7 monthly rotating shift schedule, including weekends, with a five\-day working week.
* Ability to independently own shift responsibilities, manage active incidents when required, and provide effective handovers.
* Entry\-level or intermediate cybersecurity certifications such as CompTIA Security\+, CySA\+, GIAC GSEC, cloud security certifications, or equivalent credentials are preferred.
* Experience in SaaS, e\-commerce, cloud\-native, or technology environments is an advantage.


**Benefits**
* Remote work opportunity from India, with access to a local office environment where applicable.
* Flexible working hours and a virtual\-first approach.
* High degree of autonomy, trust, and ownership in day\-to\-day work.
* Opportunities for continuous learning and professional development.
* Annual professional education budget of $1,500 for eligible employees, supporting courses, certifications, books, and other learning resources.
* Personal development workshops and structured development programs.

title: Information Security Engineer
description:
The Information Security team at IMC Trading is responsible for protecting IMC's intellectual property, IT infrastructure and business operations against external and internal threats. We work closely with technology, risk, compliance, internal audit and business leaders to reduce cyber risk to acceptable levels.
   

  

 We are looking for an Information Security Engineer to help grow and mature our Security Operations Centre, which runs on EDR, SIEM, SOAR, CSPM, IAM, firewalls, NIDS/NIPS and a range of other security controls. Alongside SOC work, you will play a central role in supporting IMC's regulatory obligations in India, preparing evidence and coordinating the cyber and systems audits that come with operating in this market.
   

  

 We offer an environment that lets you broaden and deepen your information security knowledge, with access to advanced security technology, frequent training and a culture of knowledge sharing. As you gain experience with our existing SOC technology and processes, you will be given considerable freedom to mature the function through your own initiatives.
   

  

**Your Core Responsibilities**
* Analyse security logs, alerts and reported events, and respond to or assist with the remediation of incidents.
* Hunt for potential compromise across the infrastructure using a range of threat intelligence sources.
* Report discovered vulnerabilities to technology owners and recommend remediation steps.
* Support and improve technical security controls.
* Leverage automation and orchestration to remove repetitive manual work.
* Apply AI\-assisted tooling to alert triage, event summarisation and investigation workflows, with a pragmatic view of its limitations.
* Develop reporting that measures the effectiveness of security controls.
* Develop and improve incident response playbooks.
* Support regulatory and assurance audits: prepare evidence, coordinate with auditors and track observations through to closure.


**Your Skills And Experience**
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* A self\-starter with a genuine passion for cybersecurity.
* Previous SOC experience, and/or 3\+ years of hands\-on experience in an enterprise IT environment managing endpoints and applications on\-premises or in the cloud.
* Exposure to security controls such as identity and access management, vulnerability management, and endpoint detection and response.
* Working knowledge of — or a strong willingness to learn — the Indian regulatory cybersecurity landscape: SEBI CSCRF, exchange circulars (NSE/BSE/MCX) and CERT\-In directions, along with familiarity with ISO 27001 and the NIST CSF on which CSCRF is modelled.
* Experience supporting audits (cyber audit, systems audit, VAPT, ISO or SOC 2 assessments) — evidence preparation, auditor coordination and observation remediation — is a strong plus.
* Automation using basic coding skills or low\-code / no\-code tools.
* Awareness of AI and machine learning applications in security operations is a plus; hands\-on experience with AI\-assisted security tooling or LLM\-based workflows is highly regarded.
* Understanding of common attack techniques and frameworks such as MITRE ATT\&CK.
* Strong documentation and communication skills, with the ability to translate technical findings into audit\-ready evidence and regulator\-facing reports.
* Relevant tertiary and/or security qualifications are a plus — for example a Bachelor's degree in information systems or computer science, CompTIA Security\+, Certified in Cybersecurity (CC), CEH, or ISO 27001 Lead Auditor / Lead Implementer. If you don't have them yet, you will be supported to pursue certifications on the job.


**About Us**
*IMC is a research\-driven trading firm where quantitative modeling, machine learning, and engineering shape how modern markets are traded. A stabilizing force in markets since 1989, we provide liquidity across trading venues, delivering the best outcome in value and risk management to investors. Using our own technology and capital, we build proprietary systems and algorithms that operate across global markets. title: Penetration Testing Analyst
description:
**About Us**
 Sophos is a cybersecurity leader defending 600,000 organizations globally with an AI\-driven platform and expert\-led services. Sophos meets organizations wherever they are in their security maturity and grows with them to defeat cyberattacks. Its solutions combine machine learning, automation, and real\-time threat intelligence with frontline human expertise from Sophos X\-Ops to deliver advanced, 24/7 threat monitoring, detection, and response.
   

  

 Sophos offers industry\-leading managed detection and response (MDR) alongside a comprehensive portfolio of cybersecurity technologies — including endpoint, network, email, and cloud security, extended detection and response (XDR), identity threat detection and response (ITDR), and next\-gen SIEM. Together with expert advisory services, these capabilities help organizations proactively reduce risk and respond faster, with the visibility and scalability needed to stay ahead of evolving threats.
   

  

 Sophos goes to market with a global partner ecosystem, including Managed Service Providers (MSPs), Managed Security Service Providers (MSSPs), resellers and distributors, marketplace integrations, and cyber risk partners, giving organizations the flexibility to choose trusted relationships when securing their business. Sophos is headquartered in Oxford, U.K. More information is available at www.sophos.com .
   

  

****Role Summary****
 Sophos is seeking an experienced and motivated Penetration Testing Analyst 3 to join our Red Team. The Sophos Red Team is engaged by organizations worldwide to identify and exploit vulnerabilities within client environments, applying information security threat intelligence to uncover the same weaknesses real\-world adversaries would target.
   

  

 As a Penetration Testing Analyst 3, you will act as the point of contact for testing readiness, coordinating tasks, timelines, and communication between business, client, and project teams. Responsible for escalating issues to management and taking ownership of new challenges to add value. In addition to test readiness support, the position will focus on either application security (web application penetration testing, mobile, API testing) or network security (vulnerability assessments, external penetration tests, internal penetration tests, etc.), using both off\-the\-shelf and internally developed tools to execute manual testing for advanced attacks. Candidates are not expected to be experienced in both focus areas, although that would be a plus.
   

  

 In this role, you will be responsible for test readiness activities to ensure engagements are ready to begin by troubleshooting client readiness problems, communicating with clients and tracking readiness status, and producing professional security assessment reports detailing vulnerability and exploit information for clients. This position will lead client\-facing calls throughout each engagement, from test readiness and troubleshooting, project kick\-off through notification of high and critical findings to a close\-out review of test findings, evidence, process steps to reproduce, and remediation recommendations.
   

  

 The ideal candidate for this role will bring strong technical communication skills, sound analytical and problem\-solving abilities, and a proactive approach to researching new threats, vulnerabilities, and exploits.
   

  

 You will excel as both a self\-directed individual contributor and as a member of a larger team, performing other essential duties as assigned.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
* This is a remote position with potential travel up to 10%
* Coordinate activities, documentation, readiness schedules, and information between business, clients, and project teams.
* Act as the point of contact and communicate testing readiness status adequately to all participants
* Use project management tools to monitor key tasks, responsible parties, timelines, and status
* Report and escalate issues to management as needed
* Take ownership for accomplishing new and different requests; exploring opportunities to add value to job accomplishments.
* Conduct application security assessments (web, mobile, API, etc.) using off\-the\-shelf or internally developed exploitation tools to execute manual testing for advanced attacks OR network penetration testing assessments (external pen test, internal pen test, etc.)
* Produce and deliver vulnerability and exploit information to clients in the form of a professional security assessment report
* Conduct client conference calls, including but not limited to test readiness and troubleshooting calls, project kick\-off calls, notification of high/critical findings during the testing process, and close\-out calls to review test findings, evidence, process steps to reproduce, and remediation recommendations
* Perform proactive research to identify and understand new threats, vulnerabilities, and exploits
* Conduct exploitation testing using off\-the\-shelf or self\-developed exploitation tools and document findings for client remediation
* Excel as both a self\-directed individual contributor and as a member of a larger team
* Perform other essential duties as assigned


**What You Will Bring**
* 3\+ years of experience in Information Security
* Excellent client\-facing and internal communication skills, both written and verbal
* Demonstrate ability to learn quickly and thrive in high\-energy team environment
* Professional, “get it done" attitude, work ethic, and strong team player
* Solid organizational skills including attention to detail and multitasking skills
* Minimum of 3 year of experience with penetration testing
* Minimum of 3 years of experience with at least one of the following: Nmap, Metasploit, Kali Linux, Burp Suite
* Desirable:
* Experience with NMap Scanning
* Understanding of web application authentication methods
* Experience with Linux
* Understanding of networking and appliances (routers, load balancers, firewalls, WAF, IDS/IPS, web content filter/proxy)
* Understanding of tools to validate network access with a penetration testing platform
* Offensive certifications such as CEH, WAPT, GPEN, GWAPT, GAWN, OSCP, etc.
* Knowledge of operating systems administration and internals (Microsoft Windows / Linux)
* Understanding of TCP/IP networking at a technical level
* Experience with various application attack vectors, security test processes, and strong knowledge of common vulnerabilities (i.e. OWASP Top 10\)
* Good troubleshooting skills, technical communication skills, both written and verbal; good analytical and problem\-solving skills


 \#B1
   

  

**Ready to Join Us?**
 At Sophos, we believe in the power of diverse perspectives to fuel innovation. Research shows that candidates sometimes hesitate to apply if they don't check every box in a job description. We challenge that notion. Your unique experiences and skills might be exactly what we need to enhance our team. Don't let a checklist hold you back – we encourage you to apply.
   

  

**What's Great About Sophos?**
* Sophos operates a remote\-first working model, making remote work the primary option for most employees. However, some roles may necessitate a hybrid approach. While we are a remote first organization, applicants must have legal authorization to work in the jurisdiction where the position is posted, without requiring employer sponsorship.
* Our people – we innovate and create, all of which are accompanied by a great sense of fun and team spirit
* Employee\-led diversity and inclusion networks that build community and provide education and advocacy
* Annual charity and fundraising initiatives and volunteer days for employees to support local communities
* Global employee sustainability initiatives to reduce our environmental footprint
* Global fitness and trivia competitions to keep our bodies and minds sharp
* Global wellbeing days for employees to relax and recharge
* Monthly wellbeing webinars and training to support employee health and wellbeing


**Our Commitment To You**
 We’re proud of the diverse and inclusive environment we have at Sophos, and we’re committed to ensuring equality of opportunity. We believe that diversity, combined with excellence, builds a better Sophos, so we encourage applicants who can contribute to the diversity of our team. All applicants will be treated in a fair and equal manner and in accordance with the law regardless of gender, sex, gender reassignment, marital status, race, religion or belief, color, age, military veteran status, disability, pregnancy, maternity or sexual orientation. We want to give you every opportunity to show us your best self, so if there are any adjustments we could make to the recruitment and selection process to support you, please let us know.
   

  

**Data Protection**
 If you choose to explore an opportunity, and subsequently share your CV or other personal details with Sophos, these details will be held by Sophos for 12 months in accordance with our Privacy Policy and used by our recruitment team to contact you regarding this or other relevant opportunities at Sophos. If you would like Sophos to delete or update your details at any time, please follow the steps set out in the Privacy Policy describing your individual rights. For more information on Sophos’ data protection practices, please consult our Privacy Policy Cybersecurity as a Service Delivered \| Sophos
   

  

 We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

title: Senior Mobile & API Security / Penetration Testing Consultant
description:
Seeking an experienced Senior Mobile \& API Security / Penetration Testing Consultant with deep hands\-on expertise in advanced Android, iOS, API, and backend security testing.
 



  





**Responsibilities** 




 • Perform advanced manual penetration testing of Android and iOS applications.
 



 • Conduct API \& backend security testing, including IDOR/BOLA, authorization bypass, and privilege escalation.
 



 • Perform manual exploitation, vulnerability validation, and business\-logic testing.
 



 • Conduct mobile reverse engineering, runtime analysis, and tamper\-resistance testing.
 



 • Assess QR protocol and workflow security, including replay, manipulation, spoofing, substitution, and crafted payload attacks.
 



 • Test scanner trust boundaries and identify potential debug/test\-mode or workflow bypasses.
 



 • Assess cryptographic implementations and key\-management lifecycles.
 



 • Perform threat modeling, attack\-path analysis, and vulnerability chaining.
 



 • Validate security remediation and perform retesting.
 



 • Prepare professional penetration\-testing reports complete with Proof\-of\-Concepts (PoCs), impact analysis, and actionable remediation steps.
 



  





**Requirements** 




 • 8\+ years in cybersecurity with a focus on Mobile \& API Penetration Testing.
 



 • Hands\-on experience with advanced Android \& iOS security testing alongside API security testing (IDOR/BOLA, authentication, authorization).
 



 • Proficiency in mobile reverse engineering, runtime analysis, manual exploitation, and vulnerability chaining.
 



 • Practical expertise in QR protocol/security testing, fuzzing, applied cryptography, and key\-management lifecycle assessment.
 



 • Strong capabilities in threat modeling and business\-logic vulnerability identification.
 



 • Excellent technical writing skills with the ability to document PoCs, risk ratings, and detailed remediation guidance.
 



  





**Preferred Skills** 




 • Burp Suite, Frida, Objection, MobSF, JADX, Ghidra, ADB, Wireshark, or equivalent security\-testing tools.
 



 • OSCP, OSWE, OSED/OSCE, CREST, eWPTX, eMAPT, or equivalent certifications.

title: Cybersecurity Penetration Testing Expert
description:
**Cybersecurity Penetration Testing Expert (AI Security)**
**About The Role**
 What if your hacking skills could directly shape how safe and secure AI systems are for millions of users worldwide? We're looking for Cybersecurity Penetration Testing Experts to probe, attack, and stress\-test AI\-powered applications and infrastructure — identifying vulnerabilities before bad actors do.
   

  

 This is a fully remote, flexible contract role where your offensive security expertise meets the cutting edge of artificial intelligence. You'll work on high\-impact projects that directly improve the security posture of AI systems used at scale.
   

  

* Organization: Alignerr
* Type: Hourly Contract
* Location: Remote
* Commitment: 10–40 hours/week


**What You'll Do**
* Conduct penetration tests against AI\-powered applications, APIs, and infrastructure to uncover security vulnerabilities
* Identify and exploit weaknesses in AI/ML pipelines, including prompt injection, model manipulation, data poisoning vectors, and authentication flaws
* Perform web application, network, and API security assessments using industry\-standard tools and methodologies
* Simulate real\-world attack scenarios — from reconnaissance through exploitation and post\-exploitation
* Document findings in clear, structured reports with severity ratings, evidence, and actionable remediation guidance
* Evaluate AI\-specific attack surfaces including adversarial inputs, jailbreaks, and data exfiltration risks
* Stay current with emerging AI security threats and contribute insights to improve testing methodologies
* Work independently on task\-based engagements on your own schedule


**Who You Are**
* Experienced penetration tester with a strong understanding of offensive security principles and methodologies (OWASP, PTES, MITRE ATT\&CK)
* Proficient with industry\-standard tools such as Burp Suite, Metasploit, Nmap, Kali Linux, or equivalent
* Solid understanding of web application security, network security, and API security testing
* Able to think like an attacker — creative, persistent, and methodical in finding what others miss
* Strong written communication skills — you can translate complex technical findings into clear, actionable reports
* Self\-motivated and reliable when working independently without direct supervision
* Comfortable working across diverse technology stacks and environments


**Nice to Have**
* Relevant certifications such as OSCP, OSCE, CEH, GPEN, GXPN, or eWPT
* Experience with AI/ML security testing — adversarial machine learning, prompt injection, LLM red\-teaming
* Background in red teaming, bug bounty programs, or CTF competitions
* Familiarity with cloud security (AWS, GCP, Azure) and container security
* Programming or scripting skills in Python, Bash, PowerShell, or similar
* Knowledge of secure development practices and DevSecOps workflows
* Experience conducting security assessments in compliance\-driven environments (SOC 2, ISO 27001, etc.)


**Why Join Us**
* Work on cutting\-edge AI security projects alongside leading research labs
* Fully remote and flexible — work when and where it suits you
* Freelance autonomy with access to high\-impact, intellectually challenging engagements
* Be at the forefront of AI security — a rapidly growing field with massive demand
* Sharpen your skills against novel AI\-specific attack surfaces that few security professionals have encountered
* Contribute directly to making AI systems safer and more trustworthy for users worldwide
* Potential for ongoing work and contract extension as new projects launch

title: HR Operation Specialist
description:
**Join Our Journey at VuNet**
=============================


**VuNet** is a pioneer in *Business Journey Observability*, leveraging Big Data and Machine Learning to transform digital experiences across the financial services. Our deep\-tech platform provides end\-to\-end visibility into customer journeys — empowering proactive issue resolution, operational resilience, and superior user satisfaction.


If you’ve ever used instant payment systems like UPI, chances are you’ve already experienced the power of our platform — we monitor over *28 billion digital transactions monthly*(that’s equal to watching 3 years of tik\-tok videos)**,** *touching 300 million users* with leading banks and financial institutions*.*


VuNet is Series B funded, part of NASSCOM DeepTech Club, awarded NASSCOM’s AI Gamechanger, recognized in Forbes DGEMS 200 and by several global analysts including Gartner, Omdia.


We’re building a new category of observability purpose\-built for complex digital journeys — across payments, lending, core banking and more — already powering some of the largest banks in India and MEA.


**Your Role: HR Operation Specialist**
======================================

We are looking for an **HR Operations Specialist** to manage and execute day\-to\-day HR operations while ensuring a seamless employee experience, accurate HR data, statutory compliance, and timely delivery of HR processes.


The role will work closely with employees, managers, Finance, IT, Administration, vendors, and other stakeholders to ensure smooth execution of employee lifecycle processes. The ideal candidate should be detail\-oriented, process\-driven, responsive, and comfortable managing multiple HR operations simultaneously.


Are you excited to be a part of VuNet's trailblazing team? Join VuNet and make a difference


**Key Responsibilities**
========================


### **1\. Employee Lifecycle Operations**


* Manage end\-to\-end employee lifecycle processes including onboarding, employee documentation, transfers, confirmations, and exits.
* Ensure joining formalities, documentation, background verification, and HR system updates are completed within defined SLAs.
* Maintain accurate and updated employee master data and personnel records.
* Coordinate with IT and relevant stakeholders to ensure system and access readiness on the employee’s date of joining.
* Ensure timely completion of exit formalities, clearance, documentation, and HR\-related separation activities.

### **2\. Payroll \& Compensation Operations**


* Coordinate monthly payroll inputs and ensure accurate and timely submission within payroll cut\-off timelines.
* Validate attendance, leave, loss of pay, new joiner, exit, salary revision, and other payroll\-related inputs.
* Coordinate with Finance/payroll vendors to resolve payroll discrepancies and employee queries.
* Support compensation\-related activities including salary revisions, arrears, reimbursements, and other employee compensation processes.
* Maintain confidentiality and accuracy of payroll and compensation data.

### **3\. Statutory Compliance \& Risk Management**

* Support HR statutory compliance activities and ensure required records are maintained accurately.
* Coordinate compliance requirements related to **POSH, Form D, LWF**, and other applicable statutory requirements.
* Maintain statutory registers, records, declarations, and supporting documentation for audit readiness.
* Coordinate with external consultants/vendors for statutory compliance requirements and resolution of queries.
* Support internal and external HR audits and ensure timely closure of audit observations.

### **4\. HRIS, MIS \& Data Governance**

* Maintain accurate employee information in the HRIS/HRMS and ensure timely updates for employee movements and changes.
* Prepare and publish periodic HR MIS, dashboards, headcount reports, and management reports.
* Maintain HR trackers, employee records, MOMs, and operational reports with high accuracy.
* Ensure HR data confidentiality, access control, and appropriate handling of sensitive employee information.
* Support HRIS enhancements, system upgrades, testing, and implementation of new HR processes/modules. Identify data inconsistencies and ensure timely correction

### **5\. Employee Experience \& HR Service Delivery**

* Act as a point of contact for employees on HR operational queries related to policies, payroll, attendance, leave, benefits, HR processes, and documentation.
* Resolve employee queries within defined SLAs and maintain proper query tracking.
* Provide clear, accurate, and consistent guidance on HR policies and processes.
* Identify recurring employee concerns and recommend improvements to HR processes.
* Maintain a professional and service\-oriented approach while handling employee interactions.

### **6\. Employee Engagement**

* Support planning and execution of the annual/monthly employee engagement calendar.
* Conduct new\-joiner pulse checks and coordinate periodic employee feedback initiatives
* Coordinate monthly celebrations, employee activities, team engagement initiatives, and cross\-functional events.
* Work with employee engagement SPOCs to plan and execute activities effectively.
* Track participation, feedback, and outcomes of engagement initiatives.
* Support initiatives focused on employee connect, collaboration, and workplace culture.

### **7\. Talent Acquisition Support**

* Support campus and fresher hiring activities including coordination with colleges, candidates, interview panels, and internal stakeholders.
* Provide recruitment coordination support for lateral hiring across functions.
* Schedule interviews, coordinate feedback, maintain recruitment trackers, and ensure timely candidate communication.
* Coordinate with hiring managers and interview panels to ensure smooth movement of candidates through the hiring process.
* Support recruitment documentation, offer coordination, and pre\-joining activities.
* Contribute to improving candidate experience and hiring turnaround time.

### **8\. Process Excellence \& Continuous Improvement**

* Identify gaps and inefficiencies in existing HR processes and recommend practical improvements.
* Develop, review, and maintain HR SOPs, process documents, checklists, and operational guidelines
* Support automation and digitization initiatives to reduce manual effort and improve turnaround time.
* Ensure adherence to defined HR processes and controls.
* Support periodic process reviews and implementation of corrective actions arising from audits or operational reviews.

### **9\. Administration \& Vendor Management**

* Coordinate procurement of supplies required for employee engagement activities and internal events.
* Manage procurement and distribution of office stationery and HR\-related supplies.
* Raise and track purchase orders/requests and ensure timely delivery of required items.
* Coordinate with vendors and monitor service quality, cost, timelines, renewals, and payments.
* Maintain vendor records and support periodic vendor performance reviews.
* Coordinate procurement of e\-stamp/e\-stamp\-related documentation and agreements through relevant banking/vendor channels.
* Maintain appropriate documentation for administrative purchases and vendor transactions.

**Key Skills \& Competencies**
==============================

### **Mandatory Skills**


* Strong understanding of **HR Operations and Employee Lifecycle Management**
* Good knowledge of **Payroll, Attendance \& Leave Administration**
* Working knowledge of **HR statutory compliance**
* Experience with **HRMS/HRIS and HR data management**
* Strong **MIS and Excel/Google Sheets** skills
* Good stakeholder and employee management skills
* Strong attention to detail and data accuracy
* Good written and verbal communication
* Ability to manage confidential employee information
* Strong coordination and follow\-up skills
* Process\-oriented and solution\-focused approach
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines
* Good understanding of employee engagement and HR processes

**Preferred Experience**
========================


* 6 Months \- 3 years of experience in HR Operations, HR Generalist, HR Shared Services, or a similar role.

title: Recruitment Marketing Executive
description:

**Job Type:** Full\-Time  
**Experience:** 0–2 Years  
**Location:** \[Ahmedabad]  
**Shift:** \[Overnight / US Shift]

Job Summary

We are looking for a motivated **Recruitment Marketing Executive** to support our recruitment and business development team by promoting IT candidate profiles, identifying relevant job opportunities, and connecting with recruiters and hiring companies.

The ideal candidate should have strong communication skills, good internet research abilities, and an interest in **IT recruitment, online marketing, and lead generation**.

Key Responsibilities

* Identify relevant IT job openings through LinkedIn, job portals, company websites, and other online platforms.
* Market and promote qualified IT candidate profiles to recruiters and hiring managers.
* Conduct professional outreach through **LinkedIn, email, and phone calls**.
* Research and identify potential recruiters, staffing companies, and hiring managers.
* Build and maintain a database of recruiters, clients, and job opportunities.
* Send candidate profiles based on job requirements.
* Follow up with recruiters regarding submitted profiles.
* Coordinate with recruiters and internal teams regarding candidate submissions and opportunities.
* Maintain daily records of submissions, responses, interviews, and follow\-ups.
* Monitor market trends and identify new recruitment opportunities.
* Meet daily and monthly marketing and submission targets.

Required Skills

* Strong verbal and written **English communication**.
* Good internet research and information\-gathering skills.
* Knowledge of **LinkedIn and email communication**.
* Basic knowledge of Microsoft Excel/Google Sheets.
* Strong follow\-up and relationship\-building skills.
* Ability to work with daily targets.
* Good organizational and time\-management skills.
* Willingness to learn US IT recruitment processes.

Preferred Skills

* Experience in **IT recruitment, staffing, lead generation, recruitment marketing, or business development**.
* Experience working with LinkedIn Recruiter or similar platforms.
* Understanding of US IT job roles and technologies.
* Experience communicating with US\-based recruiters or companies.
* Familiarity with ATS/CRM systems.

Education

* Bachelor's degree in **Business, Marketing, HR, IT, Commerce, or a related field**.
* Freshers are welcome with strong communication and online research skills.

Experience

**0–2 years**

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Number of qualified job opportunities identified.
* Number of candidate profiles marketed/submitted.
* Recruiter/client connections generated.
* Response and follow\-up rate.
* Interviews generated from submissions.
* Daily outreach and activity targets.
* Overall submission\-to\-interview conversion.

Ideal Candidate

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys **online research, LinkedIn outreach, communication, follow\-ups, and working with targets** and wants to build a career in **IT recruitment and staffing**.

description:
**Job Title**

 **Territory Service Representative – Operations**

 **Function**

 **Operations**

 **Reports To**

  

Inbound Shift In\-charge / Outbound Shift In\-charge (as applicable)

 **Location**

 **AEL**

 **Travel Required**

 **25%****50%****75%****þ**

  

**About DHL Blue Dart Express India:**

  

**Blue Dart Express Limited**, a listed company, is a leader in courier, integrated air express package distribution, and eCommerce in South Asia, offering a wide range of logistics solutions. Founded in 1983, it is recognised for reliable, time\-bound, and secure delivery services across 55,000\+ locations in India as well as internationally. Its competencies span across evaluation and contracting, planning and transition, delivery and execution, and specific service capabilities. We pride ourselves on innovation, digitalization, service excellence, and creating long\-term partnerships with our clients, enabling businesses to thrive in the fast\-paced logistics environment and ever\-evolving supply\-chains. It wholly\-owns India’s only scheduled air cargo airline, Blue Dart Aviation Limited, since May 1994, and the Concorde Air Logistics Limited, a transport, storage, and communications business, since May 2004\.


Blue Dart Express Limited is a part of the DHL Group's DHL eCommerce division, leveraging this global logistics leader’s network across 220 countries and territories to provide comprehensive express and logistics solutions to our clients. Our robust network and unmatched infrastructure have positioned the Blue Dart brand as a key India\-grown logistics player with an unmatched and phenomenal global outreach rooted in the DHL brand of its majority shareholder.


We are proud to be consistently ranked among **India’s Top 100 Great Places to Work**, combining it with DHL Group’s Top Employer certification. Being an **Employer of Choice** is not just a goal; it’s a fundamental part of who we are, committed to creating a workplace where people are valued, empowered, and wear the sobriquet “Blue Darter” with honour.


If you are looking to join a purpose\-led, people\-first, company that shapes India’s supply\-chains with integrity and safety, **Blue Dart is where you belong**. Blue Dart offers competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits, access to cross\-functional, succession planning and global career paths, and strong culture of recognition.


**Position Overview:**

  


The **Territory Service Representative (TSR) – Operations** is responsible for the timely pickup and delivery of customer shipments within an assigned territory while delivering a superior customer experience and representing the Blue Dart brand with professionalism.


Operating as the face of Blue Dart on the ground, the role ensures safe handling of shipments, timely collections and deliveries, accurate shipment scanning, COD collections, proof of delivery (POD) compliance and adherence to operational procedures. The TSR works closely with the Shift In\-charge and branch operations team to ensure service commitments are consistently achieved while maintaining the highest standards of safety, customer service and operational discipline.

**Job Purpose:**

  


To execute timely pickup and delivery of shipments, ensure accurate shipment handling, customer interactions and COD collections while adhering to Blue Dart's operational standards, safety requirements and service commitments.

**Key Roles \& Responsibilities:**

  

**Pickup \& Delivery Operations**

* Perform timely pickup and delivery of customer shipments within the assigned route or territory.
* Ensure all shipments are delivered within committed service timelines.
* Verify shipment details before pickup and delivery.
* Handle shipments carefully to prevent damage or loss.
* Maintain delivery productivity and route efficiency.

**Customer Service Excellence**

* Serve as the face of Blue Dart during every customer interaction.
* Maintain courteous, professional and customer\-centric behaviour at all times.
* Resolve basic customer queries during pickups and deliveries.
* Escalate customer concerns or operational exceptions promptly.
* Maintain high standards of grooming, behaviour and professionalism.

**COD \& Documentation Management**

* Collect Cash on Delivery (COD) payments wherever applicable.
* Ensure accurate cash handling and timely remittance as per company procedures.
* Obtain Proof of Delivery (POD), customer acknowledgements and required shipment documentation.
* Ensure documentation accuracy and compliance with operational procedures.
* Report discrepancies immediately.

**Operational Compliance**

* Scan shipments accurately using handheld devices or approved digital platforms.
* Ensure shipment status updates are completed in real time.
* Follow all Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) during pickup and delivery activities.
* Adhere to company policies relating to shipment handling, documentation and customer interaction.
* Support operational requirements during peak business periods.

**Safety \& Security**

* Follow all road safety guidelines while operating company or personal vehicles.
* Ensure safe handling and security of customer shipments throughout transit.
* Wear the prescribed company uniform and personal protective equipment wherever applicable.
* Report accidents, incidents or unsafe conditions immediately.
* Protect company assets and customer property.

**Vehicle \& Asset Responsibility**

* Maintain the assigned vehicle or personal two\-wheeler in roadworthy condition.
* Ensure all statutory vehicle documents remain valid.
* Maintain cleanliness and basic upkeep of the vehicle.
* Report maintenance requirements promptly.

**Workplace Discipline \& Brand Representation**

* Maintain high standards of personal grooming, hygiene and professional appearance.
* Wear the prescribed Blue Dart uniform and identity card while on duty.
* Demonstrate discipline, punctuality and professionalism at all times.
* Follow workplace rules, operational discipline and company policies.
* Represent the Blue Dart brand positively through behaviour, teamwork and commitment to service excellence.

**Team Collaboration**

* Work closely with Shift In\-charges and branch operations teams.
* Support colleagues during operational contingencies.
* Participate in operational briefings and safety meetings.
* Contribute towards achieving branch productivity and service goals.

**Qualifications \& Experience:**

  

**Education**:

* Minimum **10th Standard Pass**.
* Higher educational qualifications will be an added advantage.

**Experience**:

* Fresher or up to **2 years** of relevant experience in courier, logistics, distribution, retail delivery or field operations.
* Experience in pickup and delivery operations will be an added advantage.

**Eligibility Requirements:**

* Minimum age **18 years.**
* Valid **Two\-Wheeler** or Four\-Wheeler Driving Licence.
* Must own a two\-wheeler where deployment requires the employee to use a personal vehicle, in accordance with Company policy.
* Physically fit to perform field operations.
* Willingness to work across shifts, weekends and holidays based on business requirements.

**Skills \& Capabilities:**

  

**Technical Skills:**

* Pickup \& Delivery Operations
* Shipment Handling
* Cash Collection (COD)
* Proof of Delivery (POD)
* Mobile Device / Scanner Usage
* Route Familiarity
* Basic Computer \& Mobile Application Skills
* Basic English Reading \& Understanding

**Key Competencies:**

* Customer Focus
* Integrity
* Reliability
* Safety Consciousness
* Teamwork
* Discipline
* Time Management
* Accountability
* Positive Attitude
* Professional Appearance

**Key Performance Indicators:**

  

**KRAs**

 **KPIs**

  

Delivery \& Pickup Performance

  

On\-Time Delivery • Pickup Adherence • Delivery Productivity

  

Service Quality

  

First Attempt Delivery • Shipment Handling Accuracy • Customer Satisfaction

  

COD \& Documentation

  

COD Collection Accuracy • POD Completion • Zero Documentation Errors

  

Safety \& Compliance

  

Safe Driving • SOP Adherence • Uniform \& Grooming Compliance

  

Operational Productivity

  

Shipments Delivered/Picked Up • Scanner Compliance • Route Efficiency

  

**Why join DHL Blue Dart?**

  


When you join us, you’re not just taking a job—you’re becoming part of a purpose\-led movement that’s reshaping the future of logistics across India and the world. At Blue Dart, we don’t just deliver parcels—we deliver excellence, innovation, and opportunity every day.


Here’s what makes us stand out:

* **Great Place to Work® Certified**—a testament to our people\-first culture, inclusive environment, and commitment to your growth and well\-being.
* **Competitive pay** and performance\-linked rewards that truly recognize your impact.
* Structured learning, **global exposure**, and on\-the\-job coaching to help you grow faster than ever.
* **Best\-in\-class benefits**—from comprehensive medical cover (including optional parental care) to financial wellness and generous time off.
* A culture that celebrates **diversity, innovation, and bold thinking**—where your voice is heard and your contributions matter.
* **Global career paths**across the DHL Group, opening doors to opportunities in 220\+ countries and territories.
* The pride of working with **India’s most awarded logistics brand**, trusted by millions and driven by purpose.


This is your chance to do meaningful work, build a career without borders, and thrive in a company that’s not just a logistics leader—but a Great Place to Work. **Come grow with us.**

**Disclaimer:**  

At Blue Dart Express Limited, all recruitment is conducted through a fair, transparent, and merit\-based process aligned with our commitments to Human Rights and Diversity, Equity, Inclusion \& Belonging (DEIB).


Blue Dart does not request or accept any fees, deposits, or payments from candidates at any stage of the recruitment or onboarding process. Any such request is fraudulent and unauthorized.


Blue Dart shall not be responsible for any loss arising from such fraudulent activity. For verification, candidates may write to bdjobs@bluedart.com.

title: MRE Intern
description:
Sprinto is an **Autonomous Trust Platform** that centralizes trust requirements across **security frameworks, vendors, and customers.**



Sprinto autonomously executes tasks needed to maintain trust across compliance, audits, risk management, vendor risk, privacy, and AI governance, enabling organizations to maintain a strong, reliable trust posture without draining operational bandwidth and resources on repetitive tasks.



Backed by top\-tier investors such as Accel, Elevation, and Blume Ventures, we’ve **raised** **$31\.8M** in funding to fuel our mission. Trusted by over **4,000 organizations across 75 countries**, Sprinto helps organizations stay audit\-ready, manage real\-time risks, and scale fearlessly. With **300\+ native integrations** and AI\-driven automation, Sprinto supports **200\+ global security standards natively**, including SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, HIPAA, PCI\-DSS, and more. Sprinto's extensible architecture enables organizations to build and support an infinite number of custom integrations and frameworks.


**Founded in 2020** by second\-time founders Girish Redekar and Raghuveer Kancherla, Sprinto powers compliance for organizations like Whatfix, Encora, Anaconda, Whatnot, Ultrahuman, WeWork, Everstage, AI Foundation, HackerRank, and many more.


### **Life as a Sprinter \-**



Nobody succeeds at Sprinto by staying in their lane.



We are organized around problems, not job titles. Sprinters take ownership beyond their role, solve hard problems, and care deeply about the impact they create. If something can be improved, fixed, or built, we don't wait for permission; we step in.



Being remote means we rely less on proximity and more on trust. We write things down, communicate openly, and move quickly because great teams aren't built by sitting together, they're built by pulling in the same direction.



We believe progress beats perfection, feedback is a gift, and doing the right thing matters, even when nobody is watching.



And while we move with urgency, we never move alone.


### **The mission \-**



Every good sales conversation at Sprinto starts long before anyone picks up the phone. It starts with knowing who to talk to, what's happening inside their company, and why compliance is suddenly on their roadmap.



That's the work you'll be doing. As a Market Research \& Enrichment Intern, you'll dig into companies, industries, and markets to figure out which accounts fit Sprinto and which people inside them matter. Your research becomes the foundation our Sales and Marketing teams build campaigns on.



This isn't a "copy names into a sheet" internship. You'll learn how modern B2B companies decide who to sell to, and you'll get sharp at finding signal in messy, scattered, publicly available information.



If you like puzzles, get satisfaction from a clean and well organised dataset, and enjoy going down research rabbit holes, you'll enjoy this one.



### **Where you'll leave your mark?**


* Run primary and secondary research to build a picture of companies, industries, markets, and customers
* Find and organise information from public sources into something the team can actually act on
* Identify relevant companies and contacts against clearly defined research criteria
* Collect, validate, and structure research data in spreadsheets and internal systems
* Keep our research databases accurate and current, and flag what's gone stale
* Analyse what you find and turn it into summaries, reports, and presentations
* Pull together market, account, and customer insights that feed Sales and Marketing initiatives
* Learn and apply the research methodologies, tools, and processes the team runs on
* Work closely with your manager and teammates on ongoing research projects
### **The kind of builder we're looking for \-**

* You're a fresher or currently pursuing a Bachelor's or Master's in Business Administration, Business Analytics, Economics, Marketing, or something adjacent
* You've already done at least 3 months as a Marketing Research Intern, so you know what real research work feels like
* You're good at finding things. Give you a half\-formed question and you'll come back with sources, structure, and a point of view
* You're comfortable in Excel or Google Sheets and can keep a large dataset clean without being told twice
* You're detail\-obsessed. A mismatched column or a duplicate row bothers you
* You think logically, write clearly, and can explain what your research means, not just what it says
* You pick up new tools quickly and don't wait for a manual
* You're curious enough to research an industry you've never heard of and come out understanding it
* You like working with data to answer questions, and you're interested in market research, sales, and B2B SaaS
* You adapt easily, stay open to feedback, and are comfortable in a fast\-moving environment

### **Inclusion \& Diversity \-**



At Sprinto, talent, curiosity, and ownership matter more than where you come from. We hire people for the problems they can solve, the impact they create, and the way they help others succeed—not their background, identity, or personal circumstances. We believe the best teams are built when people with different perspectives come together around a shared ambition to build something meaningful.



We're proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to creating a fair, inclusive, and accessible hiring process for everyone.



We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

description:
**Customer Support** 




**Location:** 
 Pune
 



**Experience:** 
 1\-3 year
 



**Company:** 
 Celoxis
 



**About Celoxis** 




 Celoxis is a global Project Portfolio Management (PPM) platform used by organizations to plan projects, manage resources, track financials, collaborate, and make better business decisions.
 



 We are looking for curious, customer\-focused graduates who enjoy solving problems and want to build a career in SaaS, customer support, and technology.
 



**Role Overview** 




 As a
 **Customer Support Intern** 
 , you will be part of the team responsible for helping Celoxis customers successfully use and troubleshoot the product.
 



 This is not just a ticket\-handling role. You will learn how a B2B SaaS product works, understand real customer business problems, investigate technical issues, and communicate solutions clearly.
 



 You will work closely with Customer Success, Product, Engineering, and other internal teams.
 



**Key Responsibilities** 



* Respond to customer questions through support tickets, email, chat, and calls.
* Understand customer issues and identify the actual problem before suggesting a solution.
* Learn the Celoxis product in depth, including projects, tasks, resources, timesheets, reports, workflows, and administration.
* Reproduce customer\-reported issues and document clear reproduction steps.
* Troubleshoot functional and basic technical issues using application settings, logs, browser developer tools, APIs, and other available diagnostic information.
* Guide customers through product configuration and recommended approaches.
* Escalate product defects and complex technical issues with complete supporting information.
* Work with Product and Engineering teams to follow issues through to resolution.
* Keep customers updated on the progress of their queries.
* Create and improve internal troubleshooting documentation and knowledge\-base content.
* Identify recurring customer problems and share feedback that can help improve the product and customer experience.
* Participate in product testing and validation of fixes or new releases when required.



**What We Are Looking For** 




 We care more about your ability to
 **learn, think, communicate, and solve problems** 
 than prior work experience.
 



 You should have:
 


* A Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, IT, Engineering, BCA, BSc Computer Science, or a related field.
* Strong written and verbal English communication skills.
* Good analytical and logical reasoning skills.
* Curiosity to understand how software works instead of simply following predefined steps.
* Ability to break a problem into smaller parts and troubleshoot systematically.
* Patience and professionalism while communicating with customers.
* Willingness to learn new technologies and business concepts.
* Good attention to detail and documentation skills.
* Ability to take ownership of a problem and follow it through to resolution.



**Good to Have** 




 Prior knowledge is not mandatory, but exposure to any of the following will be helpful:
 


* SQL and relational databases
* REST APIs, JSON, HTTP, and web applications
* Browser Developer Tools
* Basic networking concepts
* Linux / Windows command line
* General programming concepts
* SaaS applications
* Project management concepts
* Tools such as Postman, Zendesk, Jira, or similar platforms



**What You Will Learn** 



* Enterprise SaaS customer support
* Project and Portfolio Management concepts
* Technical troubleshooting
* APIs and integrations
* Database and application fundamentals
* Customer communication and expectation management
* Product testing and defect reporting
* Working with Product and Engineering teams
* Handling real\-world enterprise customer scenarios



**What Success Looks Like** 




 A successful Customer Support at Celoxis will gradually be able to:
 


* Understand customer requirements without relying heavily on others.
* Troubleshoot issues methodically.
* Provide accurate and easy\-to\-understand responses.
* Distinguish between configuration issues, product limitations, and potential defects.
* Write high\-quality escalation notes that help Engineering investigate quickly.
* Take ownership of customer queries from initial investigation through resolution.
* Build strong product knowledge and become a dependable member of the Customer Support team.



**Who Would Enjoy This Role?** 




 You may be a strong fit if you enjoy questions such as:
 



**“Why is this happening?”** 




**“Can I reproduce this?”** 




**“What changed?”** 




**“Is this configuration, expected behaviour, or a bug?”** 




**“How can I explain the solution clearly to the customer?”** 




 If you enjoy solving puzzles, learning software, interacting with people, and understanding both the technical and business side of a problem, this role can be a strong starting point for your career in SaaS.
