title: Tier I Technical Support Specialist — Smart Cooler Vending
description:
**This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Tier I Technical Support Specialist — Smart Cooler Vending based in India.**
 This is a fully remote technical support role focused on helping operators successfully run smart cooler vending equipment.
   

  

 You will serve as the first point of contact for technical questions involving connected machines, mobile apps, payment readers, and basic connectivity issues.
   

  

 The role combines customer communication, structured troubleshooting, technical information gathering, and detailed documentation.
   

  

 You will help customers with onboarding, machine\-status concerns, app\-related questions, transaction issues, and approved first\-line troubleshooting.
   

  

 You will work closely with a Tier II technical team, providing clean and complete handoffs whenever deeper diagnosis or technical decisions are required.
   

  

 Success in this role depends on being organized, technically curious, customer\-focused, and comfortable following defined support processes.
   

  

 This is an opportunity to build hands\-on experience with smart vending technology, connected devices, payment systems, and real\-world technical support.
   

  

 Accountabilities
   

  

* Customer Support Intake: Receive and respond to technical support requests through approved channels, identify the issue category, gather relevant customer and machine information, and determine the likely area involved, such as the mobile app, backend, physical equipment, POS, payment reader, or connectivity.
* Issue Documentation: Capture machine IDs, models, locations, timelines, error messages, screenshots, videos, troubleshooting history, and customer impact, including downtime, lost sales, failed transactions, or installation delays.
* Basic Troubleshooting: Guide customers through approved first\-line troubleshooting procedures, including app checks, remote restarts, physical power cycles, and other documented steps. Monitor whether issues remain resolved and identify recurring offline events or transactions stuck in processing.
* Onboarding Support: Assist customers with routine setup and onboarding, app navigation, product libraries, pricing, templates, inventory, machine management, and preparation for technical\-support sessions. Provide clear follow\-up summaries and direct customers to approved training and knowledge resources.
* Connectivity Information Gathering: Collect the information required for deeper technical investigation, including whether equipment uses cellular, Wi\-Fi, Ethernet, or a router; available facility IT support; physical signal limitations; and requested screenshots, speed\-test results, photos, or status information.
* Payment \& Transaction Support: Help identify whether transaction issues appear to originate within the application environment or payment ecosystem. Gather transaction dates, times, amounts, machine IDs, and supporting evidence before escalating issues involving payment readers, settlements, integrations, or other advanced payment concerns.
* Customer Communication \& Follow\-Up: Communicate calmly and professionally, acknowledge customer concerns, ask focused questions, explain technical steps in accessible language, provide realistic next steps, and maintain consistent communication throughout the support process.
* Escalation \& Handoffs: Recognize when an issue exceeds the approved Tier I process and escalate it with a complete, structured handoff so the Tier II team can continue the investigation without repeating the initial diagnostic process.
* Support Records: Maintain accurate records of every troubleshooting step, customer response, outcome, and escalation status while clearly distinguishing confirmed facts from assumptions.


**Requirements**
* Customer Support Experience: 1–3 years of relevant experience in technical support, customer support, help desk, field\-service coordination, or a similar customer\-facing environment.
* Technical Foundation: Basic understanding of smart devices, mobile applications, web dashboards, connected equipment, Wi\-Fi, Ethernet, cellular connectivity, routers, and SIM\-based connectivity.
* Troubleshooting Skills: Ability to follow structured troubleshooting checklists carefully, investigate symptoms methodically, recognize different types of machine, application, backend, POS, and payment\-reader issues, and avoid skipping required steps.
* Communication: Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate technical instructions into clear, simple language for non\-technical customers.
* Documentation: Strong attention to detail and the ability to accurately record customer information, machine details, symptoms, timelines, evidence, troubleshooting actions, and outcomes.
* Customer Mindset: Calm, patient, professional, and empathetic when supporting frustrated customers or situations involving downtime, failed transactions, or operational disruption.
* Judgment \& Escalation: Comfortable acknowledging when an issue is outside your expertise and escalating it appropriately rather than guessing or making unsupported recommendations.
* Organization: Strong follow\-up habits and the ability to manage support requests, customer communications, screenshots, tickets, and other case information in a structured manner.
* Technical Curiosity: Willingness to learn smart cooler vending technology, connected equipment platforms, payment\-reader fundamentals, connectivity workflows, and internal support procedures.
* Helpful Experience: Background in vending operations, unattended retail, POS or payment\-reader support, basic networking, router/Wi\-Fi/Ethernet/cellular troubleshooting, ticket\-based help desk environments, or technical support for non\-technical customers is an advantage.
* Role Boundaries: Must understand that Tier I is responsible for identifying issues, gathering information, performing approved basic checks, documenting findings, and escalating. Advanced connectivity architecture, backend changes, payment\-reader replacement decisions, equipment recommendations, and deeper technical diagnosis remain outside the scope of this position unless specifically authorized.


**Benefits**
* Compensation: $17–$27 USD per hour.
* Work Arrangement: Fully remote position.
* Employment: Full\-time opportunity.
* Professional Development: Hands\-on exposure to smart cooler vending technology, connected equipment, app\-based platforms, payment systems, and real\-world connectivity troubleshooting.
* Technical Experience: Opportunity to develop practical experience across customer technical support, IoT\-connected equipment, mobile applications, POS/payment technologies, and structured escalation workflows.

title: Senior Front Office Executive
description:
Job Description – Front Office Executive

**Organization:** ONUS Robotic Hospitals  
**Location:** Hyderabad  
**Department:** Front Office / Patient Services  
**Position:** Front Office Executive  
**Reports To:** Front Office Manager / Hospital Administrator

Job Summary

The Front Office Executive will be responsible for providing a professional, courteous, and efficient experience to patients and visitors from the time they enter the hospital until completion of their visit.

The role involves patient registration, appointment coordination, billing support, enquiry handling, doctor coordination, admission assistance, and maintaining accurate patient information in the Hospital Management Information System (HMIS).

Key Responsibilities1\. Patient Reception \& Registration

* Welcome patients and visitors professionally.
* Understand the patient's requirement and guide them to the appropriate department or doctor.
* Register new patients and update existing patient information in HMIS.
* Generate UMR/Patient IDs correctly.
* Verify patient name, age, gender, mobile number, address, and other required details.
* Ensure minimum waiting time for patients.

2\. Appointment Management

* Schedule OP consultations, investigations, procedures, and follow\-up appointments.
* Coordinate with doctors regarding consultation timings and availability.
* Inform patients about delays, cancellations, or changes in doctor schedules.
* Maintain proper appointment and walk\-in patient records.

3\. OP Billing \& Cash Handling

* Generate OP consultation, laboratory, radiology, physiotherapy, and procedure bills.
* Collect payments through cash, card, UPI, or other approved payment modes.
* Issue receipts for every payment.
* Maintain accurate daily cash and billing records.
* Reconcile collections with the billing/HMIS system at the end of the shift.
* Immediately report billing discrepancies to the concerned manager.

4\. Patient Guidance \& Coordination

* Guide patients regarding:
* Doctor consultations
* Laboratory investigations
* Radiology services
* Pharmacy
* Physiotherapy
* Admissions
* Insurance desk
* Emergency services
* Coordinate with nursing, doctors, diagnostics, pharmacy, and other departments for smooth patient movement.

5\. Admission Support

* Assist patients requiring hospital admission.
* Coordinate with the admission desk regarding room/bed availability.
* Explain the basic admission process to patients and attendants.
* Ensure required documents are collected and forwarded to the appropriate department.

6\. Telephone \& Enquiry Management

* Attend incoming hospital calls professionally.
* Respond to patient enquiries regarding:
* Doctor availability
* Consultation fees
* Hospital services
* Packages
* Appointment timings
* Hospital locations
* Transfer calls to the appropriate departments when required.
* Record important enquiries and ensure proper follow\-up.

7\. Patient Experience

* Maintain a polite, compassionate, and patient\-friendly approach.
* Resolve minor patient concerns immediately wherever possible.
* Escalate complaints to the Front Office Manager/Administrator when necessary.
* Ensure patients and attendants receive clear information regarding hospital processes.
* Support collection of patient feedback.

8\. HMIS \& Documentation

* Maintain accurate patient information in HMIS.
* Avoid duplicate patient registrations.
* Update patient contact details whenever required.
* Maintain front\-office registers and daily reports.
* Protect patient confidentiality and hospital information.

9\. Coordination with Telecalling \& Marketing

* Record the correct patient lead/source such as:
* Google
* Meta/Facebook/Instagram
* Website
* WhatsApp
* Justdial
* Direct Call
* Referral
* Walk\-in
* Ensure the correct source is entered in HMIS/CRM.
* Coordinate with the telecalling team regarding appointment conversions and patient arrivals.

10\. Shift \& Handover Responsibilities

* Report to duty on time in proper uniform and grooming.
* Complete shift handover before leaving.
* Inform the next shift about pending appointments, admissions, complaints, or important patient requirements.
* Ensure the reception area remains clean, organized, and professional.

Daily Performance Expectations

The Front Office Executive should focus on:

* Accurate patient registrations
* Minimum patient waiting time
* Accurate billing
* Zero cash discrepancies
* Proper lead\-source entry
* Appointment\-to\-visit conversion
* Patient satisfaction
* Proper documentation
* Effective coordination between departments

Required Qualifications

* Any Graduate / Intermediate with relevant hospital experience
* Diploma or Degree in Hospital Administration will be an advantage
* Basic computer knowledge
* Experience using HMIS/Hospital Software preferred

Experience

**0–3 years**

Freshers with good communication skills and willingness to learn may also be considered.

Required Skills

* Excellent communication skills
* Telugu, English and Hindi preferred
* Good interpersonal skills
* Patient\-friendly attitude
* Basic computer and typing skills
* Billing and cash\-handling ability
* Ability to work under pressure
* Problem\-solving skills
* Multitasking ability
* Professional grooming and behaviour

Preferred Candidate

The ideal candidate should be:

* Energetic and responsible
* Patient\-focused
* Polite but confident
* Accurate with billing and documentation
* Comfortable coordinating with doctors and departments
* Able to handle busy OP hours calmly
* Willing to work rotational shifts

Key Performance Indicators – KPI

* Patient registration accuracy – **100%**

* Patient waiting\-time reduction
* Appointment confirmation and conversion

**ONUS Robotic Hospitals**

title: IT Network Engineer
description:
**Who are we \-** 




 We’re building an ecosystem of digital products and services that power everyday life across the Middle East—fast, scalable, and deeply customer\-centric. Our mission is to deliver to every door every day. We want to redefine what technology can do in this region, and we’re looking for an IT Network Engineer who can help us move even faster.
 



  





 noon’s mission: Every door, every day.
 



  





**Role Overview:** 




 We are seeking a highly motivated and hands\-on
 **IT Network Engineer** 
 with minimum
 **4 years of experience** 
 to manage and support the IT infrastructure at our
 **Gurugram Corporate Office** 
 while also providing operational support to corporate offices across the
 **UAE, KSA, and Egypt** 
 remotely.Occasional international travel to these regional offices may be required to support new office setups, network and voice infrastructure deployments, major hardware installations, equipment replacements, migrations, or other activities that require onsite technical presence and hands\-on configuration.
 



 The ideal candidate should possess strong experience in designing, configuring, administering, and troubleshooting enterprise network infrastructure, including LAN, WAN, wireless networks, VPNs, and network security solutions. In addition, the candidate should have practical experience configuring, managing, and troubleshooting
 **Cisco Unified Communications Manager (CUCM), Cisco Voice Gateways, SIP trunks, SIP\-based telephony,** 
 and related voice infrastructure to ensure reliable and high\-quality enterprise communication services.
 



 The successful candidate will be responsible for maintaining highly available and secure network and voice infrastructure, ensuring business continuity of critical IT services, resolving complex network and voice\-related incidents, supporting end\-user infrastructure, and collaborating with regional IT teams, telecom service providers, and vendors on operational and project initiatives. The role requires excellent analytical and troubleshooting skills, a strong customer service orientation, and the ability to work independently in a fast\-paced multinational environment while supporting multiple geographically distributed offices.
 



**Technical Expertise:** 



* Configure, administer, monitor, and troubleshoot Cisco enterprise network infrastructure, including
* Cisco routers, Layer 2/Layer 3 switches, wireless controllers, wireless access points, firewalls, and Cisco Voice Gateways.
* Configure and administer Cisco Unified Communications Manager (CUCM), Cisco Unified Border Element (CUBE), Cisco Voice Gateways, SIP trunks, MGCP, H.323, SIP, UCCX, CUP and UCS.
* Design, configure, maintain, and support enterprise IP Telephony (VoIP) and PBX solutions.
* Manage SIP trunks, Direct Inward Dialing (DID) numbers, phone extensions, dial plans, and voice routing.
* Implement and optimize Quality of Service (QoS) policies to ensure high\-quality voice communications.
* Perform Cisco Smart Licensing administration, SmartNet contract management, software lifecycle management, and license renewals.
* Support Windows Server and Linux server administration, including installation, configuration, patching, failover clustering, and basic troubleshooting.
* Participate in infrastructure lifecycle management, including firmware upgrades, hardware refreshes, and technology migrations.



**Network Security Infrastructure:** 



* Configure and troubleshoot enterprise routing, switching, VPNs, and Cisco SD\-WAN environments.
* Maintain network security infrastructure, including firewalls, VPN solutions, Network Access Control (NAC), and secure remote access.
* Plan, manage, and maintain IP address allocation using IP Address Management (IPAM) tools.
* Support enterprise wireless networking technologies and troubleshoot wireless performance issues.
* Ensure compliance with corporate IT security standards and cybersecurity best practices.
* Conduct periodic network vulnerability assessments and security reviews.



**Cloud Technologies:** 



* Support hybrid cloud connectivity within Microsoft Azure environments.
* Configure and troubleshoot Local Network Gateways, Azure Virtual WAN (vWAN), VPN, Gateways, and hybrid network connectivity.
* Collaborate with cloud and application teams to secure hybrid cloud infrastructure and optimize network performance.
* Be familiar with cloud technologies such as Cisco Meraki Cloud.



**Monitoring and Automation:** 



* Monitor enterprise infrastructure using tools such as SolarWinds, Zabbix, PRTG, or equivalent monitoring platforms.
* Configure alerts, dashboards, reporting, and proactive monitoring.
* Automate routine network administration tasks using scripting or automation tools where applicable.
* Support capacity planning and performance optimization initiatives.



**Network Support and Optimization:** 



* Provide Level 3 (L3\) network and voice support for enterprise infrastructure.
* Diagnose and resolve complex routing, switching, wireless, firewall, VPN, and VoIP issues.
* Plan and execute network implementations, upgrades, migrations, and office expansion projects.
* Coordinate with Internet Service Providers (ISPs) and telecom providers for Dedicated Internet
* Access (DIA), MPLS, leased circuits, and SIP trunk services.
* Review infrastructure utilization and recommend improvements to ensure optimal performance, scalability, and resilience.
* Participate in after\-hours maintenance activities and critical incident response when required.



**Documentation and Problem Resolution:** 



* Maintain accurate network diagrams, topology maps, IP addressing documentation, configuration backups, standard operating procedures (SOPs), and asset inventories.
* Maintain incident records, change documentation, and service reports.
* Produce Root Cause Analysis (RCA) reports and operational playbooks for recurring incidents.
* Build operational dashboards and reports using Microsoft Power BI or similar reporting tools.
* Ensure compliance with company IT policies and applicable local and international cybersecurity standards.



**Process Improvement and Planning:** 



* Identify opportunities to improve network reliability, automation, monitoring, and operational efficiency.
* Develop implementation plans for new technologies, infrastructure upgrades, and equipment deployments.
* Recommend best practices to improve service availability, security, and operational excellence.



**Troubleshooting and Support:** 



* Diagnose and resolve enterprise network, security, cloud connectivity, and IP telephony issues.
* Provide technical support to end users for connectivity, collaboration, and telephony services.
* Act as a technical escalation point for complex infrastructure incidents.
* Participate in an on\-call rotation and be available to provide remote or onsite support for critical business incidents outside normal working hours when required.



**Experience:** 



* 4\-5 years of hands\-on experience in enterprise IT Network Infrastructure within a Cisco environment.
* Minimum 2 years of experience supporting Windows Server and Linux server environments.
* Experience supporting Cisco Collaboration and Voice technologies in an enterprise environment is highly preferred.
* Experience supporting multinational or geographically distributed offices is an advantage.



  





**Qualifications:** 




**Must haves:** 



* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related discipline.
* Cisco Certified Network Associate (CCNA).



**Good to have:** 



* Cisco Certified Network Professional (CCNP Enterprise).
* Cisco Collaboration certifications (CCNP Collaboration or equivalent) are highly desirable.
* Microsoft Azure Administrator Associate (AZ\-104\) or equivalent cloud certification.
* ITIL Foundation Certification.
* Fortinet NSE, Palo Alto, or other network security certifications are an added advantage.



  





**Who will excel \-** 



* We’re looking for people with high standards, who understand that hard work matters.
* You need to be relentlessly resourceful and operate with a deep bias for action.
* We need people with the courage to be fiercely original.
* noon is not for everyone; readiness to adapt, pivot, and learn is essential.

title: AI Engineer
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

 At EY, we’re all in shape for your future with confidence.
   

  

 We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
   

  

 Join EY and help build a better working world.
   

  

**The opportunity**
 We are looking for a mid\-level AI engineer to play an integral role in our machine learning projects. This position requires designing, developing, and implementing advanced AI models with minimal supervision.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
* Bachelor's/Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field with a minimum of 5\-7 years' experience.
* Should have been involved in end\-to\-end delivery of the scalable, optimized and enterprise AI solutions.
* Experience in performing prompt engineering and fine\-tuning of the AI/ML, GenAI, LLM models \& building Agents, Multi Agent System
* Practical hands\-on fine\-tuning/transfer learning/optimization of the Transformer architecture\-based Deep Learning models.
* Experience in Agentic AI, Gen AI, LLM, NLP tools such as Word2Vec,, NLTK, SpaCy,BERT, GloVe,Autogen,Langchain, Langraph, etc
* A working understanding of cloud platforms either of AWS, Google Cloud, or Azure
* Good programming skills in Python along with experiences with Python frameworks such as Flask for lightweight applications, and FastAPI for building APIs.
* Experience in Docker for deploying the containers.
* Experience in NoSQL/SQL databases/Vector Databases.
* Strong knowledge of statistical methods and experimental design.
* Experience with MLOps practices for CI/CD in machine learning.


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Data Science, or related field
* Solid understanding of machine learning concepts, including supervised and unsupervised learning
* Proficiency in Python and experience with frameworks such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, or Scikit\-Learn
* Experience setting up Docker images and utilizing NoSQL databases (e.g., MongoDB)
* Familiarity with Retrieval Augmented Generation and AI agent platforms
* Practical experience in testing methodologies and debugging complex codebases
* Understanding of CI/CD principles and tools like GitHub Actions
* Experience with cloud services (Azure preferred) for deploying models
* Hands\-on experience developing and deploying LLM\-based AI agents


**Ideally, you’ll also**
* Solid understanding of statistics, classical statistical models, and optimization techniques at a mid\-career level
* Experience applying risk management concepts within AI and ML applications


**What We Look For**
 We want people who are self\-starters, who can take initiative and get things done. If you can think critically and creatively to solve problems, you will excel. You should be comfortable working with culturally diverse outsourced on/offshore team members, which means you may need to work outside normal working hours. Some travel may be required.
   

  

**What We Offer You**
 At EY, we’ll develop you with future\-focused skills and equip you with world\-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams.
   

  

**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
**About ClearGrid**
**ClearGrid is revolutionizing the debt resolution industry with cutting\-edge AI and advanced analytics. We leverage real\-time data, machine learning, and automation to optimize debt recovery for financial institutions. As we scale our technology platform, we are building high\-performance, user\-centric systems to support our next phase of rapid growth.**
****Role Overview****
**Based in our Bangalore, India office, the Full Stack Engineer will bridge the gap between user experience and robust backend functionality. This role requires a versatile engineer with 3\+ years of experience who loves moving fast, taking end\-to\-end ownership of features, and building intuitive user interfaces backed by resilient architectures.**
**The ideal candidate has a strong product mindset—someone who doesn't just build to spec but constantly thinks about how software impacts the end\-user. You will be a crucial driver in expanding our product capabilities, bringing a balanced mix of front\-end finesse and backend stability to the engineering team.**
****Key Responsibilities****
****Technical Oversight \& Architecture****
* Full\-Stack Development: Design, develop, and maintain responsive, intuitive front\-end user experiences alongside high\-performance microservices.
* Component Design: Architect modular, reusable UI components and scalable backend endpoints that ensure smooth data synchronization and minimal latency.
* Database Integration: Design and optimize database schemas and queries across relational and NoSQL databases to support new application features.


****Execution \& Strategy****
* Feature Delivery: Drive features from conception to deployment, balancing short\-term delivery with long\-term code maintainability.
* Security \& Clean Code: Implement secure coding practices on both the client and server sides, ensuring secure authentication and data protection.
* DevOps Contribution: Build and manage automated deployment steps, containerization, and monitoring for full\-stack features.


****Team Leadership \& Collaboration****
* Cross\-Functional Synergy: Work hand\-in\-hand with backend engineers, data scientists, and UI/UX designers to deliver seamless, cohesive user journeys.
* Code Quality: Participate actively in code reviews, sharing knowledge, establishing best practices, and ensuring code quality remains exceptionally high.


****Executive Reporting****
* Status Visibility: Keep engineering leads and product stakeholders informed on technical trade\-offs, sprint progress, and potential timeline dependencies.


**Requirements**
****Experience****
* Years of Experience: 3\+ years of professional full\-stack development experience in a fast\-paced environment.
* Industry Context: Experience working within startups, fintech platforms, or fast\-growing SaaS companies is highly valued.
* Geographic Location: Ability to work full\-time out of our Bangalore, India office.


****Technical Skills****
* Front\-End Stack: Deep proficiency in modern JavaScript/TypeScript and frameworks like React.js (or Vue.js/Angular), HTML5, and CSS3\.
* Backend Stack: Strong hands\-on experience building services in Spring Boot or Python.
* Databases: Practical experience working with relational (MySQL, PostgreSQL) and NoSQL (DynamoDB, MongoDB) databases.
* APIs \& Cloud: Strong experience designing and consuming RESTful and GraphQL APIs, with basic exposure to AWS or GCP.
* DevOps Basics: Familiarity with Docker, version control (Git), and CI/CD pipelines.


****What We’re Looking For****
* Product Empathy: A strong desire to understand the user’s pain points and a passion for building smooth, friction\-free user experiences.
* Pragmatic Problem\-Solving: Ability to assess technical trade\-offs wisely, balancing perfect architecture with the speed required to ship products in a startup environment.
* Curiosity \& Adaptability: A rapid learner eager to dive into new technologies, frameworks, and tools across the entire stack.
* Strong Collaboration: Excellent communication skills, with an open\-minded, collaborative attitude that elevates the team dynamic.

title: Field Application Engineer
description:
**Role Overview** 




 We are looking for a Engineer – Field Applications to join our Field Engineering team supporting the on\-site deployment, commissioning, and support of Autonomous Mobile Robot (AMR) systems at customer locations across Ahmedabad. In this role, you will handle installation, breakdown troubleshooting, and performance monitoring of deployed AMR platforms, working closely with internal technical teams and on\-site operators.
 



 This is a hands\-on, travel\-intensive role for someone who enjoys solving practical field problems, training operators on the ground, and keeping AMR systems running reliably in real industrial environments.
 



  





**Responsibilities** 



* Install and commission AMR systems at customer sites, supporting initial setup, testing, and validation of operations.
* Attend breakdown calls and troubleshoot hardware, software, and operational issues on deployed systems.
* Coordinate with internal technical teams to diagnose and resolve field issues.
* Monitor AMR performance to ensure maximum utilization and uptime across sites.
* Train operators and supervisors on safe and effective AMR usage.
* Support adherence to SOPs and operational best practices at customer locations.
* Maintain field visit records, issue logs, and service documentation for each site.
* Travel to customer sites as required to support deployment and service needs.



  





**Qualifications** 



* Diploma in Robotics/ Mechatronics Engineering or a related discipline \- up to 3 years of relevant experience – immediate joiners only.
* Basic understanding of mechatronics systems and electrical, mechanical, and control fundamentals.
* Familiarity with sensors, motors, and automation concepts used in AMR platforms.
* Basic exposure to Python, C\+\+, and Ubuntu OS terminal commands.
* Ability to troubleshoot hardware, software, and operational issues under guidance.
* Willingness to travel extensively for site deployment and service support.
* Good communication skills for operator interaction and training, with a strong learning attitude.

About the Role

We are looking for enthusiastic **fresh Mechanical Engineers / Diploma Mechanical Engineers** who are interested in building a career in **Technical Sales \& Business Development**.

The candidate will be trained in **Non\-Destructive Testing (NDT) equipment and inspection technologies** and will work with customers from industries such as Oil \& Gas, Fabrication, Engineering, Power, Automotive, Casting, Forging, Pressure Vessels and Infrastructure.

* Visit customers and understand their technical requirements.
* Explain and demonstrate NDT products and equipment to customers.
* Prepare and send quotations and technical offers.
* Follow up regularly with customers for enquiries and quotations.

* Develop long\-term relationships with customers.
* Track enquiries from initial contact until order closure.
* Achieve monthly sales and lead\-generation targets.
* Travel within Mumbai and other locations as required.

Products / Technologies

The candidate will be trained on products such as:

* Ultrasonic Testing (UT) Equipment
* PAUT Equipment \& Accessories
* Radiography Testing (RT) Equipment
* Betatron / X\-Ray Inspection Systems
* PMI / XRF Equipment

Candidate Profile

* Diploma / BE / B.Tech in Mechanical Engineering.

* Good communication skills.
* Basic knowledge of engineering and manufacturing.
* Willingness to learn technical products.
* Comfortable speaking with customers.
* Positive attitude and self\-motivation.
* Willingness to travel for customer visits.
* Basic knowledge of MS Excel, Word and email.

**Good to Have:**

* Internship or industrial training experience.
* Previous technical sales experience.

Who We Are Looking For

What matters most is your willingness to learn, communicate with customers and build business.

Training \& Career Development

* Fundamentals of NDT

title: Civil Engineer
description:
**Job Description**

**Job Summary**

We are seeking a **Civil Engineer Fresher** to join our engineering and project execution team. The ideal candidate should have a strong academic foundation in **Civil Engineering** and a willingness to learn and work on **Water Supply Schemes (WSS), Underground Drainage (UGD), Water Treatment Plants (WTP), Sewage Treatment Plants (STP), pipeline works, RCC works, and other civil infrastructure projects**.

The candidate will work under the guidance of senior engineers and project managers and will be involved in **site supervision, quality checking, measurements, estimation, billing support, documentation, and coordination with contractors and project teams**.

Key Responsibilities

* Assist senior engineers in the execution of **Water Supply Scheme (WSS)** projects.
* Assist in supervision of **Water Treatment Plant (WTP)** construction activities.
* Monitor **water supply pipeline** laying, testing, and commissioning activities.
* Assist in execution and supervision of **Underground Drainage (UGD)** works.
* Assist in **Sewage Treatment Plant (STP)** construction activities.
* Monitor **sewerage pipeline** laying and testing activities.
* Assist in supervision of **RCC works**, including foundations, tanks, chambers, and other civil structures.
* Conduct basic **quality inspections** under the guidance of senior engineers.
* Assist with **material testing** and maintain quality records.
* Assist in preparing and checking **Bar Bending Schedules (BBS)**.
* Assist in preparing **quantity estimates, measurements, and rate analysis**.
* Assist in preparation and verification of **client bills, RA bills, and subcontractor bills**.
* Maintain **Measurement Books (MB), DPRs, site records, and daily progress reports**.
* Assist in monitoring project progress as per drawings, specifications, and project schedules.
* Coordinate with **contractors, subcontractors, site workers, and senior engineers**.
* Assist in coordinating civil works related to **electro\-mechanical installations** at WTPs and STPs.
* Ensure proper documentation of site activities and maintain project records.
* Follow **quality, safety, and company procedures** at the project site.
* Learn and apply relevant **IS Codes, technical specifications, and construction practices**.

Required Qualifications

* **Bachelor's Degree (B.E./B.Tech) in Civil Engineering.**
* **Freshers are encouraged to apply.**
* Strong academic knowledge of basic civil engineering concepts.
* Willingness to work at project sites and learn practical construction activities.
* Candidates with internship or academic project experience in **civil infrastructure, water supply, sewerage, or construction** will be preferred.

Required Skills

* Basic knowledge of **Civil Engineering and construction practices**.
* Basic understanding of **Water Supply Schemes (WSS)** and **Underground Drainage (UGD)**.
* Basic knowledge of **WTP, STP, ESR, and pipeline construction**.
* Understanding of **RCC construction** and reinforcement works.
* Basic knowledge of **quantity estimation and measurements**.
* Basic understanding of **Bar Bending Schedule (BBS)**.
* Basic knowledge of **AutoCAD, MS Excel, and MS Office**.
* Good communication and coordination skills.
* Good numerical and analytical abilities.
* Willingness to learn new technical skills and construction methods.
* Ability to work effectively in a **site\-based environment**.
* Ability to work as part of a team and meet project deadlines.

Preferred Skills

* Internship experience in **construction or infrastructure projects**.
* Basic knowledge of **WSS, UGD, WTP, STP, and pipeline projects**.
* Knowledge of **IS Codes and PWD/CPWD specifications** will be an advantage.
* Basic understanding of **tender documents, BOQ, estimation, and billing**.
* Familiarity with **AutoCAD and MS Excel**.
* Strong interest in learning **site execution and project management**.

Key Competencies

* Site Supervision
* Project Execution Support
* Quality Control
* Quantity Measurement
* Estimation \& Billing Support
* Technical Documentation
* Teamwork
* Client \& Contractor Coordination
* Time Management
* Problem Solving
* Communication Skills
* Willingness to Learn

Career Opportunity

This role is an excellent opportunity for a **Civil Engineering Fresher** to gain practical experience in **water supply, sewerage, WTP, STP, pipeline, RCC, estimation, billing, and infrastructure project execution**. The selected candidate will receive practical exposure by working under experienced engineers and will have the opportunity to develop strong technical and project management skills.

**Mohit Plaza, First Floor, Waghapur Road, Sambhaji Nagar, Yavatmal – 445001**

**Work Mode:** In Person

**Job Description:**

**Job Title: Site Engineer**

**Location: Kerala, Tamilnadu, Karnataka**

**Company: Bilara Group**

**About BILARA GROUP**

BILARA GROUP is an architectural and construction company based in Kochi, Kerala, known for its innovative design solutions and high\-quality construction services. We specialize in delivering residential projects that stand out for their precision, craftsmanship, and sustainability.

**Position Overview**

We are looking for a highly skilled Civil Site Engineer to join our dynamic team. The ideal candidate will be responsible for managing the construction site’s day\-to\-day operations, ensuring the project’s adherence to design specifications, safety standards, timelines, and quality requirements.

As a Civil Site Engineer at BILARA GROUP, you will work closely with project managers, architects, and contractors to deliver exceptional construction projects.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Site Management:** Oversee and manage all activities on the construction site, ensuring the project progresses according to the schedule, within budget, and in compliance with safety and quality standards.
* **Coordination with Teams:** Work closely with architects, subcontractors, and laborers to ensure smooth execution of construction plans.
* **Quality Control:** Conduct regular inspections to ensure work is being carried out to the highest standards. Monitor material quality and workmanship to meet required specifications.
* **Site Supervision:** Supervise and lead a team of laborers and technical staff, providing guidance and resolving any on\-site issues.
* **Project Documentation:** Maintain accurate and up\-to\-date records of construction progress, materials, and manpower. Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly progress reports.
* **Compliance with Safety Standards:** Ensure strict adherence to safety regulations, conduct safety audits, and implement necessary corrective actions.
* **Liaison with Clients and Contractors:** Communicate regularly with clients, suppliers, and contractors to keep them informed on project developments and resolve any issues that may arise.
* **Budget and Resource Management:** Monitor the consumption of materials and equipment, ensuring optimum utilization of resources to avoid cost overruns.
* **Problem\-Solving:** Address any technical, logistical, or manpower challenges encountered during the construction process.

**Required Qualifications**

* **Education:** Bachelor’s degree or Diploma in Civil Engineering or related field.
* **Experience:** 0\-4 Years (Freshers can also apply)

**Skills**

* Proficiency in project management software (AutoCAD, MS Project, etc.)
* Strong knowledge of construction processes, materials, and legal regulations.
* Excellent problem\-solving, organizational, and communication skills.
* Ability to work under pressure and meet tight deadlines.
* Ready to travel

**Benefits**

* Competitive salary and performance\-based incentives.
* Opportunity to work on high\-profile, challenging projects.
* Professional development and career growth opportunities.
* Friendly and collaborative work environment.

title: Project Manager - EPMO
description:
Avance Clinical is a Contract Research Organisation which offers specialised services supporting drug development for the pharmaceutical and biotechnology industry.
   

  

 The Project Manager \- EPMO will be responsible for managing the planning and execution of internal projects assigned within Avance Clinical's Enterprise Project Management Office (EPMO). Operating within the EPMO's tiered governance model, the Project Manager will be allocated projects from Tier 1 (Explore), Tier 2 (Build), or Tier 3 (Transform) relative to their experience, certifications and demonstrated delivery capability — scaling responsibility as they grow within the function. The role applies established project management principles to ensure consistent, disciplined delivery across the portfolio, and contributes to the EPMO's benefits realisation framework to help measure and report the return on investment of internal initiatives.
   

  

**Core Responsibilities** 
  

  

* Lead allocated EPMO projects — Tier 1 (Explore), Tier 2 (Build) or Tier 3 (Transform) — based on experience and demonstrated capability. This includes development and execution of scope, schedule, budget, resource, risk, change, communications and stakeholder management plans, applied proportionate to project tier and complexity.
* Apply consistent project management principles across all allocated projects, working within the EPMO's flexible delivery framework and adhering to its intake, scoring, governance, reporting and closeout standards.
* For Tier 2 initiatives, partner with the nominated business sponsor to develop and refine concise business cases, ensuring scope, rationale, cost, effort and expected return on investment are clearly articulated and aligned with EPMO scoring criteria.
* For Tier 3 initiatives, deliver under the strategic oversight of the EPMO Director, ensuring full governance is observed and that the named ELT sponsor is appropriately engaged throughout the project lifecycle.
* Contribute to the EPMO's benefits realisation framework — capturing baseline measures at planning, tracking realised benefits through delivery, and providing inputs to the EPMO's ROI and outcomes reporting back to ELT.
* Maintain accurate, current project records in the EPMO portfolio dashboard, including status, resourcing, risks, issues, dependencies, scope changes and benefits\-tracking data.
* Facilitate the requirements gathering, solution design, configuration, testing, training and change management activities required for successful project delivery, working collaboratively with subject matter experts and vendors.
* Identify and escalate emerging risks, scope changes or threshold breaches (effort, cost, dependency) that may trigger tier escalation, in line with the EPMO operating model.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams including IT, Technology and Innovation, Quality and Compliance, Finance, Clinical Operations and Senior Management to negotiate resource commitments and ensure on\-time delivery of projects.
* Manage external vendors associated with project deliverables, ensuring scope, schedule and contractual obligations are met.
* Provide regular project status updates and portfolio inputs to the EPMO Director, and contribute to monthly ELT portfolio reporting packs.
* Support continuous improvement of the EPMO's tools, templates, processes and benefits\-tracking methods through feedback, adoption discipline and lessons learned.
* Other duties as directed by Line Management or delegate in line with skills, experience and/or qualifications. Qualifications, Skills and Experience
+ Ordinary degree or equivalent in an appropriate discipline and appropriate industry experience.
+ Bachelor's degree in Project Management, Business, Computer Science or other relevant discipline, and/or recognised project management certifications (e.g. PMP, PRINCE2, Agile/Scrum). Higher tier projects will typically require more advanced qualifications and demonstrated delivery track record.
+ Demonstrated project management experience scaled to the tier of project to be managed:
+ Tier 1 (Explore): early\-career project management experience or relevant transferable experience supporting small, single\-team initiatives.
+ Tier 2 (Build): a minimum of 3 years managing cross\-functional internal projects with named sponsors and defined business cases.
+ Tier 3 (Transform): a minimum of 5 years managing strategic, multi\-stream or transformation projects with executive\-level reporting and accountability for benefits delivery.
+ Experience contributing to benefits realisation, ROI measurement or outcomes reporting frameworks is highly desirable.
+ Experience managing technology, systems integration, ERP, CRM or business process transformation projects will be highly regarded given Avance's current strategic roadmap.
+ Strong working knowledge of established project management methodologies (waterfall, agile and hybrid) and the judgment to apply them proportionate to project size and complexity.

description:
**Senior Scrum Master** 




**Locations:** 
 Indore, Madhya Pradesh
 



**Work Arrangement:** 
 Office\-based
 



**Role Type:** 
 Full\-time
 



**About Ascentt** 




 Ascentt is a technology consulting and AI services firm that partners with global enterprises to deliver complex data, AI, and digital transformation programs. Our teams work directly with enterprise client stakeholders on high\-visibility engagements where delivery discipline, transparency, and outcomes matter. We offer a collaborative environment, direct exposure to global clients, and the opportunity to shape how modern Agile delivery works on AI\-driven programs.
 



**Role Overview** 




 As a Senior Scrum Master at Ascentt, you will lead the Agile delivery of one cross\-functional Scrum team building technology and AI\-driven solutions for enterprise clients.
 



 This is a hands\-on Agile leadership role. The delivery environment entails enterprise\-scale programs, cross\-team dependencies, and direct engagement with client stakeholders. The seniority of this role lies in the judgment it requires, knowing when to coach, when to facilitate, when to challenge, and when to escalate.
 



 We are looking for someone who
 **leans into problems, engages the right people, drives closure, challenges teams constructively, and operates comfortably with internal and client stakeholders.** 




**Work Location \& Client Collaboration** 




 This is an
 **office\-based position** 
 at Ascentt's Indore or Pune location. Regular presence in the office is required.
 



 Because Ascentt works with global enterprise clients, the Senior Scrum Master will need the flexibility to
 **overlap with U.S. client working hours as needed** 
 for Agile ceremonies, stakeholder discussions, planning sessions, and issue resolution.
 



**Key Responsibilities** 




**Agile Leadership \& Scrum Execution** 



* Serve as Scrum Master for one cross\-functional Agile delivery team, leading sprint planning, daily stand\-ups, backlog refinement, sprint reviews, and retrospectives.
* Ensure ceremonies produce clear decisions, commitments, and actions — and that the team establishes and stays focused on clear sprint goals.
* Apply Scrum and Agile principles pragmatically, promoting transparency, accountability, and shared ownership while protecting the team from unnecessary disruption.



**Sprint \& Backlog Readiness** 



* Partner with the Product Owner to maintain a healthy, prioritized, appropriately refined backlog.
* Surface unclear requirements, unresolved questions, dependencies, and readiness gaps before work enters a sprint.
* Facilitate sprint planning grounded in priorities, team capacity, and dependencies.



**Impediments, Risks \& Dependencies** 



* Proactively identify impediments, risks, dependencies, and emerging delivery challenges, early enough for the team to manage their impact.
* Drive issues to resolution with clear ownership, actions, and follow\-through, bringing in the right people when decisions or support are needed beyond the team.
* Escalate significant impediments with clear context, impact, and required action.



**Delivery Visibility \& Predictability** 



* Maintain transparency into sprint progress, capacity, backlog health, risks, and dependencies, and flag early when commitments are at risk.
* Use Agile metrics (predictability, carryover, cycle time, throughput) to to identify trends and drive team improvement.
* Give stakeholders appropriate visibility into delivery status.



**Coaching \& Continuous Improvement** 



* Coach the team on Agile principles, accountability, and effective performance of their roles.
* Facilitate retrospectives that produce meaningful, followed\-through improvement actions, and address recurring problems at their root cause.
* Progressively builds the team's maturity and self\-organization so it depends less on the Scrum Master for routine execution.



**Stakeholder \& Cross\-Team Collaboration** 



* Build effective relationships with Product Owners, technical leaders, and internal and client stakeholders; communicate progress, risks, and decisions clearly and proactively.
* Facilitate alignment between business and technical stakeholders, including difficult conversations, moving participants toward clear decisions.
* Coordinate with other Scrum Masters and teams where dependencies exist and contribute lessons learned to Ascentt's broader Agile delivery practice.



**Required Qualifications** 



* 8\+ years of overall experience in software development or technology delivery environments.
* 4\+ years of hands\-on experience as a Scrum Master or Agile delivery leader for cross\-functional software or technology teams.
* Demonstrated experience facilitating the full set of Scrum ceremonies and applying Agile principles in real\-world delivery environments.
* Strong track record identifying and driving resolution of impediments, delivery risks, and cross\-team dependencies.
* Working knowledge of Agile delivery metrics and their appropriate use in improving predictability and team effectiveness.
* Proficiency with Jira or comparable Agile work\-management tools.
* Strong facilitation, coaching, communication, and conflict\-resolution skills, with the ability to engage confidently with both technical and business stakeholders.
* Experience in distributed or global delivery environments, with flexibility to overlap with U.S. client hours as required.



**Preferred Qualifications** 



* CSM, PSM, SAFe Scrum Master, PMI\-ACP, or comparable Agile certification.
* Experience with enterprise clients in a consulting environment.
* Exposure to AI, Generative AI, data, cloud, or other emerging\-technology delivery environments.
* Experience in automotive, manufacturing, or related industries.



**What Success Looks Like** 




 A successful Senior Scrum Master creates an environment in which:
 


* Sprint goals are clear, and the team enters sprints with well\-understood, prepared work.
* Risks, dependencies, and impediments surface early, have clear owners, and are driven to resolution.
* Sprint commitments become increasingly realistic and predictable.
* Stakeholders have the visibility they need without unnecessary reporting overhead.
* Retrospectives lead to observable improvements, and recurring problems are fixed at the root.
* The team grows progressively more self\-organizing, collaborative, and accountable.



 Ultimately, the Senior Scrum Master's impact is visible in the team's ability to anticipate and resolve delivery challenges, make better decisions, and consistently deliver valuable outcomes.

title: Quality Assurance Specialist
description:
Job Description – PMO \+ QA Analyst
 



**Role:** 
 PMO \+ QA Analyst
 



**Experience:** 
 1–3 Years
 



**Location:** 
 Bengaluru
 



**Employment Type:** 
 Full\-time
 



  





 About the Role
 



  





 We are looking for a
 **PMO \+ QA Analyst** 
 who can work across Project Management and Quality Assurance functions. The role requires a combination of
 **QA execution, project coordination, release management, stakeholder coordination, reporting, and quality governance** 
 .
 



 The candidate will work closely with Product, Engineering, QA, and Business teams to ensure features and projects are delivered
 **on time and with the expected quality** 
 .
 



 The ideal candidate should be comfortable managing multiple workstreams, tracking project progress, identifying risks and dependencies, coordinating with stakeholders, and independently driving QA activities for assigned features/releases.
 



  





 Key Responsibilities
 



  





 PMO \& Project Management
 


* Track project, sprint, feature, and release timelines.
* Maintain project trackers, sprint trackers, dashboards, and action\-item trackers.
* Monitor progress against planned timelines and highlight deviations.
* Track
 **risks, assumptions, issues, dependencies, and blockers (RAID)** 
 .
* Coordinate with Product, Engineering, QA, and other stakeholders to ensure timely completion of activities.
* Follow up on pending tasks and ensure closure of action items.
* Coordinate sprint planning, daily stand\-ups, retrospectives, release discussions, and project meetings.
* Track feature readiness across different stages of the SDLC.
* Monitor dependencies between Product, Development, QA, vendors, and other teams.
* Prepare and circulate regular project/sprint status reports.
* Escalate risks, blockers, and timeline concerns to relevant stakeholders.
* Support planning and tracking of multiple projects/releases simultaneously.



 QA \& Quality Assurance
 


* Review
 **PRDs, user stories, functional requirements, and acceptance criteria** 
 .
* Identify requirement gaps, ambiguities, edge cases, and dependencies before development/testing.
* Prepare and review test scenarios and detailed test cases.
* Execute and coordinate
 **functional, regression, smoke, sanity, integration, and end\-to\-end testing** 
 .
* Perform API testing using tools such as
 **Postman** 
 .
* Validate UI, API responses, business rules, validations, and end\-to\-end workflows.
* Log detailed defects in JIRA with clear steps to reproduce, expected vs actual results, severity, and supporting evidence.
* Track defects through the complete lifecycle and coordinate with Development/Product teams for resolution.
* Perform defect retesting and regression after fixes.
* Validate fixes across relevant environments.
* Monitor QA progress and identify testing risks or gaps.
* Maintain QA metrics such as test execution status, defect status, open blockers, and release readiness.
* Support production issue investigation and RCA activities.
* Ensure adequate regression coverage before releases.



 Release \& Production Readiness
 


* Coordinate QA activities for planned releases.
* Track feature readiness across
 **Development, UAT, Pre\-Production, and Production** 
 environments.
* Ensure required QA activities and documentation are completed before release.
* Track test execution, open defects, blockers, and pending dependencies before release.
* Coordinate QA sign\-off/release readiness with relevant stakeholders.
* Support production deployment validation and post\-release verification.
* Track production issues and ensure appropriate RCA and closure.
* Maintain release documentation, test reports, and sign\-off records.



 Quality \& Process Improvement
 


* Identify gaps in existing QA and project execution processes.
* Recommend improvements to testing, tracking, documentation, and release processes.
* Ensure standard QA and PMO processes are followed across projects.
* Identify recurring defects, process gaps, and quality risks.
* Contribute to improving test coverage and release quality.
* Help establish and maintain project and QA metrics.
* Support implementation of quality gates and production\-readiness checks.



  





 Required Skills
 


* **1–3 years of experience** 
 in QA, PMO, Project Coordination, or a combination of these.
* Strong understanding of
 **SDLC, STLC, Agile/Scrum, and software delivery lifecycle** 
 .
* Hands\-on experience with functional and regression testing.
* Experience in API testing using
 **Postman** 
 or similar tools.
* Good knowledge of
 **JIRA** 
 and project/task tracking.
* Strong knowledge of
 **Excel / Google Sheets** 
 and reporting.
* Good understanding of defect lifecycle and release management.
* Ability to review requirements and identify gaps.
* Strong communication and stakeholder\-management skills.
* Ability to manage multiple projects, features, and priorities simultaneously.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Excellent documentation and follow\-up skills.



 Good to Have
 


* Knowledge of
 **SQL/MongoDB** 
 .
* Experience with automation tools such as
 **Selenium, TestNG, Karate, or REST Assured** 
 .
* Basic understanding of performance/load testing.
* Experience with CI/CD tools such as Jenkins.
* Experience with monitoring/logging tools such as Kibana.
* Experience working with API\-driven products.
* Experience in
 **FinTech, Banking, SaaS, or enterprise technology products** 
 .
* Understanding of production\-readiness and release\-governance processes.



 Key Competencies
 


* **Ownership:** 
 Takes responsibility for assigned features, releases, and deliverables.
* **Coordination:** 
 Effectively works with Product, Development, QA, and Business teams.
* **Attention to Detail:** 
 Identifies requirement, testing, and process gaps.
* **Communication:** 
 Clearly communicates progress, risks, blockers, and dependencies.
* **Problem Solving:** 
 Investigates issues and drives them toward resolution.
* **Planning:** 
 Can prioritize and manage multiple activities simultaneously.
* **Quality Mindset:** 
 Focuses on preventing issues rather than only identifying defects.
* **Execution:** 
 Ensures planned activities are tracked through completion.



  





 Success in This Role
 



  





 The person should be able to independently:
 



  




* Drive QA activities for assigned features/releases.
* Maintain accurate project and QA trackers.
* Identify and escalate risks, blockers, and dependencies.
* Coordinate effectively with Product, Engineering, QA, and other stakeholders.
* Ensure testing and release activities are completed on schedule.
* Provide clear visibility into
 **project status, quality status, and release readiness** 
 .
* Contribute to improving the overall QA and project execution process

**About Avaz** 





 Avaz AAC is an Augmentative and Alternative Communication app that gives children and adults with disabilities such as autism, cerebral palsy, Down syndrome, aphasia and apraxia a voice of their own to communicate and build meaningful connections. Avaz AAC is a picture\- and text\-based communication app designed for children and adults with complex communication needs.
 





 Our mission is to make effective communication accessible to every person who needs it. Achieving this requires us to understand communicators and their support networks deeply, translate that understanding into reliable products and continuously improve the communication experience.
 




  





**About the team** 





 We are a team of passionate individuals working towards a more accessible and inclusive world where everyone has the opportunity to communicate and be heard. Our product team brings together product managers, designers, developers and QA, with empathy at the centre of how we work.
 





 We create space for fresh ideas, different perspectives and thoughtful experimentation. Team members are encouraged to question assumptions, explore new approaches and learn directly from the people who use our products. We believe meaningful innovation comes from combining curiosity, open collaboration and a deep understanding of our users.
 




  





**What you’ll do** 





 Own the end\-to\-end design process for Avaz AAC and other upcoming apps and portals in the Avaz suite. You will take products and features from early research and problem definition through interaction design, visual design, prototyping, developer handoff, implementation review and post\-launch iteration.
 





 You will work closely with product managers, developers and QA to translate complex communication needs into intuitive, accessible and dependable product experiences across Android, iOS and web platforms.
 




  





**Role and Responsibilities** 



* Own the end\-to\-end design of Avaz AAC and other upcoming apps and portals in the Avaz suite, from initial concepts to shipped product state.
* Learn directly from users: run research and usability tests, watch how people use what you ship, and turn what you find into clear design decisions.
* Work closely with product managers to convert product requirements and user needs into user flows, prototypes, and high\-fidelity interface design.
* Design mobile experiences for Android and iOS while accounting for platform conventions, device variations, screen sizes and interaction patterns.
* Build and grow a shared design system across Avaz products so the experience stays consistent as we scale.
* Work closely with developers and QA while the product is being built, so what ships matches the design.



  





**Skills and Attributes** 



* 2 to 3 years of experience in product design, UI/UX design or a related digital design role.
* Demonstrated experience designing mobile applications for both Android and iOS.
* Strong proficiency in Figma, including components, variants, prototypes, libraries and developer handoff.
* Strong understanding of user\-centred design, interaction design, information architecture and visual\-interface design.
* Ability to translate complex requirements and varied user needs into clear, intuitive and implementable design solutions.
* Strong collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to explain design decisions and work effectively with product managers, developers and QA.



  





**Good to have** 



* Experience designing AAC, assistive technology, health technology, special\-education products or products for people with diverse access needs.
* Experience designing emotionally sensitive user experiences and conversational interactions, including dialogue flows, tone, prompts, responses and feedback.
* Familiarity with WCAG, Apple Accessibility, Android Accessibility, screen readers or other alternative access methods.
* Experience creating or maintaining a design system or UI/UX style guide.
* Familiarity with front\-end development workflows and the technical considerations involved in implementing interface designs.

title: Technical Writer
description:
**About Neo** 




 AI is the most significant shift in how work gets done since the advent of the Internet — yet most organizations fail to capture its value.
 **Neo** 
 is changing that.
 



 Founded by
 **Bhavin Turakhia**
 — Co\-Founder of

 **Neo** 
 is building an integrated, AI\-first suite of products that capture work, centralize context, and make AI a first\-class participant in every workflow:
 


* Tasket — A radically reimagined, AI\-native work management platform that centralizes context and makes AI delegation seamless for all work.
* Friday — AI Assistant, co\-worker and agent platform, pre\-integrated into Tasket, Studio, Drive and 1000\+ SaaS platforms.
* Studio — AI\-native suite for co\-creating docs, spreadsheets and diagrams collaboratively with humans and agents.
* Drive — AI\-native repository, where humans and agents can co\-work on files.
* Scribe — AI assistant for meetings that goes beyond note\-taking and actually does your work while on the call.



  





**About the Role** 




 We want someone whose job is turning PRDs and product context into documentation — and building the automation that makes that scale.
 



 You are someone who reads a spec closely, understands what a user or engineer actually needs to know, and writes it clearly. But you don't stop at writing docs one at a time: you build repeatable workflows — skill files, prompt templates, structured inputs — that let AI tools generate consistent first drafts from PRDs, tickets, and changelogs, which you then refine and own.
 



 This is a hands\-on, build\-the\-system role. It's not a pure writing job where you manually draft every page, and it's not a pure engineering job either — it's the combination: strong writing judgment paired with an automation mindset.
 



  





**Responsibilities** 




 • Read PRDs and engineering specs, and translate them into clear technical documentation — user guides, release notes, API docs, internal runbooks
 



 • Design and build documentation automations: skill files, prompt templates, and scripts that let AI tools generate consistent first\-draft docs from structured inputs
 



 • Maintain and improve those automations over time as our product and doc formats evolve
 



 • Edit and fact\-check AI\-generated drafts against source material — you're accountable for accuracy, not just fluency
 



 • Organize documentation in our workspace tools and keep information architecture clean and findable
 



 • Partner closely with PMs and engineers to fill documentation gaps and flag when a PRD lacks the detail needed to write accurate docs
 



 • Continuously push on documentation methodology and tooling as our products evolve
 



  





**Skills** 




 • Strong written communication — this is a writing\-first role; verbal fluency alone won't cut it
 



 • Technical fluency: able to read a PRD or API spec and understand it well enough to explain it accurately
 



 • Hands\-on use of AI: real experience using AI assistants for actual work, with a clear sense of what "skills"/prompts/context files are and how to build with them
 



 • Working understanding of project management and workspace tools (Confluence, Jira, Notion, or similar)
 



 • Genuine curiosity about systems and process — an instinct to automate the repeatable parts of a workflow
 



 • Comfortable with ambiguity and moving quickly
 



  





**Experience and Qualifications** 




 • Around 1–2 years of experience in technical writing, content engineering, developer relations, QA, or a similar technical\-adjacent role. Strong internship experience counts.
 



 • Exposure to product development or working alongside a product/engineering team
 



 • A background in computer science/engineering, or another field (journalism, English, technical support) paired with demonstrated technical comprehension — no specific degree required
 



  





**Equal Opportunity** 




 Neo is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We encourage applicants from all backgrounds, cultures, and communities to apply and believe that a diverse workforce is key to our success.

title: Customer Success Specialist (B2B AI SaaS)
description:
**About the role** 




  





 You'll be the person who takes a signed client from "we just bought this" to "this is running and driving results." At JoyzAI, that means standing up their AI chatbot and AI calling agents end\-to\-end — building the knowledge base, configuring the agent's behaviour, wiring up the lead and CRM flows, and then staying with them so the product actually delivers.
 



  





 This is not a ticket\-closing role. It's a build\-and\-own role. You're technical enough to configure agents yourself, and human enough to make clients feel taken care of at every step. You delight customers by solving the real problem, not by marking a query "resolved."
 



  





 What you'll do
 



  





**Onboarding \& agent setup** 



* Own new\-client onboarding from kickoff to go\-live: scope the use case, gather source material, and set clear delivery timelines.
* Build and structure knowledge bases from client content (websites, brochures, PDFs, FAQs) so the AI answers accurately and on\-brand.
* Configure AI chatbot and AI calling agents across the platform — Tasks, Access, Behaviour, and AI Config — including prompt design, conversation flows, guardrails, and tone (including Hinglish where needed).
* Set up CRM contact fields, ticket types, and automated workflows so leads and conversations route correctly.
* Configure voice agent call handling — greetings, one\-question\-per\-turn flows, voicemail/no\-answer/silence fallbacks, and WhatsApp follow\-ups for links and addresses.



  





**Integrations \& data flow** 



* Wire up lead pipelines — e.g. Meta lead forms → Joyz webhook, Google Sheets automations — and validate that phone/contact data lands clean and deduplicated.
* Coordinate WhatsApp Business API setup with clients (WABA, embedded signup, number provisioning) and troubleshoot access or restriction issues.
* Assist with booking, calendar, and payment integrations where the client's flow requires them.



  





**Ongoing success** 



* Run demos, walkthroughs, and handover sessions so clients can self\-serve confidently.
* Monitor live agent performance, catch weak answers or broken flows, and iterate on prompts and KB content.
* Troubleshoot issues technically before escalating — reproduce, diagnose, and fix where you can.
* Track client health, drive adoption, and surface expansion or churn signals to the team.



  





 Roughly 75% of your time is hands\-on build: software configuration, AI agent design, and API integrations into whatever the client already runs. CRM, ERP, Google Sheets, calendars, WhatsApp, and the odd internal tool nobody has documented.
 



  





 The other 25% is sitting with the client, understanding how their business actually works, and figuring out where our software can move a number that matters to them.
 



  





 That split shifts as the product matures. Expect it to land closer to 60/40 within two years, with more of your time spent on the thinking and less on the plumbing.
 



  





 We're under 15 people building AI calling agents. This is not a comfortable corporate job. You'll be in the trenches, you'll work hard, and you'll compress ten years of ordinary career growth into two (this means salary growth also, not just more work).
 



  





**What We’re Looking For** 




  





 We don't care too much about experience or degree as long as you have what it takes to do the job.
 



  





**Why JoyzAI?** 




 ✨
 **Utmost freedom and autonomy** 
 — to make decisions. You are the taskmaster, do it the way you think is best. We will only suggest.
 



 ✨
 **Complete responsibility** 
 . You are the taskmaster. Take responsibility for it.
 



 ✨
 **Top\-of\-the\-market pay** 
 – we reward high performance with the best packages.
 



 ✨
 **5\-day working** 
 – weekends are yours to recharge.
 



 ✨
 **Work from office in Noida** 
 – collaborate, learn, and grow with a passionate team.
 



 ✨
 **High\-growth startup** 
 – opportunity to be see first hand how AI brings change and be a part of that.

title: Game Designer
description:
We’re looking for a sharp, highly driven game designer who knows mobile free\-to\-play games inside out and is genuinely excited about building AI games. If you can take an idea from a rough prototype to a live game players love, we want to talk.
 



  





**Our mission:** 




 We want to build the first globally competitive games studio out of India, one that can go head to head with Timi/Tencent, Supercell, and Activision Blizzard.
 



 Greatness, for us, means taking on hard problems and refusing to settle. We care about it in the games we ship, and even more in the people and the company we’re building. We’re not there yet. We’re looking for someone exceptional to help us get there.
 



  





**Role \& key responsibilities:** 




 Veteran or up\-and\-comer. What we care about is your skill, your drive, and how much you love games.
 


* **Design for mobile free\-to\-play.** 
 Own gameplay, core loops, progression, and metagame for our mobile F2P games, across midcore, RPG, roguelike, and whatever genre fits the idea. Build systems that hook players in the first session and keep them coming back for months: retention, economy, and a session flow that feels right on a phone.
* **Take games from idea to live.** 
 Prototype fast, test, ship. You’ll be hands\-on across the whole arc, from early prototype through soft launch and into live operation, and you’ll drive the game from concept to live, not just individual features.
* **Build with AI by default.** 
 Use AI as a core part of how you work, not a bolt\-on. Prototype mechanics, generate and test content, and tighten your iteration loop with it. And because we build AI games, you’ll help design experiences that only work
 *because* 
 AI sits at the center of them. We expect you to stay ahead of what these tools can do.
* **Design documentation.** 
 Write clear specs and feature docs that tell the team exactly how a mechanic, system, control, or piece of content should work.
* **Quality \& polish.** 
 Hold the quality bar. Work closely with engineers and artists so every feature and asset feels great in players’ hands.
* **Market analysis.** 
 Study the top mobile F2P games across genres. Pull apart what makes them work, from monetization to live\-ops to feature design, and turn that into sharp breakdowns that feed our own decisions.
* **Playtesting \& feedback.** 
 Run internal and external playtests. Gather feedback and gameplay data, read what players are actually telling you, and iterate.



  





**What we’re looking for:** 



* **You live in mobile F2P.** 
 You play the best mobile F2P games and understand why they make money and why people stay. Economy, retention, and monetization aren’t mysteries; they’re how you think about design.
* **You’re a builder who ships.** 
 You’ve taken something from nothing to done. You’d rather get a rough version in front of players this week than polish a doc for a month.
* **You’re genuinely pro\-AI.** 
 You’re excited about AI in games and in the craft of making them. You try new tools, find where they give you an edge, and you’re drawn to the kinds of games AI now makes possible.
* **High IQ and problem\-solving.** 
 Serious intellectual horsepower. You take messy design problems apart and come back with smart, systematic answers.
* **Clear, organized writer.** 
 You write specs other people can actually follow.
* **Curious and growth\-oriented.** 
 You’re always learning: new techniques, new games, new tools. You treat feedback and hard problems as the reason you’re here.
* **Analytical.** 
 You’re comfortable with data. You can break down a system or a pile of player feedback, find the pattern, and back your calls with reasoning.
* **Detail\-oriented.** 
 You sweat the small stuff that turns a good game into a great one.
* **Show us what you’ve built.** 
 Junior or senior, you have to demonstrate real design ability: shipped games, personal projects, mods, game jam entries, writing, anything that shows how you think and what you can make.

* **Experimentation \& Data** 
 : Ship features with instrumentation, run experiments, and iterate based on real player behavior and metrics.
* **Product Thinking** 
 : Evaluate what to build (and what not to) using data, player insight, and first\-principles thinking.



  





**What You'll Bring:** 




***Must\-Haves:***



* Strong engineering background (CS fundamentals, system design, debugging); ability to quickly pick up new tools and technologies
* Strong product instincts, you’ve built or shipped something and
 **learned from its success/failure**
* High IQ with the ability to address significant problems from first principles and in a well\-structured way.
* Massive attention to detail, ensuring you don’t miss any minor issues.
* Outstanding communication, collaboration, and leadership skills, with the ability to inspire teams and influence stakeholders at all levels.



  





***Nice\-to\-Haves:***



* Experience in mobile F2P product roles; shipped or operated a live\-service title.
* Proven track record of taking a prototype → live feature within a professional games studio environment.
* Hands\-on A/B testing, UA creative iteration, and basic ad monetization mechanics.
* Experience with game engines like Unity or similar interactive systems



  





**Why You'll Love It Here:** 



* **Impact:** 
 You will have a direct and measurable impact on our very ambitious game, shaping its visual identity and commercial success.
* **Ownership:** 
 You will be given the autonomy and resources to build and lead a high\-performance creative product vertical.
* **Innovation:** 
 You will be at the forefront of the industry, empowered to explore and implement cutting\-edge technologies like AI.
* **Culture:** 
 You will join a passionate, collaborative, and data\-informed team that values both creative excellence and business results.
* **Benefits:** 
 We offer a competitive salary, a comprehensive benefits package, and a work environment that strongly supports your professional growth.
