description:
**This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Data Analyst based in India.**
 Join a global service delivery team supporting data\-driven decision\-making across the maritime and shipping industry. In this role, you will collect, validate, analyze, and maintain critical information covering ports, terminals, berths, vessel movements, commodities, and shipping markets. Your work will help ensure that business intelligence systems contain accurate, timely, and relevant information for internal teams and international clients. You will research data across multiple sources, identify inconsistencies, and transform information into reliable business insights. The position combines structured data management with research, reporting, and collaboration across a globally distributed environment. It is well suited to a detail\-oriented professional who enjoys working with large volumes of information and contributing to high\-quality operational intelligence.
   

  

 Accountabilities
   

  

* Enter and maintain global port, terminal, and berth information from source documents within defined timelines.
* Collect information on port characteristics, operating parameters, restrictions, local regulations, cargo operations, navigation requirements, costs, and performance from agents, published materials, port websites, and other open sources.
* Compile, compare, verify, and organize information from multiple sources to ensure accuracy, consistency, and completeness.
* Analyze and validate collected data before adding or updating records within the business intelligence system.
* Serve as the key contact for assigned clients when providing requested information and supporting data\-related requirements.
* Update vessel port\-call information generated through AIS using emails, websites, and other reliable sources, with particular attention to cargo, quantities, and stakeholder information.
* Analyze and update commodity\-flow information using sources such as international trade organizations, customs websites, and other publicly available data.
* Prepare periodic reports, tracking sheets, and data summaries for clients and internal stakeholders.
* Collect and maintain shipping market news, trends, key developments, and relevant industry events from internal and external sources.
* Produce reports and highlight relevant market trends to support commercial teams and customers in making informed business decisions.
* Compile information in response to specific queries and locate relevant files and source documentation.
* Coordinate with clients and internal stakeholders to gather market information and identify appropriate internal and external data sources.
* Maintain a high level of accuracy, organization, confidentiality, and compliance when handling business information.

* Proven experience in data entry, data collection, and data management.

* Excellent communication skills, including strong written English and the ability to rephrase and present information clearly.

* Good organizational skills and the ability to remain focused and productive when managing repetitive or deadline\-driven tasks.

* Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with a dynamic, international team.
* Strong analytical mindset and willingness to investigate, validate, and improve data quality.
* Ability to manage assigned workloads within agreed timelines while maintaining consistent quality standards.
* Familiarity with Microsoft\-related certifications or professional training is a plus.

title: Training Specialist
description:
**Job Description** **ABOUT THE POSITION**


The Finance Operations Learning \& Capability Senior Specialist owns and continuously improves learning, onboarding and capability\-building experiences across Finance Operations. Based in Pune with a global remit, the role leads new\-hire onboarding and assimilation, professional\-skills learning, early\-career development, regional hub integration, knowledge\-sharing initiatives, competency\-framework activities, My Academy enablement, learning measurement and program governance.


The position partners with Finance leaders, process owners, subject\-matter experts, HR, Talent Acquisition and enabling teams to convert business needs into practical, engaging and scalable solutions. The role combines facilitation, program management, employee experience, digital learning, stakeholder coordination, analytical thinking and disciplined operational execution.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**1\. New\-hire onboarding, assimilation and employee experience**

* Own the end\-to\-end Finance Operations onboarding experience, including calendars, communications, facilitator scheduling, learning materials, assessments, feedback and follow\-up actions.
* Deliver and continuously improve organizational orientation, foundational Finance Operations learning and new\-hire assimilation activities.
* Coordinate with SDLs, GPOs, tower leaders, managers, subject\-matter experts, HR and global stakeholders to provide a consistent and relevant experience.
* Act as an accessible point of contact for new hires during onboarding and early assimilation, directing questions and escalating concerns to the appropriate owner.
* Coordinate transportation\-account creation and updates as part of onboarding, working with Transport, Facilities, vendors or administrative teams and maintaining accurate status tracking.
* Maintain onboarding trackers, attendance, completion records, assessment outcomes, stakeholder inputs and participant feedback during Onboarding.
* Develop reusable, blended and self\-paced assets that improve continuity and reduce dependency on individual facilitators.

**2\. Global hub integration, Bogotá Specific**

* Support the integration of the Bogotá hub into the broader Finance Operations learning and competency ecosystem, ensuring alignment with global standards while recognizing local needs.
* Partner with Bogotá leaders, trainers, subject\-matter experts and HR contacts to understand capability priorities, onboarding requirements, stakeholder expectations and cultural or language considerations.
* Coordinate cross\-hub learning calendars, knowledge\-sharing sessions, facilitator support and reusable assets across Pune, Bogotá and other Finance centres.
* Promote consistency in foundational learning, competency expectations and employee experience while allowing appropriate local adaptation.
* Track hub\-integration actions, dependencies, risks and feedback, and provide clear progress updates to Competency and Finance leadership.
* Enable transfer of good practices between hubs and maintain shared documentation so learning solutions can be reused and scaled globally.

**3\. Learning needs analysis and solution design**

* Construct structured discussions with leaders, managers and process owners to identify learning needs, capability gaps and desired business outcomes.
* Design and deliver classroom, virtual, self\-paced, e\-learning and micro\-learning solutions.
* Create/convert existing learning content such as DTP’s into e\-learnings.
* Translate complex Finance, organizational and behavioral concepts into clear and practical learning experiences.
* Create and maintain courses, facilitator guides, participant materials, videos, quizzes, scenarios, simulations, checklists, job aids, playbooks and toolkits.
* Develop rapid learning solutions such as communication templates and quick\-reference guides when the business requires timely support.
* Support Finance transformation, transition and knowledge\-transfer initiatives from a learning and capability perspective.

**4\. Competency framework and extended capability requirements**

* Partner with Finance leaders, process owners and HR to define and maintain relevant competency expectations for Finance Operations roles and career stages.
* Help translate role requirements into clear knowledge, skill and behavioural competency statements that can guide learning, development and career conversations.
* Support competency mapping, gap identification and prioritization across towers, teams, locations and employee segments.
* Connect identified competency gaps to appropriate curriculum, development pathways, learning assets, assessments or manager\-led interventions.
* Maintain competency\-related documentation, learning matrices and supporting resources, ensuring they remain current as roles, processes and technologies evolve.
* Provide data and qualitative insights on recurring capability needs to inform extended Competency priorities and future learning investments.
* Support communication and adoption of the competency framework so employees and managers understand how it can be used for development.

**5\. My Academy and digital learning enablement**

* Use My Academy as a central channel to support the extended learning and competency needs of Finance Operations.
* Coordinate the creation, curation, publication and maintenance of Finance Operations learning content, pathways, curriculum and supporting resources in My Academy.
* Partner with content owners and subject\-matter experts to validate course relevance, accuracy, ownership, review dates and intended learner audiences.
* Maintain content governance, naming conventions, version control and review cycles so learning resources remain current and easy to find.
* Support learner enrolment, assignment, campaign communication, completion follow\-up and reporting in collaboration with the relevant platform or LMS owners.
* Use available platform insights(Workday, Menti\-meter, Canva, MS\-Forms) to understand participation, completion, content usage and learning gaps, and recommend improvements to curriculum and learner journeys.
* Promote awareness and adoption of My Academy through onboarding, learning campaigns, manager communication and self\-directed development guidance.
* Identify opportunities to retire outdated or duplicate materials and improve the overall learner experience.

**6\. AI integration and learning innovation**

* Identify and pilot responsible AI use cases that improve learning design, content creation, knowledge access, communication, reporting and administrative efficiency.
* Use approved AI tools to support first drafts, summaries, quizzes, scenarios, learning aids and content repurposing, with appropriate subject\-matter review before publication.
* Explore AI\-enabled approaches for personalized learning recommendations, recurring\-question analysis, knowledge discovery and identification of content gaps.
* Partner with relevant technology, HR and governance stakeholders to ensure AI use complies with confidentiality, data\-protection, intellectual\-property and responsible\-use requirements.
* Document AI\-enabled workflows, quality checks, limitations and human\-review responsibilities to enable safe and repeatable adoption.
* Share practical AI guidance and good practices with trainers, content owners and the wider Competency community.

**7\. Personal excellence, soft skills and people development**

* Design and facilitate interventions in professional communication, stakeholder management, collaboration, problem solving, workplace effectiveness, business etiquette and personal excellence.
* Manage and publish the relevant learning calendar in partnership with Finance, Delivery, site leadership and HR.
* Facilitate programs for associates, interns, managers and other employee groups based on business priorities.
* Coach internal trainers and subject\-matter experts through facilitator guidance, preparation, observation and feedback.
* Promote a learning culture through practice, reflection, feedback, knowledge sharing and manager involvement.

**8\. Internship and early\-career development**

* Coordinate the development components of Finance Operations internship and early\-career programs from orientation through completion.
* Design and deliver classroom\-to\-corporate transition journeys, personal\-excellence learning, engagement activities, assessments and development checkpoints.
* Coordinate assessments and consolidate results and stakeholder inputs to support deployment and development discussions.
* Partner with managers, HR and Talent Acquisition on team allocation, progress monitoring, learning interventions and conversion\-readiness inputs.
* Maintain regular communication with interns and Intern Champions (Functional Managers), identify development or engagement risks and coordinate appropriate support.
* Ensure final hiring, rating, deployment and conversion decisions remain with authorized business and HR owners.

**9\. Knowledge management, Knowledge Nugget and communications**

* Prepare, curate and publish the recurring Knowledge Nugget, converting Finance, workplace, process or capability insights into concise and engaging communication.
* Coordinate topics and inputs with leaders and process experts, validate content before publication and maintain a forward content calendar and repository.
* Maintain learning manuals, playbooks, templates, knowledge\-transfer documents and reusable resources in accessible locations.
* Create clear communications for onboarding, learning programs, assessments, campaigns and development initiatives.
* Support learning\-related town halls, engagement events, videos, newsletters and wider Finance communications as agreed with stakeholders.
* Build participation through timely communication, purposeful branding and audience\-appropriate messaging.
* Manage the Procurement of Goodies for participants of any competency led engagement initiatives

**10\. Measurement, governance and stakeholder coordination**

* Define and track indicators such as volume, participation, completion, assessment results, feedback, content usage, recurring questions, competency gaps and agreed business measures.
* Prepare concise updates for senior stakeholders, highlighting outcomes, trends, risks, dependencies and recommended actions.
* Use quantitative and qualitative insights to improve content, delivery methods, learner journeys and program processes.
* Maintain accurate records, dashboards, content inventories, standard operating procedures and version control.
* Build trusted partnerships with Finance leaders, SDLs, GPOs, tower managers, Bogotá and other hub stakeholders, HR, Talent Acquisition, Transport, Facilities and platform owners.
* Clarify scope, ownership, timelines and dependencies for each initiative and communicate risks early.
* Coordinate internal contributors, facilitators and external vendors where required and manage competing priorities to agreed timelines.

  

**Qualifications** **CORE CAPABILITIES**


Learning Program Design


Onboarding \& Assimilation


Global Hub Integration


Competency Frameworks


My Academy / LMS Enablement


AI \& Digital Learning


Stakeholder Partnership


KPI Tracking \& Insights


Knowledge Management

**HOW SUCCESS WILL BE MEASURED:**

* Consistent, timely onboarding delivery, including accurate communications, completion tracking and transportation\-account coordination.
* Effective integration of Bogotá and other hubs into shared learning standards, resources and governance.
* Current and usable competency maps that connect identified needs to clear development actions.
* Well\-governed, accessible and actively used Finance Operations content and pathways in My Academy.
* Responsible AI pilots that demonstrate practical efficiency or learner\-experience benefits with documented controls.
* Reliable learning calendars, internship activities, Knowledge Nugget publications and stakeholder updates.
* Accurate reporting and evidence\-based improvement across learning, competency and employee\-experience initiatives.
* Reduced key\-person dependency through documented processes, reusable assets, shared ownership and effective handover.

**ROLE OWNERSHIP AND PARTNERSHIP BOUNDARIES:**

 **ROLE OWNS**

* Learning design and facilitation
* Onboarding operations
* Knowledge Nugget
* Learning records and reporting
* My Academy content governance

**COORDINATES / SUPPORTS**

* Bogotá hub integration
* Competency mapping
* AI pilots and adoption
* Transport\-account setup
* Intern assessments and development

**AUTHORIZED OWNER RETAINS**

* Formal HR policy interpretation
* Employee\-relations investigations
* Payroll and benefits
* Final hiring, rating or conversion decisions
* Technical Finance sign\-off

  

**Additional Information** **Our Benefits**

* Flexible working environment
* Volunteer time off
* LinkedIn Learning
* Employee\-Assistance\-Program (EAP)

description:
We are seeking an experienced and detail\-oriented **Payroll Manager** to manage end\-to\-end payroll operations for a group of companies under a leading Stock Broking and Financial Services organization. The role will be responsible for ensuring accurate and timely salary processing, statutory compliances, payroll audits, employee reimbursements, taxation, and payroll governance across multiple legal entities.

The ideal candidate should possess strong knowledge of payroll laws, labor compliance, taxation, and payroll software systems, with the ability to manage large employee populations across different business units.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Payroll Operations Management**

* Manage end\-to\-end monthly payroll processing for multiple group companies.
* Ensure timely and accurate salary disbursement, full and final settlements, incentives, bonus, variable pay, and arrears processing.
* Validate payroll inputs including attendance, leaves, overtime, incentives, reimbursements, deductions, and employee master data.
* Process payroll for new joiners, transfers, promotions, resignations, and terminations.
* Ensure payroll accuracy and maintain confidentiality of employee compensation data.

**Statutory Compliance \& Taxation**

* Ensure compliance with all statutory requirements including:
* Provident Fund (PF)
* Employee State Insurance (ESIC)
* Professional Tax (PT)
* Labour Welfare Fund (LWF)
* TDS on Salaries
* Gratuity and Bonus regulations
* Manage payroll\-related audits and statutory inspections.
* Ensure timely filing of statutory returns and payment of dues.
* Handle Form 16 generation and annual tax computations.

**Payroll Accounting \& Reconciliation**

* Coordinate with Finance department for payroll accounting entries.
* Reconcile payroll reports, statutory deductions, and salary payouts.
* Monitor payroll costs and provide management reports.
* Maintain payroll records and support internal and external audits.

**HRMS \& Payroll System Management**

* Manage payroll software and HRMS database.
* Ensure data accuracy, system updates, and payroll process improvements.
* Coordinate with payroll vendors and software service providers when required.
* Implement automation initiatives to enhance payroll efficiency.

**Employee Query Management**

* Resolve employee payroll\-related queries regarding salary, taxation, reimbursements, and deductions.
* Provide guidance on tax declarations and investment proofs.
* Maintain high service standards and employee satisfaction.

**Reporting \& MIS**

* Generate monthly payroll reports, cost analysis, and headcount reports.
* Prepare management dashboards related to payroll expenses and compliance.
* Provide payroll analytics and recommendations to leadership.

**Team Management**

* Lead and mentor payroll executives and payroll operations team.
* Establish payroll controls, SOPs, and compliance frameworks.
* Drive process improvements and best practices across group companies.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* 100% accurate and timely payroll processing.
* Zero payroll compliance penalties.
* Timely statutory filings and payments.
* Payroll closure within defined timelines.
* Employee query resolution within TAT.
* Successful completion of payroll audits.
* Payroll process automation and efficiency improvements.
* Employee satisfaction on payroll services.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's Degree in Commerce, Finance, HR, or related field.
* MBA/PGDM in HR or Finance preferred.
* Payroll certification will be an added advantage.

**Experience**

* 8\-12 years of payroll experience.
* Minimum 3\-5 years in managerial role.
* Experience handling payroll for multiple legal entities/group companies.
* Experience in Financial Services, Stock Broking, NBFC, Banking, Wealth Management, or BFSI sector preferred.

**Required Skills**

* Strong knowledge of Indian Payroll Laws and Labor Compliance.
* Expertise in Income Tax, TDS, PF, ESIC, PT, and payroll accounting.

As the HR Operations Regional Leader, you will play a key role in shaping an exceptional employee experience by driving efficient, scalable, and compliant HR and payroll operations across the region. Through strong leadership, process optimization, and collaboration with HR Centers of Expertise and business stakeholders, you will enhance service delivery, lead transformative initiatives, and leverage technology to simplify and improve the employee lifecycle. Your ability to balance operational excellence with continuous improvement will help build a high\-performing HR function that supports both business growth and employee success.

title: Product Lead, Benefits Marketplace & PEO
description:
**About Rippling**
------------------


Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.


Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third\-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds.


Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1\.85B\+ from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.

  

We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses.

**About the role**
------------------


Every year, employers and employees spend more than $5 trillion on benefits globally. These products—from health insurance and retirement to fertility, mental health, telemedicine, and financial wellness—shape some of the most important decisions families make. Yet discovering, purchasing, and managing them remains fragmented, expensive, and confusing.


Rippling is building the first modern benefits marketplace that connects brokers, employers, employees, and benefit providers in one platform. Our benefits vertical includes the Rippling Benefits Platform, a rapidly growing marketplace of more than 100 partners, Rippling\-native benefits products, and Rippling PEO.


We are looking for a Growth Product Lead, Benefits Marketplace \& PEO to turn these product assets into a scaled growth engine. You will own the strategy and product roadmap to unlock growth by expanding the customers and benefit categories Rippling can serve. This role will play a central role increasing marketplace adoption and revenue.


This is a highly cross\-functional, zero\-to\-one role at the intersection of product, growth and go\-to\-market. You will work with Engineering, Design, Sales, Marketing, Benefits Advisors, Business Development and Operations,. Success will be measured in business outcomes—including qualified demand, funnel conversion and revenue and not only in features shipped.

**What you'll do**
------------------

* Own the growth strategy and corresponding product roadmap for the Benefits Marketplace and PEO, with a clear mandate to expand the addressable market.
* Execute product led growth plan across benefit categories, geographies, employer profiles, and distribution channels.
* Expand the marketplace's addressable market by identifying and prioritizing new customer segments based on unmet demand, revenue potential, strategic deal unlocks, and Rippling's right to win.
* Expand awareness and consideration for the Benefits Marketplace by improving how employers discover, understand, compare, and evaluate relevant benefits.
* Accelerate PEO top\-of\-funnel growth by increasing awareness, improving education and discovery, and creating high\-intent entry points that generate and qualify demand across organic, in\-product, partner, broker, and sales\-led channels.
* Expand PEO's TAM by identifying customer profiles and market opportunities Rippling does not serve well today, then shaping the positioning, packaging, product entry points, and cross\-functional investments needed to reach them.
* Translate the growth strategy into clear product requirements, prioritized bets, channel plans, and measurable top\-of\-funnel experiments—while partnering closely with downstream owners on clean handoffs and shared learning.

**What you will need**
----------------------

* 8\+ years of product management experience, including meaningful ownership of growth in B2B products.
* A track record of delivering measurable business outcomes—such as revenue, conversion, retention, attach, adoption, supply growth — through a combination of product and go\-to\-market levers.
* Strong product judgment and commercial instincts: You can connect customer problems, market dynamics and growth strategy into coherent product capabilities.
* Excellent analytical skills: You can define a funnel, build a business case, segment customers and partners, evaluate experiments, and turn ambiguous data into clear decisions.
* Customer obsession: You are equally comfortable speaking with employers, employees, brokers, partners, sales teams, and operations —and translating their needs into scalable products.
* Strong technical fluency and systems thinking. You can work effectively with engineers on data models, integrations, AI\-powered workflows, operational tooling, and platform capabilities without losing sight of the customer or business outcome.
* Exceptional written and verbal communication, with the ability to align executives and cross\-functional teams around a strategy, metrics, priorities, and tradeoffs.
* A self\-starter with a bias toward action who thrives in a fast\-moving environment, creates clarity from ambiguity, and can shift between long\-range strategy and detailed execution.
* Experience in benefits, insurance, PEO, payroll, marketplaces, partner ecosystems, or B2B2C products is a strong plus.
* Founder or hypergrowth startup experience is a strong plus.
* Strong alignment with Rippling's leadership principles, especially Go and See and Are Right, a Lot.

title: ISO 27001 Audit Intern
description:
**Internship Duration:** 6 Months (Onsite)

**Location:** **Onsite (Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu) only candidates who would be able to relocate or are nearby are preferred**

**Function:** Governance, Risk \& Compliance (GRC) / Assurance / Audit

**Reports to:** Audit Manager / Lead Auditor / GRC Program Lead

**Role Summary :**

As a **GRC Audit Intern**, you will support audit teams in planning, evidence collection, testing, and reporting for management system and assurance engagements, including **ISO/IEC 27001 (ISMS), ISO/IEC 42001 (AIMS), ISO/IEC 27701 (PIMS), SOC 2**, and compliance assessments aligned to **HIPAA, GDPR, and India’s DPDP Act**. This is a hands\-on, onsite internship designed to build practical skills in audit execution, controls testing, and compliance documentation.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Audit Support \& Execution**

* Assist auditors during **onsite** audits: meeting notes, evidence walkthroughs, and coordination with client stakeholders.
* Support **audit planning** activities: scope understanding, sampling lists, and evidence requests.
* Perform **controls testing support** under supervision (design/implementation checks) for security, privacy, and AI governance controls.

**Evidence Collection \& Documentation**

* Collect and organize evidence (policies, SOPs, logs, tickets, screenshots, configurations, training records).
* Maintain evidence trackers and ensure proper naming, versioning, and traceability.
* Help map evidence to standard/framework requirements (clauses, controls, Trust Services Criteria, regulatory requirements).

**Gap Assessment \& Reporting**

* Support identification of gaps, observations, OFIs, and nonconformities with clear references.
* Draft sections of audit deliverables: checklists, working papers, meeting minutes, and summary notes.
* Assist with corrective action follow\-ups: tracking CAPA status and closure evidence.

**Tools \& Coordination**

* Update audit trackers, risk registers, SoA/controls mapping sheets, and project documentation repositories.
* Coordinate with internal teams for scheduling, logistics, and documentation completeness.
* Maintain confidentiality and follow internal information security policies at all times.

**Standards / Framework Exposure (During Internship)**

You may work across one or more of the following (based on project allocation):

* **ISO/IEC 27001:2022** – Information Security Management Systems
* **ISO/IEC 42001:2023** – AI Management Systems (AIMS)
* **ISO/IEC 27701:2019** – Privacy Information Management Systems (PIMS)
* **SOC 2** – Trust Services Criteria (Security, Availability, Confidentiality, Processing Integrity, Privacy)
* **HIPAA** – Security/Privacy Rule alignment (as applicable)
* **GDPR** – Privacy compliance assessment support
* **DPDP Act (India)** – Data protection compliance support

**Required Skills \& Qualifications:**

* Currently pursuing or recently completed a degree in **Information Security, Computer Science, IT, Risk/Compliance, Cybersecurity, Law/Policy (tech)** or related fields.
* Basic understanding of cybersecurity audit concepts and frameworks.

**Preferred (Nice\-to\-Have)**

* Familiarity with any of: ISO 27001 controls, SOC 2, GDPR, HIPAA, DPDP, risk assessment, privacy principles.
* Interest in AI governance/AI risk and model lifecycle basics (helpful for ISO 42001 projects).

**Internship Outcomes / Learning**

* Understanding how certification/assurance audits are conducted and how evidence is evaluated.
* Improved professional writing: working papers, checklists, summaries, and CAPA tracking.
* Exposure to multi\-framework compliance expectations across security, privacy, and AI governance.

**Professional Expectations**

* Maintain strict confidentiality and follow security policies.
* Be punctual and dependable for onsite schedules and client meetings.

**Job Title:** Program Tester

**Focus Areas:** Software Quality Assurance, Manual \& Functional Testing, Test Planning \& Documentation, Release Coordination

**Nature of Work:** Full\-time, on\-site. The role involves testing web and mobile applications across live client projects, owning test documentation and bug tracking end\-to\-end, and coordinating closely with designers, developers, and clients to keep releases on schedule and to quality.

**About Urbanhub Innovations**

Urbanhub Innovations is a design\-led digital solutions company based in Kannur, building innovative and scalable web and mobile applications for modern businesses across India, the GCC, the UK, and Canada. With expertise in technologies such as Flutter, React, Next.js, and the MERN stack, we deliver user\-centric products that combine functionality, performance, and seamless user experience. We work closely with clients to transform ideas into impactful digital solutions that meet real\-world needs.

At Urbanhub Innovations, we believe technology is driven by people. The organization promotes a collaborative and supportive work culture where creativity, learning, and innovation are encouraged at every level. Team members work on live client projects with real ownership, gain hands\-on exposure across industries and markets, and continuously sharpen their skills in a fast\-evolving digital environment.

We are committed to creating a positive and growth\-oriented workplace where employees feel valued, empowered, and motivated to contribute their best.

**Role and Responsibilities**  
1\. Functional \& Manual Testing

* Test web applications (React, Next.js, Laravel) and mobile applications (Flutter, Android and iOS) across devices, browsers, and screen sizes
* Perform functional, UI/UX, regression, smoke, and cross\-browser/cross\-device testing before every release
* Verify that delivered features match the approved design (Figma) and the agreed requirements or SRS
* Test multilingual and RTL (Arabic) layouts, payment flows, forms, and e\-commerce journeys where applicable

2\. Test Planning \& Documentation

* Read requirement documents, user stories, and designs to prepare test scenarios and test cases before development is complete
* Maintain structured test case sheets, test execution logs, and release checklists for every project
* Write clear, reproducible bug reports with steps, expected vs actual results, screenshots or screen recordings, and severity/priority
* Track defects from logging to closure and re\-verify fixes before sign\-off

3\. Release Coordination \& Sign\-off

* Own the pre\-release quality gate: confirm what is tested, what is open, and whether a build is ready to ship
* Coordinate UAT with clients, collect and consolidate their feedback, and convert it into actionable tickets for the team
* Prepare concise QA status summaries for internal stand\-ups and client updates

4\. Task Tracking \& Follow\-ups

* Maintain project trackers, task boards, and milestone timelines for the projects being tested
* Follow up with designers and developers on pending fixes, blockers, and deadlines
* Keep meeting notes, action items, and decision logs updated and circulated
* Flag scope changes, timeline risks, and dependency issues early to the project lead

5\. Client \& Team Communication

* Communicate clearly and professionally with clients across India and international markets over email, WhatsApp, and calls
* Translate client feedback into precise technical requirements for the team, and technical constraints into plain language for clients
* Work closely with UI/UX designers, developers, and content teams to keep deliverables on schedule

6\. Process \& Continuous Improvement

* Suggest improvements to QA checklists, bug\-tracking workflows, and release processes
* Stay current with testing tools, mobile/web platform updates, and QA best practices
* Contribute to internal documentation, onboarding material, and reusable test templates

**Essential Requirements**

* Fresher to 2 years of experience in software testing, QA, or a related technical role (academic projects, internships, or freelance work count)
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, IT, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
* Solid understanding of the software development life cycle and the testing life cycle (STLC)
* Ability to write structured test cases and clear, reproducible bug reports
* Strong attention to detail with the discipline to test thoroughly rather than quickly
* Strong written and spoken communication skills in English, with the confidence to speak with clients and lead follow\-ups
* Naturally organised: comfortable maintaining trackers, checklists, and timelines, and chasing pending items without being reminded
* A sense of ownership — takes responsibility for the quality and timely delivery of the projects assigned, not just the tickets
* Ability to handle multiple client projects and shifting priorities simultaneously

**Good to Have**

* Exposure to bug\-tracking or project tools such as Jira, ClickUp, Trello, Notion, or Google Sheets\-based trackers
* Basic familiarity with Figma for comparing builds against designs
* Basic understanding of APIs and tools such as Postman
* Exposure to automation basics (Selenium, Playwright, or similar) or interest in learning them
* Understanding of Agile/Scrum practices
* Experience testing e\-commerce, booking, or dashboard\-style applications

description:
**About the Opportunity**
=========================


Job Type: Permanent
Application Deadline: 19 September 2026**Job Description**

  



**Title**Manager, Internal Audit

**Department** Internal Audit

**Location** India

**Reports To**Associate Director

**Level**Level 5


We’re proud to have been helping our clients build better financial futures for over 50 years. How have we achieved this? By working together, and supporting each other, all over the world. So, join our Internal Audit team and feel like you are part of something bigger.

**About your team**


FIL Internal Audit is an independent Group function that reports directly to the Chief Executive Officer of Fidelity International and to the Group Audit and Risk Committee. Our mandate is to examine and critically evaluate the effectiveness of the Company's internal controls and governance systems, as well as the adequacy of, and compliance with, regulatory obligations, internal strategies, policies, processes and reporting procedures. In addition, we help management and the Board to fulfil their oversight responsibilities through effective challenge to help them identify, assess and commercially manage the Company's risk.


Using a risk\-based methodology, our audit plan is developed in consultation with FIL management to include audits of specific business areas as well as thematic and emerging risks through participation in new initiatives and systems developments.


We are a global team with our people working from our offices in the UK, Luxembourg, India, Singapore, China and Japan.

**About your role**

The role of Manager in the Corporate Enablers Internal Audit team is to assist in the delivery of audit assignments as part of a wider team, to verify that business operations are effectively controlled and that risks are effectively managed. Working under the guidance of the Director or Associate Director, you will be required to participate in the planning and execution of audit assignments in line with the FIL audit methodology, producing findings and draft reports for presentation to senior management. In addition, you will contribute to the maintenance and ongoing risk assessment of the audit universe to deliver risk\-based audit coverage for our Corporate Enablers businesses which include Finance, Tax, Procurement, Property Services, Treasury, Compliance, Risk and HR.

**About you**

* You will have a minimum of 2 years auditor experience, ideally in the financial services sector.
* You will have experience in testing control design and operational effectiveness, writing workpapers to reperformance standards and have drafted audit finds for discussion with senior management.
* You will have a strong academic background and ideally hold a relevant professional qualification such as CIA, ACCA, ACA, CIMA, CISA etc.
* You will be an effective communicator, in both verbal and written form, and an analytical thinker who employs logic and persuasion to influence with diplomacy and tact.
* You will be a proactive, innovative, collegial team player who can be accountable and absorb/integrate ideas from diverse views, create partnerships and collaborate with others.
* You will have a curious mindset, be passionate about learning new things and have a strong drive for continued self\-improvement and growth.
* You will be a proficient user of Microsoft office, have experience conducting data analytics and ideally have started to use AI tools in your daily work.

**Feel rewarded**


For starters, we’ll offer you a comprehensive benefits package. We’ll value your wellbeing and support your development. And we’ll be as flexible as we can about where and when you work – finding a balance that works for all of us. It’s all part of our commitment to making you feel motivated by the work you do and happy to be part of our team. For more about our work, our approach to dynamic working and how you could build your future here, visit careers.fidelityinternational.com.

title: Production Supervisor
description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.



This Position reports to:



Production Manager \#\#\#


**What we believe in**



At ABB, we are dedicated to addressing global challenges. Our core values: care, courage, curiosity, and collaboration \- combined with a focus on diversity, inclusion, and equal opportunities \- are key drivers in our aim to empower everyone to create sustainable solutions. That's our story. Make it your story.



Your role and responsibilities



In this role, you Lead a team within a production unit in the execution of processes to transform parts and raw materials into ABB products in a timely, cost\-effective manner. Ensure continues and efficient operation in accordance with volumes, schedules, procedures, drawings and quality and safety



The work model for the role is: \#Li\-Onsite



This role is contributing to the ABB India, Smart Power, Electrification, Business, for Production Operation function for Bangalore Nelamangala Location.


**You will be mainly accountable for:**


* Resource Planning \& Production Execution: Organize and allocate resources efficiently to meet monthly production targets, ensuring capacity planning and adherence to demand plans for on\-time delivery.
* Material, Equipment \& Facility Management: Ensure material availability through regular coordination with planning and buyer teams and identify technical equipment and facility improvements as needed.
* Quality \& Process Improvement: Ensure customer PPM targets and zero\-line stoppages by implementing preventive actions, identifying process deficiencies, and advancing improvement initiatives.
* KPI \& Safety Management: Regularly review KPIs for assigned product lines, ensuring safety compliance and maintaining 6S standards across production areas.
* People Leadership \& Development: Guide, motivate, and develop direct and indirect team members, ensuring teams are well\-organized, staffed, skilled, and aligned with HR policies.


**Qualifications for the role:**


* Experience: 10–15 years of relevant experience in a similar manufacturing role with a focus on planning and operational improvement.
* Qualification: Full\-time Diploma/Degree in Mechanical, Electrical, or Production Engineering.
* Ensure effective production planning and scheduling to meet volume requirements per demand plans while managing inventory levels efficiently.
* Implement continuous improvement initiatives, focusing on process optimization and productivity enhancements.
* Implement lean manufacturing practices, line balancing, and 5S concepts to ensure operational excellence on the shop floor.
* Plan and manage resources effectively, covering men, machines, materials, and methods to support smooth production operations.
* Comfortable working in rotational shifts (A, B, C), ensuring support for continuous production and operational flexibility.


**More about us**



ABB Smart Power provides energy distribution solutions for data centers, industrial and manufacturing plants, critical infrastructure and commercial buildings. The Division’s technical teams work closely with industry partners, delivering advanced solutions that support rapid growth, energy transition, and sustainability objectives. The Division’s portfolio includes industrial circuit breakers, low\-voltage systems, motor starting applications, and safety devices like switches and relays. Its Power Protection unit supports the world’s largest data center companies with advanced energy\-efficient UPS solutions. The Division’s ABB Ability™ Energy Manager provides a scalable, easy\-to\-use platform that helps organizations save energy and reduce CO2 emissions.



Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. We welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.



Ready to make an impact? Apply today or visit www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

ABB never asks for payment from job applicants. All genuine job offers follow a formal application and interview process.



View current job openings and apply at: \[https://careers.abb/global/en/home](https://careers.abb/global/en/home)



For more information, read our full fraud warning notice at: \[https://global.abb/group/en/careers/how\-to\-apply/fraud\-warning](https://global.abb/group/en/careers/how\-to\-apply/fraud\-warning)

title: Manager – HR Operations & Employee Relations
description:
**About the School –**
  

  

**CHIREC INTERNATIONAL SCHOOL**
  

CHIREC International is a leading K\-12 school located in Hyderabad, India offering International Baccalaureate Diploma Programme (IBDP), Cambridge International Examinations (CIE) and Central Board of Secondary Education (CBSE). CHIREC was founded in 1989 by Founder\-Director, Ratna Reddy as a summer camp that offered Programmes in fine arts, performing arts, computers, indoor and outdoor sports. Today, CHIREC is one of the premier educational institutions in the country for excellence in academics and co\-curricular activities. CHIREC’s mission is to nurture the innate potential of its students to enable them to excel in whatever they choose. The school helps students to grow and evolve into open\-minded, ethical and caring individuals who are focused and encouraged to set goals, attain them and exceed expectations. As a valued member of the Cognita global group, and recognized by respected educational bodies like the Council of International Schools (CIS) and the IB Organization, CHIREC International School is known for its exceptional quality of education.
  

  

**About Cognita**
  

  

At Cognita, we know every student is unique. We nurture their distinct personalities and strengths. We support them academically, socially, and emotionally, wherever they are in the world, wherever they’re starting from. And each and every one of our schools is unique too. We protect what’s special about them, while offering them rich knowledge, opportunities, and best practices. And they get to be part of something bigger. We open their classrooms to the collective wisdom of over 100 schools in 16 countries, ensuring every child gets an education that’s, quite literally, world class. It’s an individual approach that empowers every school, teacher and student to focus on what they do best. And thrive.
  

  

**Position Objective:**  

Own the day\-to\-day HR infrastructure and ensure consistent, compliant, and employee\-friendly HR operations across the organization. The HR Manager will digitize workforce data, streamline safeguarding and personnel checks, automate absence tracking, and simplify employee onboarding, while overseeing personnel administration, payroll, and HR compliance for educational institutions.
  

The role will ensure adherence to relevant employment laws, regulations, safeguarding requirements, and organizational policies, working closely with internal teams and external auditors or regulatory bodies to maintain effective, compliant, and integrated HR processes.
  

  

**Key Responsibilities:**
  

* Oversee day\-to\-day HR operations and ensure efficient, consistent, and employee\-focused service delivery.
* Develop, standardize, and continuously improve HR policies, procedures, SOPs, workflows, and documentation.
* Provide HR guidance and support to managers and employees on people\-related matters.
* Manage employee relations matters, including grievances, disciplinary issues, performance concerns, and workplace conflicts.
* Ensure employee relations cases are handled fairly, confidentially, consistently, and in line with applicable employment laws and policies.
* Coordinate payroll processes with Finance and payroll providers, ensuring accurate and timely processing.
* Oversee attendance, leave, absence management, and employee benefits administration.
* Monitor attendance, absence, and workforce trends and provide relevant insights to management.
* Ensure compliance with employment laws, regulations, safeguarding requirements, and organizational policies.
* Manage pre\-employment and personnel checks, including background verification, references, and right\-to\-work checks.
* Maintain accurate HR records and ensure timely completion and renewal of mandatory compliance checks.
* Own the HRIS and ensure accurate, secure, and up\-to\-date employee and workforce data.
* Drive digitization and automation of HR processes, including onboarding, employee records, attendance, and routine workflows.
* Develop HR MIS, dashboards, and reports to support workforce planning and management decision\-making.
* Maintain appropriate HR data governance, controls, confidentiality, and reporting standards.
* Support internal and external HR audits, inspections, regulatory reviews, and compliance assessments.
* Promote employee wellbeing, engagement, inclusion, and a positive employee experience.
* Coordinate employee welfare, engagement, and support initiatives and address workplace concerns.
* Identify opportunities to improve HR service delivery, employee experience, and organizational effectiveness.
* Lead, coach, and develop the HR team, ensuring clear responsibilities, performance standards, and continuous capability development.

  

**Education \& Professional Qualifications**
  

* Postgraduate qualification in Human Resources, Personnel Management, Business Administration, or a related discipline.
* A degree or professional qualification in Law, Labour Law, Industrial Relations, or Employee Relations will be an advantage.
* Relevant professional HR certification is desirable.

**Experience**
  

* 15 to 20 years of relevant HR experience, with at least 5 years in a managerial position.
* Demonstrated experience in HR operations, employee relations, HR compliance, policy implementation, payroll coordination, and HR systems.
* Experience in leading and developing small HR teams
* Experience in the education sector or another regulated environment is highly desirable.
* Proven experience in HR digitization, HRIS implementation/improvement, process automation, and HR MIS.
* Demonstrated experience handling complex employee relations matters, audits, regulatory requirements, and employment\-related compliance.
* Experience working with senior leadership and external auditors, regulators, and service providers.

  

**Benefits at CHIREC**
  

Competitive salary depending upon qualifications and experience
  

Lunch on all school\-working days
  

School transport as per the available bus routes
  

Comprehensive Medical Insurance
  

Personal accident policy
  

Term Life policy
  

Professional Development

Complete this application before the closing date. The Closing Date for Applications is: **15\-Oct\-2026**

#### **Job Context \& Major Challenges**


Job Context: UltraTech Cement Ltd. is the largest manufacturer of grey cement, Ready Mix Concrete (RMC) and white cement in India. The company has consolidated capacity of 116\.75 Million Tonnes Per Annum (MTPA)\* of grey cement. UltraTech Cement has 23 integrated plants, 1 clinkerisation plant, 26 grinding units and 7 bulk terminals. * Provide technical, process and systems support to the Financial Reporting team members by managing and monitoring the delivery of Financial Reporting services and ensuring delivery quality in terms of accuracy, completeness and timeliness on a daily basis.
* Manage and review the booking of accounting transactions, master data maintenance, fixed assets and project accounting transactions, calculations, workings and account analysis as performed by the Financial Reporting team members.
* Manage and monitor to ensure month end close steps are executed in accordance with work instructions and month end close checklist
* Manage and monitor to ensure timely, accurate and complete preparation of month\-end, quarter\-end, year\-end and statutory financial reports for BASF companies across Asia Pacific. This would include reports for group reporting, internal management reporting, statutory reporting as well as any agreed ad hoc reports required e.g. audit schedules, tax schedules etc
* Perform analytical review of profit and loss accounts and balance sheet, trend analysis, cost centre checks and transaction posting checks
* Ensure that all deadlines for Financial Reporting services are met consistently.
* Coaching and perform trouble shooting to resolve issues related to Financial Reporting processes.
* Coach and support a team to meet the Financial Reporting services requirements.
* Provide guidance and training to Financial Reporting team members to improve their ability on the job.
* Liaise with relevant stakeholders on Financial Reporting work issues and queries.
* Assume hands on / backup role when needed, to meet service delivery needs • Drive team motivation and morale.
* Act as counsel to Financial Reporting team members as and when needed.
* Act as a backup for Head of Financial Reporting on ad\-hoc task as and when required.
* Perform other duties as and when delegated, including job rotation to other functional teams

**Compliance:**


* Enforcing compliance with BASF policies, local company legal and statutory requirements Internal.
* Manage and participate in any compliance audits and respond to audit queries
* Ensure all work documentation and work processes are updated and meet with Internal Control and ISO requirements.

**Others**


* Drive the implementation of continuous improvement initiatives, Internal Control Requirements, Six Sigma, Balance Scorecard and any other ad hoc project roll outs etc.
* Be a “Key User” within the team, providing expert knowledge and support to colleagues and hands on support when required.
* Support the implementation of Business Continuity Plan (BCP) through resource planning, backup and communication.
* Coordination, monitoring and compilation of Key Performance Indexes (KPI).
* Such other tasks as BSSCKL management and changing business environment may require to be performed.
* Contribute and support team strategic plan and objectives.

**Perform the role of Shared Service Centre Accountant.**


* Act as a single point of contact (SPOC) for all related functional work streams for the assigned sub region.
* Collates information and updates by conducting weekly / bi\-weekly cross functional meeting amongst all related functional work streams for the assigned sub region.
* Supports Head of Finance in the role of a Business Partner, Advisor and Integrator of the total business view.
* Supports Head of Finance Reporting in the role as a Finance Commentator, explaining business story in numbers and variances.
* Leading role in coordinating and liaising with respective counterparts i.e. Auditors, Local Accountants and Delivery Managers.
* Monitor the preparation and distribution of information that are to be furnished i.e. relating to Prepared by Client (PBC) list, Balances confirmation, notes to the Accounts including ensuring deadlines are met.

**Service Management:**


* Manage the Financial Reporting team members to deliver services within agreed service levels
* Ensure the operations in accordance with the service management framework by providing timely and accurate customer service.
* Review backlog and cycle time reports; supervise team members to improve process flow times.
* Ensure all workflows are processed within agreed service timelines.
* Influence the development of the service level agreement and charging mechanisms for the services provided.
* Ensure customer queries are attended to and resolved in a timely, responsible and proactive manner.
* Monitor SLAs, Balance Scorecard and KPIs, to ensure continue improvement in operations and service to customers.

**Quality and Continuous Improvement.**


* Identify, recommend and develop solutions in consultation with Head of Financial Reporting for continuous improvement opportunities. Ensure successful implementation across the team and in the local companies.

* Work closely with external consultants, auditors etc

* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and effective communication skills.
* Ability to work effectively in a multicultural, fast\-paced global environment
* High attention to detail and a commitment to data accuracy

* Experience working in MNC and Captive GCC experience is preferred

title: Contract Management Specialist
description:
**Contract Management Specialist**
==================================

Date: Sep 7, 2026
Location:
Bangalore, KA, IN, 560100


Req ID: 38058
Work Mode: Remote India
**Summary**
-----------


As anContract Management Specialist at Gainwell, you will serve as an individual contributor responsible for leading the development, negotiation, interpretation and administration of contracts and contract governance across the enterprise. This role partners closely with legal, procurement, HR, and business stakeholders to manage contractual risk, ensure regulatory compliance, and drive standardized contract practices that support organizational and client objectives.


We are seeking an experienced and highly motivated Associate Manager Contracts to support a U.S.\-based healthcare technology and services organization focused on contracts with state and local governments as well as commercial entities. This role will be responsible for independently managing complex commercial, healthcare, technology, vendor, and government\-related contracts throughout the contracting lifecycle.


The ideal candidate will possess exceptional English communication skills, strong contract interpretation and negotiation experience, sound business judgment, and the ability to operate independently while partnering closely with U.S.\-based legal, sales, procurement, delivery, and executive teams.


**Your role in our mission**
----------------------------


When joining Gainwell, you will:


* Draft, review, negotiate, and manage a wide variety of state agreements, including:


* Master Services Agreements (MSAs)
* Statements of Work (SOWs)
* Amendments and Change Orders
* Non\-Disclosure Agreements (NDAs)
* Teaming Agreements
* Software, SaaS, and technology agreements
* Vendor and subcontractor agreements
* State, local and commercial healthcare\-related services agreements
* Lead contract negotiations with customers, vendors, subcontractors, and business partners.


* Analyze contractual risks and provide management with suggestions for risk\-mitigation strategies.


* Interpret contract provisions and provide clear guidance to internal legal and contracts team members regarding rights, obligations, and compliance requirements.


* Collaborate with U.S.\-based contract managers, attorneys and business leaders to resolve legal, commercial, operational, and compliance issues.


* Support bid, and procurement activities, including performing proposal and contract reviews associated with RFPs and government healthcare opportunities.


* Ensure contracts comply with corporate policies, applicable laws, healthcare regulations, privacy requirements, and contracting standards.


* Maintain accurate contract records and manage contracts through contract lifecycle management systems.


* Track key contractual obligations, deliverables, renewals, notices, and expiration dates.


* Provide training and guidance to internal stakeholders on contract processes and risk management.


* Build strong working relationships with internal and external business partners and serve as a trusted advisor to the business.


**What we're looking for**
--------------------------


* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience; a degree in law from a reputable university in India preferred.


* 12\-15 years of experience in contracts management, legal operations, or related fields


* Strong knowledge of US contract law, regulatory compliance, and risk management principles


* Ability to independently review, negotiate and manage complex agreements and influence stakeholders


* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, communication, and stakeholder management skills


* Demonstrated experience in drafting, negotiating and summarizing contracts and associated risks with minimal supervision.


* Excellent written and verbal English communication skills, including the ability to communicate effectively with U.S.\-based executives and legal professionals.


* Strong ability to identify, interpret and summarize contractual terms and explain legal and business implications to legal and non\-legal stakeholders.


* Experience managing multiple priorities and meeting demanding deadlines in a fast\-paced environment.


* Ability to work independently with minimal supervision while exercising sound judgment.


* Proficiency with Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and contract lifecycle management tools.


**Preferred Qualifications**


* Experience supporting U.S. healthcare, healthcare technology, managed care, health plan, or Medicaid\-related contracts.


* Familiarity with healthcare privacy, data security, compliance, and regulatory requirements.


* Experience supporting U.S. state government contracts, healthcare procurements, or large\-scale outsourcing agreements.


* Experience working within a multinational or global organization supporting U.S.\-based operations.


**Competencies**


* Exceptional contract drafting, review and negotiation capabilities


* Contract interpretation and issue spotting


* Executive\-level communication skills


* Business acumen and commercial judgment


* Risk assessment and mitigation


* Attention to detail


* Customer\-focused mindset


* Ability to influence without direct authority


* Self\-starter with strong ownership mentality


**What you should expect in this role**
---------------------------------------


* **Remote environment (Work Hours : 6:30 pm \-3:30am IST)**


* High level of ownership for contract strategy, compliance, and enterprise risk management


* Collaboration with legal, procurement, HR, and business leaders


* Opportunity to influence enterprise contract governance, compliance frameworks, and operational efficiency

title: Talent Acquisition Partner
description:
At Zimmer Biomet, we believe in pushing the boundaries of innovation and driving our mission forward. As a global medical technology leader for nearly 100 years, a patient’s mobility is enhanced by a Zimmer Biomet product or technology every 8 seconds.


As a Zimmer Biomet team member, you will share in our commitment to providing mobility and renewed life to people around the world. To support our talent team, we focus on development opportunities, robust employee resource groups (ERGs), a flexible working environment, location specific competitive total rewards, wellness incentives and a culture of recognition and performance awards. We are committed to creating an environment where every team member feels included, respected, empowered and recognised.

**What You Can Expect**
-----------------------



As a Zimmer Biomet full life\-cycle Talent Partner, you will join the global Talent Acquisition team and lead efforts attracting, sourcing, and selecting top\-tier talent to join our team. You will work closely with hiring managers and HR partners in a consultative role to understand staffing needs, develop effective recruitment strategies, and ensure a seamless and positive candidate experience and meeting agreed KPIs.  

This role will be a part of the Talent Acqusition Commercial team and support hiring in Australia and New Zealand and India but also other global locations as required.

**How You'll Create Impact**
----------------------------


* Collaborate with hiring managers to define job requirements and qualifications.
* Utilize data and up\-to\-date market insights to advice on market realities or alternatives.
* Develop and implement effective sourcing strategies within a variety of channels.
* Conduct thorough screening and assessment of candidates to ensure alignment with Zimmer Biomet’s requirements, culture, and values.
* Guide the manager and candidate through the interview phases, ensuring a robust and effective assessment and engaging experience for the candidate.
* Artfully manage offers and negotiations, finding a successful outcome for both parties.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with candidates, growing the future pipeline.
* Stay informed of industry trends, competitive landscape, and best practices to continually improve the recruitment process and experience.
* Contribute to the development and implementation of talent acquisition initiatives and projects.
**What Makes You Stand Out**
----------------------------


* Strong sourcing techniques
* Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to quickly establish rapport and credibility with hiring managers and candidates.
* Influencing and negotiation skills
* Fluency in English and local language
**Your Background**
-------------------


* 3\+ years of experience as a full life cycle Talent Advisor/Partner
* Experience has a consultative advisor, driving the recruitment process and outcomes.
* Familiarity with applicant tracking systems and other HR software.
  

EOE/M/F/Vet/Disability

title: Junior HR Executive
description:
We are looking for a dynamic and result\-oriented Talent Acquisition Executive to manage end\-to\-end recruitment activities, including sourcing, screening, interviewing, salary negotiation, and candidate closure. The role requires strong knowledge of job portals, recruitment strategies, ATS/ERP systems, and high\-volume hiring. The ideal candidate should be able to hire 80–100 candidates per month, maintain a strong talent pipeline, manage recruitment TAT and hiring cost data, and be willing to travel across India for recruitment requirements.

**What we Offer?**

* Absolute clarity on work expectations and number\-based appraisal system
* Company is growing 10X in next 4 years, so a superb growth opportunity for people contributing towards growth of company.
* Stable company with clear laid down procedures, and a great track record of growth.
* Pan India operations so scope of moving across India to gain multiple experience in various geographies.
* Job Security with cash rich, well\-funded company listed on NSE with market cap of 600 Crores.
* Professional work culture and learning environment, where the only pressure is of upgrading your skillset and growing along with organization.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Handle end\-to\-end recruitment from sourcing to candidate onboarding.
* Source candidates through job portals, LinkedIn, referrals, social media, and other recruitment channels.
* Screen resumes, conduct HR interviews, and coordinate interviews with hiring managers.
* Achieve monthly hiring targets of 80–100 positions while maintaining recruitment quality.
* Build and maintain a strong talent pipeline for current and future hiring requirements.
* Negotiate salary, influence candidates, and ensure successful offer acceptance and joining.
* Ensure adherence to recruitment SOPs, hiring policies, and company guidelines.
* Maintain recruitment MIS, ATS/ERP records, and recruitment reports.
* Track and improve Recruitment TAT, Time\-to\-Hire, Cost\-to\-Hire, and Joining Ratio.
* Draft professional emails for candidate communication, interview scheduling, offers, and follow\-ups.
* Coordinate with hiring managers and stakeholders to ensure timely position closures.
* Travel across India for recruitment drives, campus hiring, walk\-in interviews, and business hiring requirements.

**✅ Desired Candidate Profile:**

* Strong knowledge of job portals (Naukri, LinkedIn, Indeed, Workindia, etc.) and sourcing strategies.
* Proven ability to close positions within defined TAT.
* Experience in high\-volume hiring (80–100 hires per month preferred).
* Excellent salary negotiation, candidate influencing, and stakeholder management skills.
* Good knowledge of ATS/Recruitment Software/ERP systems.
* Strong email drafting, MS Excel, and reporting skills.
* Ability to build and maintain a quality candidate database and talent pipeline.
* Excellent communication, interpersonal, and time management skills.
* Willingness to travel across India for recruitment activities.

Pay: ₹10,000\.00 \- ₹15,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Provident Fund

Application Question(s):

* Do you have recruitment experience of warehouse/3PL Company?
* Whats your current salary?
* Can you join immediately? Your notice period?
* Our warehouse is at Survey no. 68,69, part\-70, vill\-devaryamjal, taluka\-shamirpet,Medchal\-Malkajgiri, this location. Are your comfortable for this location?

Work Location: In person

title: HR Manager
description:
A global bank has been quietly building an India technology and operations centre for the past two years, and the India HR function, currently a team of three, needs a Manager who can own the full employee lifecycle for a headcount that is set to double this year. This bank has partnered with Flexiple to hire this role into its India centre.
 



**The mandate** 




 You will own HR operations, employee relations and statutory compliance for a mixed population of technology, operations and control\-function employees across two India locations, reporting into the India HR Head.
 



**What lands on this desk** 



* End\-to\-end employee lifecycle management, from onboarding and confirmations through transfers and exits
* Employee relations cases, including performance management and disciplinary matters, handled with the documentation rigour a regulated employer expects
* Statutory compliance across PF, ESI, gratuity, Shops and Establishments and the Contract Labour Act, working closely with payroll and legal
* Coordination with employee forums where they exist, and audit readiness for internal and regulatory reviews
* Manager coaching on policy interpretation, calibration cycles and difficult conversations



**Compliance and the fine print** 




 Because this is a regulated bank, HR decisions here carry documentation weight: every exception needs a paper trail, every policy change needs a sign\-off chain, and every audit finding needs a closure plan. You will be the person who keeps that machinery running without slowing the business down.
 



**What we need you to have already done** 




 Seven to ten years in HR generalist or HR business partner roles, with at least three of those inside a bank, NBFC or other tightly regulated employer. You should be fluent in Indian labour law as it actually gets applied, not just in theory, and comfortable being the person managers call when a termination gets complicated. Prior experience with a unionised or works\-council population is a strong plus.
 



**Where and how** 




 This role is based out of Mumbai, Bengaluru or Delhi NCR, with Remote (India) available for the right candidate, though a hybrid presence is preferred given the employee\-relations caseload.
 



**Getting to an offer** 




 Applications move through an HR screen, a case\-study discussion built around a real employee\-relations scenario, a round with the hiring manager, and a closing conversation with the India leadership team.
 



 This application will also be considered for other HR leadership mandates Flexiple is currently hiring for, not only this one.

title: Manager- HR Operations
description:
**About the Role** 
 :
 



 We are looking for a
 **Manager\- HR Operations** 
 to own the operational core of the People function at Radix. Getting it right \-consistently, precisely, without exception \- is the job. Done well, this role is the foundation on which Radix builds world\-class people operations. The role spans three areas: HR and people technology systems, payroll and statutory compliance across India, UAE, and Cayman Islands, and \- by virtue of reporting into the Rewards function \- direct exposure to compensation and rewards work. It reports to the Rewards Lead.
 



 This is a role where the day\-to\-day is the job \- payroll that runs without incident, systems that hold, compliance that never slips. Someone who gets that right consistently, and who is intellectually curious enough to ask why something takes as long as it does, will find real scope here. The right candidate communicates clearly across functions and geographies, collaborates generously, and holds themselves to a standard that others can depend on.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 




  





**HR Systems** 



* Own the accuracy and upkeep of HR and people technology platforms — HRMS, payroll systems, benefits tools, and related infrastructure
* Manage all data operations: employee records, org changes, lifecycle events, role and grade updates, and compensation inputs — with a zero\-tolerance standard for data error
* Maintain system SOPs, configuration logs, and governance documentation; treat documentation as a living asset, not a compliance task
* Continuously audit systems for efficiency gaps, data inconsistencies, and process bottlenecks; resolve issues before they surface downstream
* Evaluate payroll, benefits, and HR platforms against global standards, and where a better\-fit solution exists, build the case and support implementation — the ability to lead that process end to end is a strong plus
* Leverage AI and automation tools to reduce manual effort, improve accuracy, and free up capacity for higher\-value work



  





**Payroll \& Statutory Compliance** 



* Lead end\-to\-end payroll across India, UAE, and Cayman Islands \- inputs, validations, reconciliations, vendor coordination, and closure \- accurately and on time, every cycle
* Ensure compliance with all applicable statutory requirements across geographies: India (PF, ESIC, PT, TDS, gratuity), UAE (WPS, end\-of\-service), and Cayman Islands (employment law, pension, mandatory benefits)
* Review payroll outputs in detail; catch exceptions and anomalies before disbursement and drive swift resolution
* Proactively identify inefficiencies in payroll and benefits workflows; implement improvements aligned to global best practice \- tighter controls, smarter reconciliations, reduced cycle time, and tooling that meets the standard of a world\-class people function
* Manage statutory filing calendars and vendor accountability across all jurisdictions; maintain audit\-readiness at all times
* Partner with Finance on reconciliations, provisions, cost reporting, and period\-end requirements across all geographies



  





**Rewards \- Visibility \& Exposure** 




*Sitting within the Rewards function gives this role a natural window into compensation and rewards work that most ops roles simply don’t have. This is not a core delivery responsibility \- it is genuine proximity to a domain that can meaningfully expand this person’s professional horizon.* 



* Work alongside the Rewards Lead on compensation cycles, benefits renewals, benchmarking, and policy implementation \- contributing on data, process, and coordination as the work demands
* Build working familiarity with compensation frameworks, appraisal cycles, job architecture, and benefits program management \- knowledge that compounds over time.



  





**What we are looking for:** 



* 6–8 years of experience across HR operations, payroll, people systems, or total rewards \- with direct ownership across at least two of these areas
* Hands\-on payroll experience across at least two geographies; India essential, UAE strongly preferred, Cayman Islands or other offshore exposure a plus
* Working knowledge of HRMS and payroll platforms as an operations owner \- managing accuracy, configurations, and data
* Genuinely energised by getting recurring processes right \- someone who finds the discipline of daily execution satisfying, and sees improvement as something that earns its place on top of a solid baseline
* Intellectually driven \- someone who reads the landscape, benchmarks against best practice, and brings ideas for how Radix’s HR operations can be best\-in\-class
* Actively uses AI tools in day\-to\-day work; approaches operational problems with a mindset of automation\-first wherever it adds genuine value
* Strong Excel and data\-handling skills: reconciliations, validation, analysis, and reporting
* High attention to detail and structured thinking; able to hold multiple workstreams across geographies without losing precision
* Sound judgment with confidential information; mature and discreet in how sensitive data is handled
* Strong communicator \- clear, credible, and culturally fluent across Finance, Legal, HR leadership, employees, and vendors
* Collaborative by nature; builds trust across functions and treats shared accountability as a feature, not a constraint.



  





**Success in This Role Looks Like** 



* Payroll runs cleanly across all three geographies \- accurate, on time, and with controls that hold under scrutiny
* HR systems are trusted sources of truth; data quality is owned, not just monitored
* Statutory compliance is never reactive \- filings, obligations, and vendor accountability are managed ahead of the calendar
* The operational footprint of the People function shrinks over time as processes become faster, smarter, and less dependent on manual effort
* The Rewards proximity is used well \- curiosity is active, domain knowledge grows, and the person is building toward more
* Radix’s people operations are genuinely world\-class \- accurate, efficient, globally compliant, and built on tools and processes that reflect the best of what a high\-performing people function looks like.
