title: Program Manager
description:
**Position:** 
 Program Manager – Urban Initiative
 



**Location:** 
 Delhi
 



**An initiative supported by The Convergence Foundation** 




  





**About URBAN Project** 




 India is urbanising rapidly, and its cities are where the country's economic future will be decided. Services already form the largest part of the Indian economy, and well\-functioning cities are essential to sustaining services\-led growth and creating jobs at scale. Yet urbanisation in India has often been unplanned and under\-resourced, leaving cities struggling with weak planning, a difficult business environment, fragmented governance, and chronic under\-financing. Getting urbanisation right – rapid yet sustainable – is one of the highest\-leverage opportunities for India's economic transformation.
 



  





 The Urban Initiative is supported by The Convergence Foundation, the Urban Initiative is being established to help India build the policy ecosystem needed to drive economic growth through rapid and sustainable urbanisation. It will work systemically—developing policy perspectives and partnering with the government to advance reform—rather than engaging in on\-ground implementation. Its work will be organised around four interconnected pillars:
 



  




* **Regional economic and spatial planning:** 
 Creating regional economic plans that feed into better, more growth\-oriented master plans for cities and their surrounding regions.
* **Ease of doing business:** 
 Enabling more sensible development control norms and regulations that make it easier to build, invest and do business in cities.
* **Governance:** 
 Strengthening how cities are managed, including the devolution of power to empowered, accountable city governments.
* **Financing:** 
 Ensuring cities are adequately funded and well managed – through better allocation of public money, raising local resources, and involving the private sector through PPP and other models.



  





 Across each pillar, the initiative will build a strong policy perspective, drawing on best practices from better\-run Indian cities as well as relevant global examples. It will work closely with the central government – including NITI Aayog and the Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs (MoHUA) – to drive policy change at the national level, and with state and city governments where there is genuine interest and appetite for reform. The initiative will remain a small, high\-quality team focused on ideas, influence and partnerships rather than implementation.
 



  





**Position Summary** 




 The Economic growth team works with internal and external stakeholders on cross functional projects. This role sits within the team's Urban Development initiative, which explores emerging issues and whitespaces in the urban development policy ecosystem. The Program Manager (PM) should have strong problem\-solving skills, secondary research capabilities and analytical prowess. In addition, as well as excellent oral \& written communication skills. The ideal candidate is a self\-starter with a bias towards action and the ability to work with ambiguous requirements. The PM will have a steep learning curve and would be expected to hit the ground running on live projects with Government institutions.
 



  





**Areas of Work:** 




 The Program Manager will:
 


* Work with Economic Growth team and leadership to identify and scope priority areas in the urban development policy ecosystem, with a focus on ease of doing business in cities, urban finance, and city planning
* Engage in dipstick secondary research to diagnose binding constraints in issue areas and develop initial hypotheses around opportunities for impact (e.g. which regulatory constraints, if solved for, can improve ease of doing business in a city)
* Develop evidence\-based benchmarking frameworks to compare cities on regulatory performance and identify opportunities to streamline approvals, improve governance, and accelerate urban economic growth
* Engage with policymakers, urban practitioners, and other ecosystem stakeholders to validate findings, refine priorities, and build partnerships
* Oversee the creation of knowledge material across priority areas by identifying potential partners, developing terms of reference and managing projects to their completion
* Provide continued program/grant support to organisations, programs or public goods that might stem as a result of the scoping exercise



  





**Required Qualifications, Skills and Abilities** 



* Undergraduate or masters degrees from top tier institutions. While there is no preference for a particular major or specialisation, prior experience in urban development or related sectors will be preferred
* Up to 4 years of work experience in a consulting or challenging/ high growth environment
* Excellent analytical, critical thinking and problem\-solving skills
* Solid planning and organisational skills with high attention to detail, accuracy, protocol and deadline
* Excellent writing ability that is clear, concise and analytic in style
* Excellent communication, interpersonal, and stakeholder\-facing skills including solid presentation and facilitation skills
* High level of flexibility and responsiveness with the ability to shift priorities quickly and as organisational demands require
* Ability to do research and distil important concepts in a structured, concise, yet comprehensive manner
* Operating style suited to working in a small\-organisation setting, where teamwork and resourcefulness are highly valued



  





**Compensation** 




 Remuneration will be competitive with Indian philanthropy pay scales and will depend upon the candidate's experience
 



  





**Location** 




 New Delhi, India

description:
Job Description: Technology Project Manager / Scrum Master
 



 Location: \[Pune]
 



 Position Overview
 



 The Technology Project Manager / Scrum Master is a hands\-on delivery leader
 **responsible for establishing disciplined Scrum practices, configuring and governing Jira, and leading complex, cross\-functional technology projects across Cordance Commerce** 
 . This role creates the operating rhythm, delivery visibility, risk management, and stakeholder alignment needed to turn strategic priorities and product roadmaps into predictable outcomes.
 



 The ideal candidate combines
 **deep Scrum mastery with strong technology project\-management experience** 
 and sufficient technical fluency to coordinate software, data, infrastructure, platform, release, and customer\-migration initiatives. This role does not replace Product or Engineering ownership; it enables those teams to work effectively by improving backlog readiness, facilitation, transparency, dependency management, decisions, and execution discipline.
 



 Key Responsibilities
 


* **Establish, coach, and continuously improve practical Scrum ways of working across assigned teams** 
 , including roles, working agreements, Definition of Ready, Definition of Done, estimation, capacity planning, sprint goals, and team\-level metrics.
* **Set up and configure Jira from the ground up** 
 , including projects, issue types, workflows, statuses, screens, fields, permissions, boards, filters, dashboards, automation rules, notifications, releases, and reporting conventions.
* Serve as the operating owner for Jira data quality and governance, ensuring that teams consistently maintain accurate priorities, owners, estimates, sprint assignments, dependencies, due dates, releases, and status information.
* **Plan, schedule, and facilitate Scrum ceremonies, including backlog refinement, sprint planning, daily Scrum, sprint review, retrospective, and cross\-team Scrum\-of\-Scrums or dependency forums where needed** 
 .
* Coach Product Owners, Engineering leaders, and delivery teams on backlog health, story quality, acceptance criteria, estimation, sustainable commitments, flow, accountability, and continuous improvement.
* Remove or escalate impediments, protect sprint commitments from unplanned disruption, and help teams address recurring delivery constraints without creating unnecessary process overhead.
* Develop and publish concise weekly delivery reports covering sprint goals, planned\-versus\-completed work, milestone health, delivery confidence, throughput or velocity trends, blockers, risks, dependencies, decisions, scope changes, and actions requiring leadership attention.
* Lead end\-to\-end planning and execution for strategic technology projects, including platform consolidation, Secure Retail\-to\-Solutions migration, database modernization, unified reporting, reliability improvements, integrations, and AI\-enabled initiatives.
* Translate approved business priorities and product roadmaps into project charters, workstreams, milestones, dependencies, resource plans, delivery forecasts, measurable acceptance criteria, and clear ownership.
* Establish and maintain integrated project plans across Engineering, Product, Architecture, Data, Quality, Infrastructure, Customer Success, Support, Sales, and external partners.
* Facilitate project kickoffs, planning sessions, weekly execution reviews, risk and dependency reviews, decision forums, retrospectives, and executive status updates.
* Track scope, schedule, capacity, budget, quality, risks, assumptions, issues, dependencies, decisions, and changes; escalate early with context, business impact, options, and a recommendation.
* Coordinate release and migration readiness across technical and customer\-facing teams, including validation, cutover, rollback, communications, training, support preparedness, and post\-launch stabilization.
* Partner with Product Managers and Engineering leaders to maintain clear priorities, healthy and ready backlogs, realistic commitments, and alignment among customer needs, architecture requirements, capacity, and delivery timelines.
* Manage vendor and contractor deliverables when assigned, including statements of work, milestones, invoices, risks, performance, and expected return on investment.



 Core Competencies
 


* **Scrum Leadership:** 
 Applies Scrum deeply and pragmatically, coaches teams and leaders, and builds self\-managing teams rather than simply scheduling ceremonies.
* **Jira Architecture \& Governance:** 
 Can design, configure, launch, document, and continuously improve a Jira environment that supports reliable execution and decision\-making.
* **Technology Project Management:** 
 Creates structure, momentum, and accountability for complex initiatives involving multiple products, teams, vendors, and business functions.
* **Technical Fluency:** 
 Understands software delivery, cloud platforms, databases, APIs, integrations, testing, CI/CD, releases, and production operations well enough to manage dependencies and risk.
* **Risk \& Decision Management:** 
 Identifies threats early, maintains usable risk and issue logs, clarifies tradeoffs, and drives timely decisions with accountable owners.
* **Reporting \& Executive Communication:** 
 Turns Jira and project data into concise, evidence\-based reporting on progress, forecasts, delivery confidence, business impact, and decisions needed.
* **Facilitation \& Influence:** 
 Builds alignment, handles conflict constructively, and moves work forward across organizational boundaries without relying on formal authority.
* **Continuous Improvement:** 
 Uses retrospectives, delivery data, and root\-cause analysis to improve predictability, quality, speed, and team effectiveness.



 Required Qualifications
 


* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, Business, Project Management, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 7\+ years of experience in technology delivery, including meaningful experience performing both Scrum Master and technology project\-management responsibilities.
* Demonstrated expertise in Scrum, including facilitating all ceremonies, coaching Product Owners and engineering teams, improving backlog health, removing impediments, and using retrospectives to deliver measurable improvement.
* Hands\-on experience configuring and launching Jira for software\-development teams, including workflows, issue types, custom fields, permissions, boards, dashboards, automation, filters, releases, and reporting.
* Demonstrated success delivering SaaS software, platform, data, cloud, integration, infrastructure, release, or migration projects through the full lifecycle.
* Experience building integrated project plans and managing scope, schedule, dependencies, capacity, resources, risks, budgets, vendors, organizational change, and operational readiness.
* Ability to build weekly reports and meaningful delivery metrics from Jira and related systems, including sprint predictability, planned\-versus\-delivered work, flow, aging work, blockers, quality, and milestone confidence.
* Strong working knowledge of software\-development lifecycles, Agile and hybrid delivery approaches, release management, CI/CD, testing, and production\-readiness practices.
* Excellent facilitation, organization, written communication, stakeholder management, conflict resolution, and executive\-presentation skills.



 Preferred Qualifications
 


* Certified ScrumMaster (CSM), Professional Scrum Master (PSM), PMI\-ACP, PMP, or comparable certification; advanced Scrum certification is a plus.
* Experience administering Jira Cloud and integrating Jira with Confluence, GitHub, CI/CD, service\-management, or business\-intelligence tools.
* Experience managing technology integration or consolidation following acquisitions or across a multi\-product SaaS portfolio.
* Experience leading customer migrations, cloud modernization, database migrations, data\-platform implementations, or enterprise reporting initiatives.
* Experience coordinating distributed teams, contractors, vendors, and stakeholders across time zones.
* Experience with retail, point\-of\-sale, inventory, e\-commerce, donation, or thrift/resale software environments.
* Working knowledge of information security, data privacy, business continuity, and operational readiness.



 Success Measurements
 



 Scrum Adoption \& Team Effectiveness
 


* Scrum ceremonies are purposeful, consistently run, time\-boxed, and supported by clear team working agreements and ownership.
* Backlogs and sprint work meet agreed readiness and quality standards, while retrospective actions lead to measurable improvements.



 Jira Implementation \& Data Quality
 


* Jira projects, workflows, boards, permissions, dashboards, automation, and reporting are configured to support the agreed delivery model and adopted consistently.
* Jira data is sufficiently accurate and current to support weekly reporting, forecasting, prioritization, and leadership decisions.



 Delivery Predictability \& Transparency
 


* Weekly reports are timely, concise, evidence\-based, and trusted by delivery teams and executives.
* Milestone attainment, sprint predictability, and planned\-versus\-delivered performance improve toward agreed organizational targets.



 Risk, Dependency \& Decision Management
 


* RAID and decision logs remain current, with accountable owners and due dates, and material threats are escalated before they jeopardize committed outcomes.
* Cross\-team dependencies, scope changes, and schedule impacts are identified, evaluated, resolved, and communicated promptly.



 Release, Migration \& Operational Readiness
 


* Launches and migrations have complete, cross\-functional readiness plans covering validation, cutover, rollback, communications, training, support, and stabilization.
* Assigned initiatives are delivered without avoidable customer disruption or preventable critical production failures.

title: Copywriter
description:
**Background** 




 Praan (Praan, Inc.) is an impact focused deep\-tech startup democratizing clean air using breakthrough filterless technology. The company is backed by top tier VCs and CXOs globally and currently operates between the United States and India. Our team puts extreme attention to detail and loves building technology that's aspirational. Praan's team and culture is positioned to empower people to solve large global problems at an accelerated pace.
 



  





**Why** 




 Everyone worries about the dooms\-day in climate change which is expected to occur in the 2050s. However, there's one doom's day which is the reality for millions of people around the world today. Air pollution takes more than 7 Million lives globally every single year. Over 5% of premature children death occur due to air pollution in developing countries. Everyone has relied on governments or experts to solve the problem, but most solutions up until today have either been too expensive or too ineffective. Praan is an attempt at making the future cleaner, healthier, and safer for the generations to come.
 



  





**Job Description** 




 You'll own Praan's voice — the words that turn a hard science mission into something people feel. The manifesto, the vision, the founder's public writing, the story we tell customers and future teammates. This is a craft role for someone who thinks in ideas, not just sentences.
 



  





**What you'll do** 



* Write Praan's manifesto and core brand story — our "why we exist"
* Turn deep tech into writing anyone can understand and feel
* Shape the company's and founder's public voice
* Set the tone that other writers (social, ads, regional) follow
* Work closely with design and video so words and visuals move together



  





**Skill Requirements** 




  





 A portfolio with
 **real narrative work** 
 — a manifesto, brand story, essay, or launch copy you're proud of (not just SEO blogs)
 



 The ability to build an argument, not just decorate one
 



 Range: big\-idea long\-form
 *and* 
 a sharp one\-line headline
 


* Genuine curiosity about hard problems — and the discipline to research them well



  





**Good to have** 



* Experience writing for the Indian market
* Comfort in a fast\-moving, founder\-led environment
* SEO/AEO awareness — able to write so a page works for search as well as for people (this isn't a content\-SEO role, but a sense for discoverability helps)



  





**Praan is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate based on race, religion, caste, gender, disability or any other criteria. We just care about working with great human beings!**

 In a world where you can be anything,
 **Be Infoblox.** 




**Apprentice HRBP** 




 We have an opportunity for an
 **Apprentice HRBP** 
 to join our People \& Places (Human Resources) team in Bangalore, reporting to the Director HRBP. In this pivotal role, you will support experienced HR Business Partners in delivering people strategies, programs, and employee experience initiatives for our India and global teams. Collaborating closely with HR Centers of Excellence (Talent Acquisition, Total Rewards, Talent Development, HR Operations) and business leaders, you will gain hands\-on exposure to strategic HR, HR analytics, workforce planning, organizational development, and AI‑enabled HR tools, contributing to projects that improve employee experience, drive data‑driven decision making, and strengthen our culture.
 



**Be a Contributor — What You’ll Do** 



* Support HRBPs on people initiatives and employee experience programs for assigned client groups
* Coordinate key HR processes including goal setting, performance management, talent reviews, and promotions
* Prepare HR dashboards and reports using Oracle HCM, Microsoft Excel, and Power BI to summarize people metrics
* Use AI‑enabled tools and HR analytics platforms to summarize insights and automate routine HR reporting
* Analyze employee data (headcount, attrition, engagement) to identify patterns and draft recommendations for HRBPs
* Partner with HR Operations on onboarding, internal transfers, offboarding, and employee lifecycle activities
* Support employee engagement, recognition, and culture‑building activities including logistics and post‑event analysis
* Assist in documenting HR policies, standard operating procedures, and process improvements
* Participate in workforce planning by compiling headcount, pipeline, and skills data and updating org charts
* Experiment with generative AI tools under HRBP guidance, applying sound judgment and data privacy standards



**Be Prepared — What You Bring** 



* Bachelor’s degree (completed or in final year) in Human Resources, Business Administration, Psychology, Commerce, or related discipline
* 0–2 years of experience in HR, internships, or campus projects (HRBP, HR Operations, or People Analytics exposure is a plus)
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build trust across diverse stakeholders
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint; comfort working with data, reports, and basic dashboards
* Curiosity about HR analytics and digital HR tools, including interest in using AI responsibly to improve productivity
* Analytical mindset with strong problem‑solving skills, attention to detail, and a structured approach
* Ability to learn quickly, manage multiple tasks, and follow through in a fast‑paced, global environment
* High level of professionalism, integrity, and respect for confidentiality and data privacy
* Positive attitude with a growth mindset and enthusiasm for building a long‑term career in Human Resources



**Be Successful — Your Path** 




**First 90 Days:** 
 Immerse in our culture, connect with mentors (Blox Buddies), and map the systems and meet with key stakeholders that rely on your work. Discuss and create short/long term goals.
 



**Six Months:** 



* Support routine HRBP activities with increasing independence across core HR programs
* Build and maintain HR dashboards and standard reports for headcount, movement, and people metrics
* Contribute to at least one engagement or culture initiative, from planning through post‑event analysis
* Demonstrate ability to use Oracle HCM, collaboration tools, and at least one AI‑enabled or analytics tool
* Establish trusted working relationships with HR Operations, Talent Acquisition, and People \& Places colleagues



**One Year:** 



* Independently manage defined portions of HR cycles for assigned client groups
* Provide clear, data‑backed insights on attrition, hiring, engagement, and organization health
* Recommend at least one process improvement or automation using AI or analytics tools
* Be recognized as a reliable, detail‑oriented partner with strong stakeholder management skills
* Be considered for future opportunities within the HR function based on performance and business needs



**Belong — Your Community** 




 Our culture thrives on inclusion, rewarding the bold ideas, curiosity, and creativity that move us forward. In a community where every voice counts, continuous learning is the norm. So, whether you code, create, sell, or care for customers, you’ll grow and belong here.
 



**Be Rewarded — Benefits That Help You Grow, Thrive, Belong** 



* Comprehensive health coverage, generous PTO, and flexible work options
* Learning opportunities, career‑mobility programs, and leadership workshops
* Sixteen paid volunteer hours each year, global employee resource groups, and a “No Jerks” policy that keeps collaboration healthy

* We practice pay transparency and reward performance. Offers reflect role location, internal equity, experience, skills, education, and certifications



**Ready to Be the Difference?**

title: HR Manager Supply Chain - East Zone
description:
**HR Manager – Supply Chain (East Zone)**
 Function
   

  

 Human Resources
   

  

 Location
   

  

 Preferably East Zone (with travel across breweries and supply chain locations as required)
   

  

 Reporting To
   

  

 Zonal HR Head – South \& East
   

  

**Job Purpose**
 The HR Manager – Supply Chain will act as the primary HR partner for the Supply Chain function across the East Zone based out of UBGD Brewery. The role will be responsible for driving key HR processes and governance at unit level, while also partnering with Supply Chain and Business Leaders to support strategic people initiatives, workforce productivity, manpower budgeting, compliance, contract labour management, and performance tracking across multiple locations.
   

  

 The incumbent will play a critical role in coordinating and enabling HR initiatives across breweries and supply chain sites in East Zone, including Odisha, West Bengal, Andhra Pradesh, Telangana and other assigned locations.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 HR Business Partnering
   

  

* Partner with Supply Chain leadership and site management teams on people\-related priorities.
* Provide HR support on organization effectiveness, workforce planning, employee engagement and talent management.
* Act as the HRBP for Supply Chain teams across the East Zone and ensure alignment of HR initiatives with business objectives.
* Support leaders in driving productivity, manpower optimization and capability\-building initiatives.


 Compliance \& Governance
   

  

* Ensure adherence to labour laws, statutory requirements and company policies across assigned locations.
* Drive governance and compliance reviews related to contract labour, third\-party workforce and HR processes.
* Support audits, inspections and compliance assessments.
* Ensure timely closure of compliance observations and corrective actions.


 Contract Labour Management (CLMS)
   

  

* Drive effective implementation and governance of Contract Labour Management Systems (CLMS).
* Monitor contractor compliance, statutory documentation and workforce records.
* Partner with operations teams to improve contract labour productivity and cost efficiency.
* Support contract labour wage administration and related governance mechanisms.


 Payroll \& Employee Lifecycle Management
   

  

* Ensure accurate and timely payroll inputs and validation for employees and contract workforce, wherever applicable.
* Oversee employee lifecycle processes including onboarding, transfers, confirmations and separations.
* Resolve employee and stakeholder queries related to payroll and HR operations.


 Workforce Planning \& Budget Management
   

  

* Coordinate annual manpower budgeting and workforce planning exercises for the zone.
* Track manpower costs, productivity metrics and HR\-related financial KPIs.
* Support scenario planning and analysis to drive cost optimization initiatives.
* Provide periodic insights and reports to business and HR leadership.


 HR Analytics \& KPI Tracking
   

  

* Consolidate HR and business data from multiple units and locations.
* Prepare dashboards, presentations and management reviews for zonal leadership.
* Track key HR metrics including manpower, attrition, productivity, absenteeism, contract labour costs and compliance indicators.
* Drive data accuracy and timely reporting.


 Project Management \& Strategic Initiatives
   

  

* Coordinate cross\-location HR initiatives and supply chain projects across East Zone.
* Drive productivity and transformation projects in partnership with business leaders.
* Support implementation of new HR systems, processes and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Facilitate best practice sharing across breweries and supply chain units.


 Stakeholder Management
   

  

* Collaborate closely with Brewery HR teams, Supply Chain leaders, Finance, Procurement and Operations stakeholders.
* Act as a central coordination point for zonal HR projects and reviews.
* Influence and support business leaders in achieving organizational and people objectives.


 Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
   

  

* Compliance adherence and audit scores
* Contract Labour Management effectiveness
* Payroll accuracy and timeliness
* Workforce productivity improvements
* Manpower budget adherence
* HR analytics and reporting accuracy
* Talent and engagement initiatives completion
* Project delivery and stakeholder satisfaction
* Cost optimization and productivity gains


**Qualifications**
* MBA / PGDM in Human Resources or equivalent.
* 5\-8 years of HR experience, preferably in Manufacturing, FMCG, Supply Chain or Industrial Relations environment.
* Experience in HRBP, Compliance, Payroll and Contract Labour Management.
* Strong understanding of labour laws and manufacturing HR practices.


 Skills \& Competencies
   

  

* HR Business Partnering
* Labour Law \& Compliance
* Contract Labour Management
* HR Analytics \& Dashboarding
* Workforce Planning \& Budgeting
* Stakeholder Management
* Project Management
* Strong Excel and Data Management Skills
* Communication \& Influencing Skills
* Problem Solving and Execution Excellence


 Travel Requirement
   

  

 Moderate travel across breweries and supply chain locations within the East Zone as required for business reviews, compliance governance, project execution and stakeholder management.
   

  

**Positioning Statement:**
 This is a high\-impact HRBP role that combines operational excellence (Compliance, Payroll, CLMS) with strategic HR partnering, zonal coordination, productivity improvement and workforce cost management to support the Supply Chain agenda across the East Zone.

description:
**Title: HR \& Admin Manager** 




**Organization:** 
 STEM Shiksha Foundation, a not for profit sec 8 company
 



**Location:** 
 Officebing, Vikhroli West, Mumbai
 



**Reporting To:** 
 Head – Operations
 



  





**About Maker Bhavan Foundation (MBF)** 




 Maker Bhavan Foundation (MBF) is a non\-profit organization transforming engineering education across India by shifting learning from theoretical instruction to hands\-on, active problem\-solving. Founded by visionary tech alumni, entrepreneurs, and academicians, MBF equips academic institutions with the tools, funding, and expertise needed to cultivate future\-ready innovators and engineers. Through its flagship Tinkerers' Labs (24/7 student\-led makerspaces), MBF gives students direct access to rapid prototyping technology. Its high\-impact initiatives, such as the InventX summer invention internship, the Vishwakarma Awards, and the Center for Essential Skills, foster both technical ingenuity and professional readiness. Collaborating directly with governing bodies like AICTE on Project PRACTICE, MBF works to integrate project\-based learning into Tier\-II and Tier\-III colleges. Driven by a vision to embed a vibrant maker culture into higher education, Maker Bhavan Foundation aims to expand to 100s of engineering colleges by 2030, directly empowering 10% of India's graduating engineers each year to translate bold ideas into real\-world technological solutions.
 



  





**1\. Role Overview** 




 STEM Shiksha Foundation is seeking a highly organized and proactive
 **HR \& Admin Manager** 
 to manage our day\-to\-day office operations and internal people processes.
 



 This is an execution\-heavy role for someone who enjoys building order out of chaos. You will be the backbone of the office—ensuring our physical and digital workspaces run like clockwork while managing the end\-to\-end employee lifecycle for our growing team. We need a "doer" who is comfortable switching between vendor negotiations and recruitment screenings with ease.
 



  





**2\. Key Responsibilities** 




**A. Office Administration \& Digital Systems (70%)** 



* **Daily Operations:** 
 Oversee the day\-to\-day functioning of our office at Vikhroli; manage housekeeping, supplies, and general upkeep.
* **Digital Architecture:** 
 Act as the primary administrator for
 **Google Workspace** 
 . This includes managing user access, structuring shared drives, and ensuring a clean, intuitive file\-naming hierarchy.
* **Vendor Management:** 
 Source, negotiate with, and manage vendors for office utilities, stationery, and equipment.
* **Logistics Support:** 
 Coordinate travel, local transport, and scheduling for the leadership team and visiting stakeholders.
* **Documentation:** 
 Maintain rigorous digital and physical filing systems to ensure "audit\-ready" documentation at all times.



  





**B. HR Operations(30%)** 



* **Talent Acquisition:** 
 Manage the full recruitment funnel—posting jobs, initial resume screening, scheduling interviews, and maintaining a candidate database.
* **Onboarding \& Exits:** 
 Ensure every new hire has a seamless Day 1 (IT setup, documentation, orientation) and manage professional offboarding for exiting employees.
* **Policy Implementation:** 
 Roll out HR policies and ensure consistent adherence across the team.
* **Performance Support:** 
 Assist the Head of Operations in tracking KRAs and ensuring timely completion of performance review cycles.
* **Compliance:** 
 Maintain employee records, attendance, and basic HR compliance requirements.



  





**3\. Candidate Profile** 




**Experience** 



* 5–6 years of relevant HR \& Admin experience.
* Experience independently handling recruitment and HR operations.
* Prior experience in a startup, NGO, or small\-to\-mid\-sized education firm is highly preferred.



**Competencies** 



* **Execution Powerhouse:** 
 You don't just design processes; you enjoy the hands\-on work of implementing them.
* **Digital Fluency:** 
 Expert\-level command over Google Workspace (Drive, Sheets, Docs, Calendar). You should be the person others ask for help with digital tools.
* **Organizational Hygiene:** 
 A natural knack for organizing files, schedules, and physical spaces.
* **Discretion:** 
 High integrity and emotional intelligence when handling sensitive employee information.



  





**Compensation** 




 Compensation will be competitive and based on experience and capability.

 Mercom India, a subsidiary of U.S.\-based Mercom Capital Group, is a leading clean energy communications and consulting firm with expertise in renewable energy. Based in Bengaluru, Mercom India supports the Indian clean energy market through research, news, and communication services. Known for its leadership and impact, Mercom India actively helps shape India’s rapidly evolving clean energy sector.  Mercom is seeking an experienced Human Resources Manager with a proven ability to lead HR operations, recruitment, employee engagement, and organizational development. The ideal candidate will be proactive, strategic, and able to support a fast\-paced media, research and events environment
 



  





**Role Description** 




 This is a full\-time, on\-site role located in Bengaluru for a Human Resources Generalist. The HR Generalist will be responsible for overseeing daily HR operations, including the administration of HR policies, employee benefits, and ensuring compliance with applicable regulations. Additional responsibilities include managing recruitment, onboarding, employee engagement programs, and supporting various HR functions to enhance workplace culture and productivity.
 



  





**1\. HR Operations and Compliance** 



* Maintain accurate HR documentation, employee records, statutory compliance, and audit readiness.
* Ensure company policies are consistently applied across all teams.
* Maintain up to date knowledge of Indian labor laws, wage standards, and regulatory changes.



 ·       Oversee payroll coordination, leave management, and attendance systems with high accuracy.
 



**2\. Talent Acquisition and Recruitment Excellence** 



* Manage complete lifecycle recruitment for open positions.
* Drive talent sourcing through job portals, ATS, LinkedIn, internal databases, employee referrals, and strategic networking.
* Conduct structured screening, competency\-based interviewing, and salary negotiations.
* Build an annual hiring roadmap aligned with business growth.
* Create standardized interview frameworks and evaluation templates to ensure fair and consistent hiring.



**3\. Employee Onboarding and Orientation** 



* Develop a structured onboarding program with clear role expectations, culture orientation, and 30\-60\-90\-365 day plans.
* Ensure new hires have seamless integration into teams and company processes.



**4\. Performance Management and Goal Setting** 



* Implement quarterly and yearly performance review cycles.
* Partner with department heads to define KPIs, OKRs, and measurable performance goals.
* Conduct coaching sessions with managers to improve evaluation quality.
* Support the development of high\-performance talent pipelines.



**5\. Learning and Development** 



* Conduct training needs analysis and implement learning programs that support skill development across editorial, research, events, and business teams.
* Organize internal workshops, leadership training, communication skills programs, and technical upskilling.
* Track training effectiveness and recommend continuous improvements.



**6\. Culture Building and Employee Engagement** 



* Build a culture of trust, accountability, and openness.
* Plan structured engagement activities that support collaboration, wellness, and morale.
* Develop employee feedback systems and action plans based on insights.
* Establish mechanisms to identify early indicators of conflict, burnout, or policy deviations.



**7\. HR Policy Development and Governance** 



* Create and update HR policies, organizational handbooks, disciplinary guidelines, and workplace behavior frameworks.
* Ensure zero tolerance for any form of misconduct and maintain a safe, respectful working environment.
* Support leadership in communication of policies and organizational expectations.



**8\. Disciplinary Action and Workplace Management** 



* Handle employee relations issues, grievances, and investigations with discretion and professionalism.
* Conduct fact\-based disciplinary meetings aligned with company guidelines.
* Ensure timely resolution through structured processes and documented follow\-ups.



**9\. Strategic HR and Leadership Support** 



* Work closely with senior leadership to align HR priorities with business objectives.
* Provide data driven insights, HR metrics, and reports on hiring, retention, attrition, and performance.
* Contribute to organizational design, workforce planning, and future capability building.



**10\. Exit Management** 



* Conduct exit interviews, analyze patterns, and recommend corrective actions.
* Ensure smooth offboarding, full and final settlement coordination, and knowledge transfer.



  





**Experience** 




 Minimum 2 years to 8 years of proven HR experience.
 



  





**Qualifications**

* Experience with Employee Benefits administration and a strong understanding of Benefits Administration processes.
* Strong organizational, communication, and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to work collaboratively in a team and take proactive initiatives independently.
* MBA in HR,
 
 Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, or equivalent
* Experience in a mid\-sized organization and familiarity with employment laws, particularly within the Indian market, is a plus.

title: Onboarding Specialist
description:
**RAMCO CONGLOMERATE:** 




  





 Ramco Systems is part of the $1 billion\+ diversified Ramco Group, a legacy enterprise with deep roots in industries such as cement, textiles, engineering, software, energy, and biotech. With over 75 years of heritage and innovation, the Ramco Group is a global powerhouse that blends traditional business values with modern technologies.
 



  





 Ramco Systems is the Group’s technology arm, delivering next\-gen enterprise software across Global Payroll, HR, Aviation MRO, ERP, and Logistics. Headquartered in Chennai, India, Ramco serves over 1,000 customers across 35\+ countries and is recognized for its AI/ML\-based, bot\-enabled, and cloud\-native solutions.
 



  





 Our platform is designed for digital operations trusted by governments, Fortune 500 companies, and high\-growth enterprises alike.
 



 If you’re looking to be part of a company that combines innovation, global exposure, and a mission to disrupt legacy systems with intelligent enterprise applications Ramco is the place to be.
 



  





**ROLE OVERVIEW:** 




  





 We are looking for a smart, energetic, and detail\-oriented HR professional to lead the end\-to\-end onboarding experience for our global workforce.
 



 While HR SPOCs support employees in local regions, the onboarding process is centrally managed from India. This role ensures seamless onboarding execution, compliance, documentation accuracy, employee wellness initiatives, and support for organisation\-wide engagement programmes.
 



 The ideal candidate combines strong operational discipline with a passion for creating excellent employee experiences. Success is judged by new hires who are productive from day one, and by records that hold up under audit without a scramble.
 



  





**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES** 




  





**Global Onboarding Management** 




 ▪ Manage end\-to\-end onboarding for employees across global locations.
 



 ▪ Coordinate with HR Business Partners, hiring managers, recruiters, IT, facilities, and regional HR teams to ensure readiness before joining.
 



 ▪ Conduct new hire induction programmes and ensure a consistent onboarding experience across regions.
 



 ▪ Track completion of onboarding milestones and drive timely closure of pending activities.
 



 ▪ Manage onboarding communications, documentation, and employee queries.
 



 Compliance, Verification \& Audit
 



 ▪ Own background verification and related documentation processes.
 



 ▪ Conduct periodic audits of employee records, onboarding documents, and compliance requirements.
 



 ▪ Ensure process adherence and maintain accurate employee data across HR systems.
 



 ▪ Identify process gaps and implement controls to improve quality, compliance, and operational efficiency.
 



 ▪ Support internal and external audit requirements related to onboarding and employee records.
 



  





**Employee Wellness \& Experience** 




 ▪ Coordinate and drive employee wellness initiatives across the organisation.
 



 ▪ Partner with wellness vendors and internal stakeholders to increase participation and awareness.
 



 ▪ Monitor programme effectiveness through participation metrics and employee feedback.
 



 ▪ Support campaigns related to physical, mental, and emotional well\-being.
 



  





**Employee Engagement \& Communication** 




 ▪ Support organisation\-wide engagement initiatives and cultural programmes.
 



 ▪ Coordinate quarterly town halls, leadership connects, employee events, and recognition activities.
 



 ▪ Coordinate with external vendors for payment processing, organisational presentations, and award registrations and submissions, working closely with the CHRO to support strategic initiatives.
 



 ▪ Work with internal stakeholders to ensure seamless execution of engagement programmes.
 



 ▪ Gather employee feedback and provide insights to improve employee experience.
 



  





**WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE** 




 ▪ New hires who arrive to a ready desk, ready access, and a clear first week — wherever in the world they join.
 



 ▪ A consistent onboarding experience across regions, not one that varies by who is coordinating it.
 



 ▪ Employee records and verification documentation that stand up to audit without preparation.
 



 ▪ Wellness and engagement programmes that people actually turn up to.
 



 ▪ Process gaps found and closed before they become audit findings.
 



  





**KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS (KPIs)** 




 Performance in this role is measured against the following indicators. Targets are set annually with the Head of HR Operations and reviewed on the cadence noted.
 



 ▪ Onboarding readiness and milestone closure — new hires with all pre\-joining activities complete before day one, and onboarding milestones closed within the defined timeline. (Monthly)
 



 ▪ New hire experience — induction completion, and new\-hire feedback on the onboarding experience across regions. (Quarterly)
 



 ▪ Background verification and record accuracy — verification cases closed within the agreed timeline, and accuracy of employee data across HR systems. (Monthly)
 



 ▪ Audit and control outcomes — audit findings on onboarding and employee records closed within timeline, and process gaps closed with controls implemented. (Quarterly)
 



 ▪ Wellness programme participation — participation rates and employee feedback on wellness initiatives. (Quarterly)
 



 ▪ Engagement calendar delivery — town halls, leadership connects, events, and recognition activities delivered to calendar, with vendor coordination and award submissions completed on time. (Quarterly)
 



  





**REQUIRED EXPERIENCE \& SKILLS** 




 ▪ 2 to 4 years of experience in HR Operations, Onboarding, Employee Experience, or HR Shared Services.
 



 ▪ MBA or PGDM.
 



 ▪ Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.
 



 ▪ High attention to detail with excellent process orientation.
 



 ▪ Ability to manage multiple priorities and work across geographies and time zones.
 



 ▪ Proficiency in Excel, HRMS platforms, and reporting tools.
 



 ▪ Passion for creating engaging employee experiences while ensuring operational excellence.
 



  





**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS** 




 ▪ Experience in a fast\-paced IT company, Global Capability Centre (GCC), or multinational organisation.
 



 ▪ Exposure to IT Services, Product Engineering, or technology environments.
 



 ▪ Experience running background verification and employee\-record audit processes.
 



  





**WHY JOIN RAMCO SYSTEMS** 




 ▪ Own the onboarding experience for a global workforce from a single central hub.
 



 ▪ Visible impact from day one every new joiner meets your process first.
 



 ▪ Exposure to wellness, engagement, and cultural programmes alongside core HR operations.
 



 ▪ Be part of a fast\-evolving, innovation\-led enterprise software company.

description:

 A Day in the Life

 \#BetterDaysStartNow

* Ensures the execution and continuous improvement of logistics processes, such as the replenishment system, data interchange systems, demand management, electronic data systems administration, and related functions.
* Ensures that customer service and time objectives are achieved within existing financial constraints in order to meet marketing and financial objectives.
* Builds relationships with manufacturing, suppliers, and customers through the resolution of delivery issues.

**Key Responsibilities \& Requirements**

* Perform Fit\-Gap Analysis by evaluating current warehouse operations against SAP best practices to enhance inventory accuracy, warehouse efficiency, and order fulfillment processes.
* Configure, support, and maintain SAP logistics modules including: SAP EWM SAP WM SAP Inventory Management SAP TM
* Support warehouse operations including inbound/outbound processing, picking, packing, putaway, replenishment, cycle counting, and shipping activities.
* Utilize Winshuttle and LSMW for data migration, mass uploads, and SAP process automation activities.
* Manage and maintain logistics master data including material masters, storage bins, handling units, batch management, and warehouse organizational structures.
* Develop custom SAP reports, KPIs, dashboards, and analytics using: Microsoft Power BI Microsoft Excel SAP reporting and query tools
* Conduct data validation, cleansing, and harmonization to ensure accuracy and integrity across warehouse and logistics systems.
* Lead User Acceptance Testing (UAT), System Integration Testing (SIT), and defect resolution activities for SAP enhancements and implementations on business side
* Create and maintain functional specifications, process documentation and SOPs
* Train end\-users and provide post\-go\-live production support for SAP warehouse and distribution functionalities.
* Collaborate with supply chain, procurement, transportation, warehouse operations, and IT teams to optimize logistics performance and warehouse throughput.
* Support SAP implementation, migration, upgrade, and enhancement projects while minimizing operational disruption.
* Identify warehouse process bottlenecks and recommend automation and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Assist with inventory reconciliation, stock movement analysis, and root cause analysis for warehouse discrepancies.
* Utilize SQL queries and SAP data extraction techniques to analyze logistics performance trends and support operational reporting.
* Monitor KPIs including inventory accuracy, order cycle time, picking accuracy, warehouse utilization, and on\-time shipment performance.
* Support change management initiatives and ensure compliance with operational standards, audit controls, and warehouse procedures.
* SAP Master Data Warehouse, Logistics and Distribution, Warehouse management, SAP system, basic medical drives , pharma, industry not needed, warehouse prospective.

Delivers and/or manages projects assigned and works with other stakeholders to achieve desired results. May act as a mentor to colleagues or may direct the work of other lower level professionals.  Entry\-level individual contributor on a project or work team. Works with close supervision.

 Communicates primarily with internal contacts within immediate group. Contacts others to gather, confirm and convey information.

 N / A – job at this level is focused on self\-development.

 High School Diploma, Vocational diploma, or equivalent with 2\+ years of relevant experience in Supply Chain Logistics (or equivalent experience) OR Associate's Degree with 1\+ year experience OR Baccalaureate Degree with 0\+ years experience.
   

  

**Physical Job Requirements**
 The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by employees assigned to this position, but they are not an exhaustive list of all the required responsibilities and skills of this position.

 At MiniMed, we put people first. A commitment to our employees lives at the core of our values: We recognize their contributions. They share in the success they help create. We offer a wide range of benefits, resources, and competitive compensation plans designed to support you at every stage of your career and life.

We're looking for early\-career engineers who are curious, eager to learn, and want to build real\-world data systems from day one.
   

  

**About The Role**
 As a Data Engineer (Entry Level), you'll work closely with senior engineers to build and maintain data pipelines, write and optimize SQL, and support our cloud\-based data warehouse. This role is ideal for freshers or engineers with up to 2 years of experience who want strong mentorship and hands\-on exposure to modern data engineering tools and practices.
   

  

**A Snapshot Of Your Responsibilities**
* Assist in building and maintaining data pipelines under the guidance of senior engineers.
* Write, test, and optimize SQL queries to extract, transform, and validate data.
* Support batch data ingestion and basic ETL/ELT workflows using Python.
* Help maintain data quality by running basic checks and flagging inconsistencies.
* Learn and work within our cloud data warehouse (Snowflake/Databricks) under supervision.
* Document your work — data flow notes, basic technical specs, and test cases.
* Participate in code reviews and incorporate feedback to improve code quality.
* Collaborate with analytics and business teams to understand data needs.
* Take a proactive approach to learning new tools, languages, and best practices.
* Communicate progress and blockers clearly with your team.


**What You Will Need**
 For Freshers (0 years experience):
   

  

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, IT, or a related field.
* Basic understanding of SQL — able to write simple SELECT, JOIN, and aggregation queries.
* Basic knowledge of Python programming.
* Basic awareness of data warehousing concepts (tables, schemas, ETL at a conceptual level).
* Understanding of relational databases and data structures.
* Strong willingness to learn, good analytical thinking, and attention to detail.
* Good verbal and written communication skills.


 For 1–2 Years Experienced:
   

  

* 1–2 years of hands\-on experience in a data engineering, analytics engineering, or similar role.
* Working knowledge of SQL, including joins, aggregations, and basic performance tuning.
* Hands\-on experience with Python; exposure to PySpark is a plus.
* Exposure to a cloud data warehouse or lakehouse platform (Snowflake, Databricks, Redshift, or BigQuery).
* Basic exposure to ETL/data pipeline tools (e.g., Airflow, dbt, Fivetran) is a plus.
* Familiarity with version control (Git/GitHub/Bitbucket).
* Basic understanding of any cloud platform (AWS, Azure, or GCP).
* Good problem\-solving skills and ability to work in an agile team environment.


**Nice to Have**

title: Data Engineer
description:
**About ADA**
 ADA is the Data and AI Experience Company. Present in 14 markets globally, we build intelligent experiences that power enterprise growth, spanning identity and authentication, personalization, commerce, and data \& AI foundations; where every touchpoint earns trust, every interaction creates value, and every decision runs on real\-time intelligence, so enterprises can stay ahead and deliver measurable outcomes. Our mission is to build the world's most intelligent growth platform for every client we serve. We work with over 1,500 global brands across CPG, Retail, Telco, BFSI, and Healthcare.
   

  

**About The Team**
 Our Connector Engineering group builds and operates data connectors that bring customer data from hundreds of third\-party API\-based systems into warehouses. Engineers use an internal declarative framework, authoring structured connector definitions for entities, endpoints, authentication, and sync behavior that the shared framework executes, tests, and runs in production.
   

  

 The framework powers several hundred production connectors. Connector engineering pods own portfolios of live connectors—building new ones, extending existing ones, fixing bugs, and handling incidents.
   

  

 What You'll Do
   

  

* Build and ship connectors: Design, author, and maintain connector definitions for third\-party REST and GraphQL APIs owned by your team, from requirements through General Availability.
* Extend existing connectors: Add new tables, entities, endpoints, and feature flags to live connectors in response to customer requests and support escalations — for example, adding a new API object, supporting a new region or credential format, or enabling a new sync mode.
* Own production health: Triage and resolve incidents on your team's connectors, debug sync failures across a distributed system, and drive root\-cause fixes.
* Work within the connector framework: Write connector definitions following the framework's syntax and rules, validate changes with the framework's validation and local\-testing tooling, and write hybrid backend code for logic that can't be expressed declaratively.
* Handle auth and credentials: Implement OAuth and other authentication flows for new connectors, and run credential migrations safely across existing production connections.
* Partner with the platform/framework team: Work with the team that owns the shared connector framework when a requirement needs a new framework capability (e.g., custom report support, new deployment modes ), and help evaluate framework\-based vs. fully custom build decisions for new connectors.
* Test and validate : Write and maintain automated tests (unit, integration, and build\-system\-level test suites) and support workflow/orchestration\-based sync testing for your connectors.
* Collaborate cross\-functionally: Work with Product, Support, and Technical Writing to scope new connectors, resolve customer\-impacting issues, and keep setup/overview documentation accurate .


 What We're Looking For
   

  

* 2–3 years of professional software engineering experience, ideally building backend services, third\-party API integrations, or ELT/data\-pipeline connectors.
* Strong proficiency in Java (or a comparable statically typed backend language); comfort picking up a declarative or functional DSL used for connector definitions.
* Solid understanding of REST and GraphQL APIs: authentication (OAuth 2\.0 and others), pagination, rate limiting, and webhooks.
* Working knowledge of data sync/ELT concepts — incremental vs. historical sync, schema design , and idempotency .
* Strong debugging skills: comfortable reading logs, tracing failures through a multi\-service system, and root\-causing production incidents under time pressure.
* Experience with Git\-based workflows and collaborative code review.
* Clear written communication — this role works closely with Support, Product, Technical Writing, and the platform team, often asynchronously.


 Nice to Have
   

  

* Exposure to large\-scale build systems (e.g., Bazel, Gradle, Maven).
* Familiarity with workflow\-orchestration frameworks (e.g., Temporal, Airflow, Step Functions).
* Prior experience maintaining SaaS/API connectors or working on an integrations team.
* Interest in AI\-assisted engineering tooling for connector generation or documentation.


 Success in the First 3 Months
   

  

* Independently triage, debug, and resolve incidents on the team's owned connectors.
* Navigate the connector definition , validation tooling, and test suites without heavy hand holding .
* Build working relationships with the platform/framework team, Support, and Product stakeholders.

 Deep expertise in AWS services and architectures, including but not limited to:
   

  

 Compute: EC2, Amazon EKS, Amazon ECS, AWS Lambda, AWS Fargate, AWS Batch.
   

  

 Storage \& Databases: Amazon S3, Amazon RDS, Amazon Aurora, Amazon Redshift, DynamoDB, Amazon Keyspaces, Amazon ElastiCache.
   

  

 Data \& Analytics: AWS Glue (ETL, Data Catalog, DataBrew), Amazon EMR, Amazon Athena, Amazon Kinesis (Data Streams, Firehose, Managed Service for Apache Flink), Amazon MSK, AWS DMS, AWS Lake Formation, Amazon MWAA, AWS Step Functions, Amazon QuickSight.
   

  

 Operations \& Monitoring: Amazon CloudWatch, AWS CloudTrail, AWS X\-Ray, AWS Cost Explorer.
   

  

 Strong SQL skills, including performance tuning on large datasets.
   

  

 Proven ability to translate business requirements into technical solutions.
   

  

 Excellent analytical, problem\-solving, and critical\-thinking skills.
   

  

 Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
   

  

 Experience working in an Agile development methodology.
   

  

 Ability to work independently, manage multiple priorities, and meet tight deadlines.
   

  

**Preferred Skills (Nice To Have)**
 AWS Certified Data Engineer – Associate, or AWS Certified Solutions Architect certification.
   

  

 Proficiency in Python or PySpark for data manipulation and automation.

 * Identify and consolidate operational information currently communicated through WhatsApp and other informal channels.
* Convert unstructured messages into structured operational data.
* Categorize information relating to production, maintenance, utilities, quality, breakdowns, manpower, energy and environmental performance.
* Use AI/NLP tools to extract important information automatically.
* Develop daily and weekly 
 **Plant Intelligence Reports** 
 .
* Identify recurring problems, abnormal events and operational trends.



 The objective is to move from 
 **"collecting reports" to "generating intelligence."** 



 2\. Improve Plant Energy Efficiency
 
 Analyze plant data to identify opportunities to reduce:
 


* Electricity consumption
* Steam consumption
* Fuel consumption
* Energy consumption per MT of production
* Compressed air and utility losses
* Equipment running losses
* Abnormal energy consumption



 The candidate should be able to identify questions such as:
 



**Why has energy consumption per MT increased?** 




**Which equipment or process is responsible?** 




**Where are we losing energy?** 




**What corrective action can reduce the cost?** 



 3\. Improve Manufacturing Efficiency
 
 Analyze production data to identify:
 


* Production efficiency
* Batch\-wise performance
* Production delays
* Downtime
* Process deviations
* Recurring operational problems
* Production losses
* Raw\-material consumption
* Yield variations



 The candidate will work closely with 
 **Production, Maintenance, Utilities, ETP and Plant Management teams** 
 .
 


 4\. Maintenance \& Breakdown Intelligence
 
 Create a structured system to track:
 


* Equipment breakdowns
* Downtime
* Maintenance requests
* Preventive maintenance
* Corrective actions
* Root\-cause analysis
* Spare\-parts requirements
* Repeated equipment failures
* Pending maintenance activities



 The system should clearly show:
 



**Issue → Responsible Person → Target Date → Action → Status → Closure** 




**Management should be able to immediately identify overdue and recurring problems** 
 .
 


 5\. Pollution \& Environmental Data
 
 Analyze operational and environmental data to identify opportunities to reduce:
 


* Pollution load
* SO₂/SO₃\-related emissions
* Acid mist
* Effluent load
* Waste generation
* Chemical losses
* Abnormal operating conditions



 The objective is to use data to identify 
 **the operating conditions that contribute to higher pollution and develop preventive actions.** 



 6\. Manpower \& Labour Productivity
 
 Analyze manpower deployment against production and plant requirements.
 



 Identify:
 


* Idle manpower
* Overtime
* Shift\-wise manpower utilization
* Repetitive manual activities
* Opportunities for automation
* Labour productivity
* Manpower requirements by activity/process



 The objective is to improve 
 **manpower utilization and operational productivity** 
 .
 


 Build a Digital Plant Monitoring Application
 
 A major part of this role will be to help develop a 
 **web\-based application for plant operations and issue management** 
 .
 



 The application should eventually allow plant personnel to enter and monitor:
 


* Daily production
* Shift production
* Raw\-material consumption
* Energy consumption
* Utility consumption
* Quality parameters
* Breakdown information
* Maintenance activities
* ETP/environmental parameters
* Manpower deployment
* Corrective actions



 The candidate may build the application directly using appropriate technologies and AI\-assisted development tools, or work with external developers to implement the system.
 


 Management Dashboard \& AI Reporting
 
 The ultimate objective is to create a management dashboard that can answer, at any time:
 


 Plant Performance
 * What was produced?
* What was the target?
* What was the variance?


 Energy
 * Energy consumption/MT?
* Is it improving or deteriorating?
* Where is the abnormal consumption?


 Maintenance
 * What broke down?
* How much production was lost?
* Which problems are recurring?
* What actions are overdue?


 Environment
 * Are pollution parameters within expected levels?
* What operational factors are affecting them?


 Management Actions
 * What are today's critical issues?
* Who is responsible?
* What is overdue?
* What requires management intervention?


 Skills \& Qualifications
 
 Candidates with experience or knowledge in some or all of the following will be preferred:
 


* Advanced Excel
* SQL
* Power BI / Tableau
* Data cleaning and analysis
* Dashboard development
* Python
* Artificial Intelligence / Generative AI
* AI agents and automation
* APIs and database integration
* Web application development
* Process automation
* Data visualization
* Business intelligence



 Experience in 
 **chemical manufacturing, pharmaceuticals, process industries, manufacturing or industrial operations** 
  will be an advantage.
 



 However, we are equally interested in candidates who may not have extensive manufacturing experience but demonstrate 
 **exceptional analytical ability, technology skills and the ability to understand real\-world business problems.** 



 What We Are Looking For
 
 We are 
 **not looking for someone who simply prepares reports and dashboards** 
 .
 



 We are looking for someone who can look at plant data and ask:
 


**Where are we losing money?** 
**Why is this happening?** 
**Can we predict it before it happens again?** 
**Can AI automate the monitoring and follow\-up?** 
**What action should management take?** 

 The successful candidate will have the opportunity to work directly with 
 **plant operations and senior management** 
  and build systems that have a measurable impact on the company's manufacturing operations.
 


 Success in this role will be measured by real business outcomes:
 * Lower energy cost per MT
* Lower production downtime
* Reduction in recurring breakdowns
* Better manpower utilization
* Reduction in pollution load
* Faster closure of plant issues
* Improved production efficiency
* Automation of manual reporting
* Better visibility and control for management



**If you are excited by the opportunity to combine AI, data and technology with real\-world chemical manufacturing, we would like to hear from you.**

 Analyst, Big Data Analytics \& Engineering

By leveraging secure data, cutting\-edge technology, and innovative solutions, we empower individuals, financial institutions, governments, and businesses to achieve their potential.

 Position Overview
   

  

 Based in Gurgaon, India, this is a techno\-functional position that combines strong technical skills with a deep understanding of business needs and requirements. The role focuses on developing and maintaining advanced business analytics and AI\-driven solutions for pre\-sales value quantification. As an Analyst, you will be responsible for creating and optimizing tools that help Mastercard’s internal teams quantify the value of services, enhance customer engagement, and drive business outcomes. You will combine AI and analytics to deliver actionable insights, empowering teams to make informed decisions and strengthen client value propositions. The role requires close collaboration across teams to ensure tools meet business needs and deliver measurable impact.
   

  

 \_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_
   

  

 Role Responsibilities
   

  

* Value Quantification \& Tool Development


 Develop tools and solutions to quantify the value of Mastercard’s services during the pre\-sales process, enabling internal teams to effectively communicate value to customers.
   

  

* Data Analysis and Management


 Manage and analyse large datasets using SQL and other database management systems to support value quantification efforts.
   

  

 Perform statistical analysis to identify trends, correlations, and insights that inform strategic decisions
   

  

* Business Intelligence and Reporting


 Utilize business intelligence platforms such as Tableau or Power BI to create insightful dashboards and reports that communicate the value of services
   

  

 Generate actionable insights from data to inform strategic decisions and provide clear, data\-backed recommendations
   

  

* AI \& Analytics Integration for Business Impact


 Use AI and advanced analytics techniques to enhance pre\-sales tools, enabling data\-driven insights that support customer engagement, strategic decision\-making, and business outcomes.
   

  

* Cross\-Functional Collaboration \& Stakeholder Engagement


 Collaborate with Sales, Marketing, Consulting, Product, and other internal teams to understand business needs and ensure successful tool development and deployment.
   

  

 Communicate insights and tool value through compelling presentations and dashboards to senior leadership and internal teams, ensuring tool adoption and usage to senior leadership and internal teams, ensuring tool adoption and usage.
   

  

* Insight Generation, Reporting \& Process Optimization


 Generate actionable insights from data to inform strategic decisions, providing clear, data\-backed recommendations to improve pre\-sales efforts and customer engagement.
   

  

 \_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_
   

  

**All About You**
 Data Analytics and Business Intelligence:
   

  

 Proficiency in data analytics tools and techniques to analyse and interpret complex datasets.
   

  

 Experience in creating insightful dashboards and reports using business intelligence platforms such as Tableau, Power BI, or similar tools.
   

  

**AI And Machine Learning**
 Knowledge of AI and machine learning algorithms to enhance pre\-sales tools and generate data\-driven insights.
   

  

 Familiarity with programming languages such as Python or R for developing and implementing machine learning models
   

  

**Advanced Excel Skills**
 Strong skills in Excel, including advanced functions, pivot tables, and data visualization, to build and optimize ROI calculators and other analytical tools
   

  

**Database Management And SQL**
 Experience with database management systems and proficiency in SQL for querying and managing large datasets
   

  

**Web\-Based Platforms**
 Understanding of web\-based platforms and tools for developing end\-to\-end solutions that cater to pre\-sales needs
   

  

**Statistical Analysis**
 Ability to perform statistical analysis to identify trends, correlations, and insights that support strategic decision\-making
   

  

**Cross\-Functional Collaboration**
 Strong collaboration skills to work effectively with Sales, Marketing, Consulting, Product, and other internal teams to understand business needs and ensure successful tool development and deployment
   

  

**Communication And Presentation**
 Excellent communication skills to convey insights and tool value through compelling presentations and dashboards to senior leadership and internal teams
   

  

 Execution Focus
   

  

 A results\-driven mindset with the ability to balance strategic vision with tactical execution, ensuring that tools and solutions are delivered on time and create measurable business value.
   

  

 Education
   

  

 Bachelor’s degree in data science, Computer Science, Business Analytics, Economics, Finance, or a related field. Advanced degrees or certifications in analytics, data science, or AI/ML are preferred
   

  

 \_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_
   

  

 Why Us?
   

  

 At Mastercard, you’ll have the opportunity to shape the future of internal operations by leading the development of value quantification solutions that empower teams across the organization. Join us to make a meaningful impact, drive business outcomes, and help Mastercard’s internal teams create better customer engagement strategies through innovative value\-based ROI narratives.
   

  

 Location: Pune, India

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

title: Machine Learning Engineer
description:
**ABOUT ADGRID** 




 AdGrid is an early\-stage, stealth\-mode AdTech–FinTech company based in Gurugram, building a platform at the intersection of advertising technology and financial infrastructure. We are a small, fast\-moving team hiring the people who will help shape the company from the ground up.
 



  





**ROLE SUMMARY** 




 We are looking for a Machine Learning Engineer to build and ship intelligent voice and language experiences across speech, LLMs, retrieval, and memory. You will work on STT, TTS, RAG, model training, and on\-device AI, taking ML systems from data and experimentation to production.
 



  





**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES** 



* Build and optimise speech\-to\-text (STT) and text\-to\-speech (TTS) pipelines for natural, low\-latency voice interactions.
* Improve speech accuracy across Indian languages, accents, and noisy real\-world environments.
* Build LLM\-powered features using Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG), embeddings, vector search, and grounded responses.
* Design and manage short\-term context and long\-term memory across sessions.
* Work on prompt design, model evaluation, and continuous improvement of response quality.
* Create, train, fine\-tune, and evaluate models across speech, language, and retrieval use cases.
* Work across the complete ML lifecycle, including data, features, training, evaluation, and iteration.
* Run and optimise LLMs and speech models locally, on\-device, or at the edge.
* Optimize models for edge deployment through quantization, compression, and efficient runtimes.
* Ship ML models to production and contribute to serving, monitoring, and retraining.
* Build reliable data and training pipelines.
* Work closely with product and engineering teams to turn AI ideas into production\-ready features.



  





**WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR** 



* 2–3 years of hands\-on experience building ML and AI systems, with experience shipping toward production.
* Hands\-on experience or strong project work with speech\-to\-text (STT) and text\-to\-speech (TTS) pipelines.
* Experience building LLM systems using RAG, embeddings, vector search, and model memory/context.
* Experience creating, training, fine\-tuning, and evaluating ML models.
* Strong understanding of deep learning, with hands\-on experience using PyTorch and good fundamentals in mathematics and statistics.
* Experience with local or edge execution of LLMs, including running and optimising models on\-device or at the edge.
* Strong Python skills and solid software engineering practices, including Git and testing.
* Experience with LLMs, RAG frameworks such as LangChain/LlamaIndex, vector databases, and fine\-tuning techniques such as PEFT/LoRA.
* Familiarity with model optimisation techniques such as quantisation, compression, distillation, or pruning is a plus.
* Exposure to MLOps, experiment tracking, model monitoring, Docker, CI/CD, and cloud platforms such as AWS, GCP, or Azure is a plus.
* Experience with Indian languages, multilingual or code\-mixed speech/NLP, agentic systems, or real\-time audio systems is an advantage.
* Good problem\-solving skills and ability to work independently in a fast\-moving environment.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, IT, or a related field.
* Available to work full\-time from our Gurugram office (on\-site).



  





**HOW TO APPLY** 




 Interested candidates may send their resume to career@adgrid.ai. A GitHub profile, research paper, or link to an AI/ML
 



 project you have built is welcome.

 We’re building a consumer product where reliability, usability, privacy, and trust are critical.
   




**About the Role** 

 We’re looking for a Quality Assurance Test Engineer to help us test and improve Typesider as we continue developing and releasing the product.
 



 You’ll work closely with the product and development teams to test the Windows application, identify bugs, explore edge cases, and ensure new features work reliably for real users.
 



 This is a hands on role where you’ll have a direct impact on product quality.
   




**What You’ll Do** 

 • Test the Typesider Windows desktop application across different user scenarios
 



 • Create, document, and execute manual test cases and test scenarios
 



 • Perform functional, regression, exploratory, integration, and usability testing
 



 • Test the complete user journey, including installation, onboarding, streaks, reward days, reward claims, and redemption
 



 • Test new features and product updates before release
 



 • Identify bugs, edge cases, and usability issues
 



 • Document bugs clearly with steps to reproduce, expected behavior, actual behavior, severity, and supporting information
 



 • Verify fixes and perform regression testing
 



 • Test different Windows environments and user scenarios
 



 • Work closely with developers and the product team to understand and resolve issues
 



 • Think like a real user and identify issues that could impact trust, engagement, retention, and overall experience
 



 • Help improve testing processes and documentation as the product grows
   




**What We’re Looking For** 

 • 0–3 years of experience in QA, software testing, or a related field
 



 • Freshers and candidates with 1–3 years of experience are welcome to apply
 



 • Good understanding of manual testing and software testing principles
 



 • Ability to create and execute clear test cases and test scenarios
 



 • Understanding of functional, regression, exploratory, integration, and usability testing
 



 • Strong attention to detail and ability to identify bugs and edge cases
 



 • Ability to write clear and reproducible bug reports
 



 • Good analytical and problem solving skills
 



 • Strong written and verbal communication skills
 



 • Comfortable working closely with developers and product teams
 



 • Willingness to explore a product deeply and question how things work
   




**Good to Have** 

 • Experience testing Windows desktop applications
 



 • Familiarity with Jira or similar bug tracking tools
 



 • Basic understanding of API testing
 



 • Exposure to automation testing or QA automation tools
 



 • Experience testing consumer software or applications involving rewards, subscriptions, payments, or user accounts
   




**What We Value** 

 We’re looking for someone who doesn't just follow a checklist.
 



 A good QA engineer should be able to ask:
 



 What happens if the user does this?
 



 What happens if the system fails here?
 



 Can this feature be misunderstood or misused?
 



 Does this actually work the way a real user would expect?
 



 Your ability to think through these scenarios and uncover problems will be a major part of the role.
   




**Why Join Typesider** 

 Typesider is an early stage consumer product, so you’ll have the opportunity to work closely with the team building the product and see your work directly influence releases.
 



 You’ll be testing a product used by real users and helping build the quality standards and QA processes as the product grows.
   




**Work Details** 

 Experience: 0–3 Years
 



 Compensation: ₹3–5 LPA
 



 Employment Type: Full\-time
 



 Location: Noida, Uttar Pradesh
 



 Work Mode: Hybrid
 



 Working Days: Monday to Friday
 



 Working Hours: 10AM \- 6PM
