title: Graduate Engineer Trainee
description:
**About the role** 
 GreyOrange is looking for a Graduate Engineer Trainee – Firmware Quality Assurance to support embedded firmware validation and quality assurance for robotic systems.
   

  

 The role involves working closely with Firmware, Electronics, Software, Product Engineering, and Quality teams to identify and resolve firmware issues before Functional Acceptance Testing (FAT) and customer deployment.
   

  

 We are looking for a hands\-on engineer with a strong interest in embedded systems, robotics, firmware testing, debugging, communication protocols, and quality engineering. The candidate will be involved in validating firmware on robots, controllers, sensors, and VDA systems.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 Embedded Firmware Quality \& Validation
   

  

* Test and validate embedded firmware releases before FAT and site deployment.
* Perform firmware\-level checks on robots, controllers, sensors, and VDA systems.
* Identify firmware defects, reproduce issues, and provide clear debugging information to the Firmware team.
* Validate bug fixes and perform regression testing before firmware releases.
* Review firmware release and change logs and ensure that changes are adequately tested.


 Embedded Debugging \& Troubleshooting
   

  

* Debug firmware\-related issues using logs, diagnostic tools, and communication interfaces.
* Support troubleshooting of CAN, UART, RS\-232/RS\-485, Ethernet, and other embedded communication protocols.
* Understand communication between controllers, sensors, motor drivers, and other robotic electronics.
* Support root\-cause analysis to determine whether issues are related to firmware, electronics, communication, or software.
* Perform remote debugging and embedded\-level checks on VDA and robotic systems.


 FAT \& Robot Validation
   

  

* Support Functional Acceptance Testing (FAT) and internal robot testing from a firmware quality perspective.
* Ensure firmware is adequately validated before robots are released for FAT.
* Create firmware test cases, checklists, and regression test plans.
* Track firmware defects through closure and verify fixes.
* Contribute towards achieving zero firmware\-related defects during FAT.


 Quality \& Engineering Collaboration
   

  

* Work closely with Firmware, Electronics, Software, Product Engineering, and Quality teams.
* Support CAPA and root\-cause analysis for firmware\-related field issues.
* Analyze recurring firmware failures and recommend preventive actions.
* Maintain defect trackers, test results, logs, and firmware validation reports.


**Qualifications \& Experience**
* Bachelor's degree in Electronics \& Communication Engineering (ECE), Electronics, Electrical Engineering, Embedded Systems, Mechatronics, Computer Engineering, or a related discipline from a recognized institute.
* 0–2 years of relevant experience in embedded systems, firmware testing, quality assurance, or related areas.
* Fresh graduates with strong academic projects or internships in embedded systems may also be considered.
* Good understanding of microcontrollers, embedded systems, and firmware architecture.
* Basic programming knowledge in C/C\+\+.
* Understanding of communication protocols such as CAN, UART, SPI, I2C, RS\-232/RS\-485, and Ethernet.
* Ability to read basic electronic schematics and understand sensors, controllers, and interfaces.
* Exposure to robotics, AMRs, AGVs, automotive ECUs, or industrial automation is preferred.


**Required Skills \& Tools**
* Hands\-on approach to embedded firmware testing, troubleshooting, and debugging.
* Ability to analyze logs, firmware versions, communication errors, and test results.
* Familiarity with debugging and testing tools such as:
+ CAN analyzers
+ Serial terminals
+ Debuggers
+ Oscilloscopes
+ Logic analyzers

* Basic understanding of quality and problem\-solving methodologies such as 5 Why, Fishbone Analysis, CAPA, root\-cause analysis, and validation testing.
* Working knowledge of Microsoft Office.
* Familiarity with JIRA or other defect tracking systems is an advantage.
* Good written and verbal communication skills.


 Travel \& Work Expectations
   

  

* Willingness to travel to supplier locations, GreyOrange facilities, and customer sites based on business requirements.
* Comfortable working with global and cross\-functional teams across different time zones.
* Willingness to participate in hands\-on robot testing, firmware validation, troubleshooting, and plant activities.

title: Quality Assurance Engineer
description:
**A Snapshot of Your Day**
 We are seeking an experienced QA Engineer (Manual \& Automation) with strong expertise across web, mobile, and API testing. The ideal candidate possesses a solid foundation in manual testing, extensive hands\-on automation skills, strong analytical abilities, and the capability to take ownership of end\-to\-end quality for assigned features. This role requires close collaboration with cross\-functional teams and continuous improvement of testing processes, frameworks, and automation coverage.
   

  

**How You’ll Make An Impact**
* Develop and document comprehensive test plans, test cases, and automation scripts based on functional and technical requirements.
* Execute manual and automated tests to validate software functionality, usability, API responses, and overall system stability.
* Build, enhance, and maintain automation test suites for web, mobile, and API platforms.
* Accurately report, track, and manage defects using JIRA, ensuring clear and concise communication with the development team.
* Take ownership of end\-to\-end quality for assigned modules/features and ensure timely delivery of high\-quality releases.
* Perform regression testing to ensure new changes do not adversely impact existing functionality.
* Collaborate with developers, product managers, designers, and business stakeholders to clarify requirements and provide early feedback.
* Maintain detailed documentation of test cases, test results, and QA processes for traceability and reproducibility.
* Contribute to the improvement of automation frameworks to increase test reliability and coverage.
* Utilize AI tools to accelerate test case creation, script optimization, analysis, and documentation.
* Stay updated with emerging QA trends, tools, automation technologies, and industry best practices to drive continuous improvement.


**What You Bring**
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, or a related field.
* 3–5 years of experience in manual and automation testing for web applications, mobile apps, and APIs.
* Strong hands\-on experience with web automation using Playwright with Typescript and mobile automation using Appium.
* Experience with API testing and automation using Postman, Newman, or Rest Assured.
* Minimum 2 years of recent, continuous experience in Web and API automation
* Proficient in at least two programming languages used for automation, such as TypeScript, Java, Python, or C\#.
* Experience in integrating automated tests into CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, etc.).
* Experience in performance testing (load, stress, API performance) is an advantage.
* Hands\-on experience with test management tools such as JIRA, Azure DevOps, or similar platforms.
* Skilled in using AI\-driven QA tools to speed up test design, data generation, defect analysis, and documentation.
* Solid understanding of Agile/Scrum methodologies and experience working in cross\-functional Agile teams.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with the ability to identify issues early.
* Exceptional attention to detail, ensuring accurate testing and effective detection of defects.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills for collaboration with global and cross\-functional teams.
* ISTQB or other relevant QA certifications would be an advantage.


**About The Team**
 In the central Digital Products and Solutions (DPS) organization, our Software Application and Engineering department is responsible for developing software solutions for both internal and external customers.

With more than 92,000 dedicated employees, we not only generate electricity for over 16% of the global community, but we’re also using our technology to help protect people and the environment.

We uphold a 150\-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.

 Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity, we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences.

title: Quality Engineer (Tester, Manual)
description:
**Project Role :** 
 Quality Engineer (Tester, Manual)
   

  

**Project Role Description :** 
 Ensure solution quality by executing manual tests against defined requirements, user stories, and expected behavior. Design test cases, identify and document defects, and collaborate with delivery teams to ensure reliable, user\-ready releases.
   

  

**Must have skills :** 
 Microsoft Functional Testing
   

  

**Good to have skills :** 
 Automated Testing
   

  

**Minimum 2 Year(s) Of Experience Is Required**
**Educational Qualification :** 
 15 years full time education
   

  

 Summary:
   

  

 As a Quality Engineer focusing on manual testing, your day involves ensuring the quality of solutions by carefully executing tests aligned with defined requirements and user stories. You design detailed test cases, meticulously identify and document any discrepancies or defects, and work closely with delivery teams to support the release of dependable and user\-ready software. Your role is pivotal in maintaining the integrity of the product through thorough validation and collaboration, contributing to a seamless user experience and successful project outcomes.
   

  

 Roles \& Responsibilities:
   

  

* Expected to perform independently and become an SME.
* Required active participation/contribution in team discussions.
* Contribute in providing solutions to work related problems.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to understand requirements and provide feedback on testability and quality aspects.
* Maintain comprehensive documentation of test cases, defects, and test results to support transparency and traceability.
* Assist in the continuous improvement of testing processes and methodologies to enhance efficiency and effectiveness.
* Support junior team members by sharing knowledge and providing guidance on testing best practices.


 Professional \& Technical Skills:
   

  

* Must To Have Skills: Proficiency in Microsoft Functional Testing.
* Good To Have Skills: Automated Testing.
* Strong analytical skills to interpret requirements and translate them into effective test cases.
* Experience in defect tracking and management tools to ensure clear communication of issues.
* Ability to work collaboratively within agile teams and adapt to changing project needs.
* Attention to detail to identify subtle issues that could impact user experience.


 Additional Information:
   

  

* The candidate should have minimum 2 years of experience in Microsoft Functional Testing.
* This position is based at our BDC14A \- STPI location.
* A 15 years full time education is required.

title: QA Tester (Manual & AI-Assisted)
description:
**About Meraki Labs** 




 Meraki Labs is one of India's first startup studios, founded in 2020 and headquartered in Bangalore. Backed by seasoned entrepreneurs and operators, the team both founds and funds companies, taking a hands\-on approach to building them — working closely with founders to take bold ideas from paper to prototype to enduring businesses, with a focus on sectors like fintech, AI, deep tech, and edtech.
 



 As Meraki Labs continues to co\-build across its portfolio, we're looking for a QA Tester (Manual \& AI\-Assisted) to help ensure the products we build across our portfolio companies are reliable, high\-quality, and ready for real users — blending hands\-on manual testing rigor with modern AI\-assisted tools.
 



  





**Role Overview** 




 We're looking for a QA Tester with 2–5 years of experience who is comfortable executing manual test cycles while also leveraging AI\-powered testing tools (e.g., AI test generation, self\-healing automation, visual regression with AI, LLM\-based test case creation) to improve test coverage and efficiency. You'll work closely with developers, product managers, and designers across portfolio companies to ensure every release meets quality standards.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  




* Design, write, and execute manual test cases for web/mobile applications across functional, regression, UI/UX, and exploratory testing
* Use AI\-assisted testing tools to generate test cases, identify edge cases, and accelerate regression testing
* Identify, document, and track bugs using tools like Jira, Linear, or similar bug\-tracking systems
* Collaborate with developers to reproduce, troubleshoot, and verify bug fixes
* Perform API testing using tools like Postman
* Contribute to test plans, test strategies, and acceptance criteria during sprint planning
* Evaluate and pilot new AI\-based QA tools to continuously improve testing efficiency and coverage
* Conduct cross\-browser, cross\-device, and compatibility testing
* Participate in release readiness reviews and sign\-off processes
* Maintain clear, structured test documentation (test cases, test plans, bug reports)



  





**Requirements** 




  




* 2–5 years of hands\-on experience in manual software testing
* Solid understanding of QA methodologies, SDLC, and STLC
* Experience writing clear, structured test cases and bug reports
* Familiarity with AI\-assisted testing tools or a strong willingness to learn and adopt them (e.g., Testim, Mabl, Functionize, ChatGPT/Claude for test case generation, or similar)
* Working knowledge of bug tracking and test management tools (Jira, TestRail, Zephyr, etc.)
* Basic understanding of API testing
* Good understanding of web/mobile application architecture
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with excellent attention to detail
* Clear written and verbal communication skills



  





**Good to Have** 




  




* Exposure to basic automation scripting
* Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments
* Familiarity with prompt engineering for AI\-based test generation
* Basic SQL knowledge for backend data validation
* Experience testing AI/ML\-powered products or features



  





**What We Offer** 




  




* Opportunity to work at the intersection of traditional QA and cutting\-edge AI tooling, across a portfolio of fintech, AI, deep tech, and edtech startups
* Collaborative, fast\-paced startup studio environment

* Exposure to a wide range of devices including STB, Mobile, Smart TV, Apple TV and Fire TV ecosystems
* Collaboration with global teams and customer stakeholders across diverse projects
* Hands\-on experience with advanced testing, troubleshooting and streaming technologies
* Opportunity to contribute to high\-impact digital video solutions in a global telecommunications environment

title: Software Quality Assurance Analyst
description:
About the Role:
   

  

 As a Software Quality Assurance Analyst, you'll play a crucial role in ensuring the functionality and reliability of our software products by executing various test cases and helping to identify defects.  Skills:

title: Quality Assurance Engineer
description:
**A Snapshot of Your Day**

* Accurately report, track, and manage defects using JIRA, ensuring clear and concise communication with the development team.

title: QA Automation Engineer - QA 2
description:
**Job Purpose**
 We are looking for a QA2 Automation Engineer with 3–5 years of experience who will be responsible for ensuring the quality, reliability, and performance of our customer\-facing frontend platforms including Android, iOS, and Web applications.
   

  

 The primary focus of this role will be to design, develop, and maintain automated test frameworks and test suites for mobile and web platforms. You will work closely with developers, product managers, and designers to ensure that new features are delivered with high quality and minimal regressions.
   

  

 As an e\-commerce platform, our applications power critical user journeys such as product catalogue browsing, checkout flows, payments, and order lifecycle management, and this role will play a key part in ensuring these flows remain stable and reliable.
   

  

 To succeed in this role, you should have a strong understanding of automation frameworks, frontend testing strategies, test design techniques, and CI/CD integration. Experience in mobile and web test automation along with modern QA practices will be highly valuable.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 Design, develop, and maintain automation frameworks and test suites for Android, iOS, and Web applications.
   

  

 Write automated test cases for functional, regression, and end\-to\-end testing of customer\-facing features.
   

  

 Collaborate closely with frontend engineers (Android, iOS, Web) to understand application architecture and ensure proper automation coverage.
   

  

 Validate critical e\-commerce user journeys including product discovery, checkout flows, payment flows, and order lifecycle.
   

  

 Design and execute test scenarios using strong test design techniques such as boundary value testing, equivalence partitioning, and risk\-based testing.
   

  

 Manage and track test cases, test execution, and defects using Jira and related test management practices.
   

  

 Work closely with product managers and designers to validate business requirements and ensure correct feature behavior.
   

  

 Perform API testing and validation to ensure reliability of frontend\-backend integrations.
   

  

 Build and maintain automation pipelines integrated with CI/CD systems to enable continuous testing.
   

  

 Identify defects, analyze root causes, and collaborate with developers to ensure faster resolution.
   

  

 Monitor automation results and improve stability, reliability, and execution efficiency of automation suites.
   

  

 Continuously evaluate new tools, frameworks, and best practices to improve the overall QA automation ecosystem.
   

  

 Participate in Agile ceremonies, sprint planning, and release readiness discussions.
   

  

 Ensure high standards for performance, reliability, and usability across devices and browsers.
   

  

**Skills \& Requirements**
 Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
   

  

 3–5 years of experience in QA Automation, preferably testing mobile and web applications.
   

  

 Experience working with test management tools such as Jira for test case management and defect tracking.
   

  

**Hands\-on Experience With Automation Tools Such As**
* Appium / Espresso / XCUITest for mobile automation
* Selenium / Playwright / Cypress for web automation


 Experience writing automation tests using Java, Kotlin, JavaScript, or Python.
   

  

**Strong Understanding Of Test Design Techniques Such As**
* Boundary value analysis
* Equivalence partitioning
* Risk\-based testing


 Experience with API testing tools and frameworks such as Postman, Rest Assured, or similar.
   

  

 Good understanding of mobile and web application architecture and frontend workflows.
   

  

 Experience integrating automation test suites with CI/CD pipelines such as Jenkins, GitHub Actions, or GitLab CI.
   

  

 Proficiency with Git or similar code versioning tools.
   

  

 Experience testing REST APIs and JSON\-based services.
   

  

 Strong analytical and debugging skills.
   

  

 Excellent communication, collaboration, and problem\-solving skills.
   

  

 Ability to work effectively in a fast\-paced Agile development environment.
   

  

**Good To Have**
 Experience with BDD frameworks such as Cucumber / Gherkin.
   

  

 Experience with performance testing tools such as JMeter or k6\.
   

  

 Experience with mobile device farms such as BrowserStack or Firebase Test Lab.
   

  

 Understanding of mobile deep linking, push notifications, and analytics validation.
   

  

 Experience with test reporting tools such as Allure or ReportPortal.
   

  

 Understanding of modern frontend technologies and mobile architectures.

title: Mid-Level QA Engineer
description:
About the Role
 
 Office Beacon is looking for a
 **Mid\-Level QA Engineer** 
 with strong hands\-on experience in both
 **manual and automated testing** 
 .
 



 You will be responsible for validating product features, designing and executing test scenarios, identifying defects, maintaining automated test coverage, testing APIs, and supporting reliable product releases.
 



 The ideal candidate combines strong manual testing fundamentals with practical automation experience and can independently investigate issues, communicate defects clearly, and work closely with developers, product managers, designers, and other QA engineers.
 



**Hands\-on test automation experience is required for this position.** 



 Key Responsibilities
 
**Manual \& Functional Testing** 



* Test new product features against requirements, acceptance criteria, and expected user workflows.
* Perform functional, regression, smoke, sanity, and exploratory testing.
* Identify functional defects, UI inconsistencies, validation issues, edge cases, and workflow problems.
* Validate features from both technical and end\-user perspectives.
* Perform impact testing on areas affected by product changes.



**Test Case Design \& Execution** 



* Develop comprehensive test scenarios based on product requirements and user journeys.
* Create and maintain detailed, reusable test cases.
* Identify positive, negative, and edge\-case scenarios.
* Validate form behavior, error messages, loading states, empty states, and success states.
* Test permissions and role\-based behavior where applicable.
* Validate data accuracy and workflow consistency.
* Ensure new changes do not negatively affect existing functionality.



**Defect Management** 



* Identify and document defects clearly and accurately.
* Provide reproducible steps, expected results, and actual results.
* Include screenshots, videos, logs, or other supporting evidence when appropriate.
* Assign appropriate severity and priority based on business and technical impact.
* Retest resolved defects and verify fixes.
* Communicate critical and release\-blocking issues promptly.



**Test Automation** 



* Develop and maintain automated tests for critical product workflows.
* Automate repetitive regression scenarios.
* Maintain existing automation suites and test cases.
* Execute automated test suites as part of release validation.
* Analyze automation failures and distinguish between application defects, test failures, and environmental issues.
* Improve automation stability, reliability, and coverage.
* Work with developers and senior QA engineers to integrate automation into the QA process.



**API Testing** 



* Perform API testing using Postman, Swagger, or similar tools.
* Validate API requests and responses.
* Verify status codes, payloads, validation rules, and error handling.
* Identify inconsistencies between frontend behavior and backend responses.
* Support API and integration testing.



**Product Quality \& User Experience** 



* Evaluate features for functionality, usability, reliability, and consistency.
* Test happy\-path, negative, and edge\-case scenarios.
* Validate responsive behavior and cross\-browser compatibility.
* Identify potential customer\-impacting issues before release.



**Release \& Regression Testing** 



* Support QA validation throughout the development lifecycle.
* Execute regression suites before production releases.
* Maintain release checklists and regression coverage.
* Identify high\-risk areas requiring additional testing.
* Participate in release validation and provide clear testing status updates.



**Collaboration** 



* Work closely with developers, product managers, designers, and QA engineers.
* Participate in sprint planning, refinement, stand\-ups, and other Agile ceremonies.
* Communicate testing progress, risks, and defects clearly.


 Must\-Have Qualifications
 * **2–4 years of professional experience in software QA or software testing.**
* **Hands\-on experience with test automation is mandatory.**
* Experience testing web applications, SaaS products, mobile applications, or public\-facing software products.
* Hands\-on experience with at least one automation framework such as
 **Playwright, Cypress, Selenium, Appium, or a similar framework** 
 .
* Strong understanding of manual testing principles.
* Strong knowledge of
 **test case design and defect life cycle** 
 .
* Experience with functional, regression, smoke, sanity, and exploratory testing.
* Ability to create test scenarios from product requirements and user journeys.
* Basic to intermediate experience with
 **API testing** 
 .
* Hands\-on experience with
 **Postman, Swagger, or a similar API testing tool** 
 .
* Ability to identify functional defects, UI issues, validation problems, and edge cases.
* Familiarity with Agile/Scrum and sprint\-based software development.
* Experience with defect tracking or project management tools such as
 **Jira, Linear, GitHub, or similar platforms** 
 .
* Strong debugging, analytical, and problem\-solving skills.


 Preferred Qualifications
 * Experience with more than one automation framework.
* Experience with
 **Playwright, Cypress, Selenium, or Appium** 
 .
* Experience integrating automated tests into
 **CI/CD pipelines** 
 .
* Familiarity with test management tools such as
 **TestRail or Zephyr** 
 .
* Familiarity with Git and Git\-based development workflows.
* Experience with automated API testing.
* Experience testing responsive web applications across multiple browsers and devices.
* Experience troubleshooting flaky automation tests.
* Experience working with logs, browser developer tools, or basic debugging tools.
